jobs.title: Senior Fulfillment Operations Manager, Away Team
jobs.description:
Spreetail propels brands to increase their ecommerce market share across the globe while improving their operational costs. Learn how we are building one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies in history: www.spreetail.com.  


 
Spreetail is seeking a Senior FC Operations Manager to join our Away Team, a small, elite group that supports facility launches, crisis response, and operations excellence across our fulfillment network. This is not a traditional site-based role. You will lead Area Managers and FC Leads embedded across our network, building operational mastery and deploying where we need you most. Partnering with Site Directors, you will run the day-to-day operation of every facility you support, own facility P&L performance during deployments, and build a bench of leaders who can perform in any building. When Spreetail opens a new fulfillment center, you will move into a permanent senior operations leadership role there, bringing the relationships, operating model fluency, and institutional knowledge to help launch the site from day one.

This role is built for a strong operations leader who is ready to run a full building, prove it across the network, and grow toward site leadership. If you thrive on variety, build trust fast in new environments, and want a clear path to owning a building's operation, this is your role.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced and commercially minded Financial Controller to join us on a 6 to 12 month fixed term contract to start asap! We are a rapidly scaling business and the potential for a future permanent role for the right candidate is very possible.

This isn't a role for someone who simply wants to maintain the status quo. We're looking for an experienced hands-on finance leader who can help us become a 1st rate finance team through continuous learning, improvement, automation and systemisation. A leader that can help us scale from a local finance team to an efficient international finance function.

You will lead the Finance function, overseeing financial operations, controls, team leadership and business partnering while driving scalability and continuous improvement. You will also partner with FP&A on the monthly reporting cycle, cash flow management and budgeting & forecasting rounds. And you will partner with the business to enable continuous improvement and strategic decision-making.

As a fast-growing healthcare business, things move quickly here. We're looking for someone who enjoys pace, thrives on variety, and can bring structure, clarity, and commercial thinking to a constantly evolving environment.

While we offer flexibility, this role requires attendance at our Winnersh office at least once per week to support collaboration with key stakeholders and maintain a strong connection to the business.

We can only consider candidates who are immediately available or have a notice period of no more than two weeks.

 

What will you be doing?

 - Lead the day-to-day Finance function ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.

 - Manage and develop a growing Finance team including the Accounting Team, AP, AR & Payroll, providing support, coaching, and direction.

 - Support the development of a scalable finance operating model, including international expansion and strategic growth initiatives.

 - Maintain a robust financial control environment, overseeing risk management, tax compliance, statutory reporting and audit activities.

 - Own the month-end and year-end close processes, balance sheet integrity and working capital management, ensuring accurate reporting, effective controls and strong cash performance.

 - Oversee treasury activities including banking relationships, cash management, liquidity planning and payment controls.

 - Oversee VAT, PAYE and corporation tax compliance, coordinating with external advisers where required.

 - Develop and maintain financial policies, procedures and governance frameworks to support a strong internal control environment.

 - Lead finance transformation initiatives, including process improvement, automation, system optimisation and implementation projects to improve efficiency, scalability and controls.

 - Partner with senior stakeholders and FP&A to provide financial insight, performance analysis and decision support across the business.

 - Partner with FP&A on cash flow management and budgeting & forecasting rounds.

 - Act as a key point of contact for external auditors, accountants, banks, and other finance partners.

What do you need?

 - Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

 - Min 3 years experience in a Financial Controller role.

 - Experience with inventory processes including purchase orders, prepaid orders, consignment stock, and cost of goods sold.

 - Strong technical accounting knowledge with experience producing management and statutory accounts.

 - Experience managing budgets, forecasts, and cash flow in a growing business.

 - Experience implementing systems and optimising the utilisation of systems.

 - Proven ability to partner with senior stakeholders and influence decision-making.

 - Strong leadership skills with experience scaling, managing and developing teams.

 - Excellent attention to detail alongside the ability to think strategically.

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

 - Strong systems knowledge and advanced Excel skills.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience within healthcare, pharmacy, e-commerce, or regulated industries.

 - Experience working in a scale-up environment.

 - Experience using Xero,  ADP,  ApprovalMax, ExpenseIn, FloQast and similar systems.

 

What we offer:

 - Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays.

 - Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions.

 - Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more.

 - Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams with support to grow your skills and impact on the business.

 - Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave.

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

jobs.title: Senior CX Specialist
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Customer Experience (CX) Specialist with advanced expertise in measurement, content adoption, and qualitative and quantitative user research. This individual will drive data-informed insights that help Learning Services understand whether content is reaching users, whether it is effective, and why adoption succeeds or falls short. They will independently lead research initiatives, collaborate with colleagues across Learning Services, and translate findings into strategic recommendations that improve the Learning Services customer journey.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

• Identify user needs, pain points, and behavior patterns through measurement and evaluation frameworks, and translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve the learning journey.

• Use Heap and other analytics tools to independently track content engagement, map user journeys, surface meaningful patterns, and deliver actionable insights to Learning Services teams.

• Design and facilitate stakeholder interviews, surveys, and usability tests; synthesize findings to identify strategic themes and inform Learning Services priorities.

• Lead end-to-end research projects — from planning and execution through to presenting insights — ensuring findings drive decisions across teams.

• Collaborate across functions (online learning, product, marketing, corporate UX) and influence outcomes through a deep understanding of user needs.

• Create and refine personas, journey maps, and user scenarios to guide content strategy and Learning Services planning.

• Synthesize research into clear, compelling reports, presentations, and data narratives tailored for diverse stakeholders including leadership.

• Proactively communicate project status, surface risks, and recommend solutions with clarity and impact.

• Stay current on trends in analytics, content effectiveness measurement, and CX research practices.

• Performs other related duties and activities as required.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS

Education and Work Experience:

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in a related field a plus.

• 5+ years of progressive experience in user experience research, customer experience, analytics, or a related field.

• Demonstrated experience with measurement and evaluation — understanding of what makes content effective and how to assess impact.

• Experience working in a content-driven environment; familiarity with adult learning or instructional design a plus.

• Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities:

• Advanced proficiency in qualitative and quantitative research methods.

• Experience with analytics tools (Heap, Google Analytics, or equivalent) to track user journeys and content engagement.

• Strong ability to design, deploy, and analyze surveys at scale and distill findings into strategic insights.

• Skilled at translating data into clear narratives and recommendations for diverse audiences, including leadership.

• Proven ability to lead complex research and measurement projects with minimal guidance.

• Ability to mentor others and give constructive, timely feedback.

• Experience with UX tools (e.g., Figma, UserTesting) and usability testing practices.

Other Requirements:

• Travel: 0%

• Special Work Hours: None

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Packaging Development
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE.

Glossier is a people-powered ecosystem, brought to life by engaging online and offline experiences. In 12 years, we have built an iconic brand that goes far beyond beauty. Our brand is built on trusted emotional connection, empathy, and consistency in how we show up for people every day. We are woven into everyday moments of people’s lives, becoming part of their routines, their self-expression, and their confidence. We are defined not just by what we make, but by how we make people feel and the relationships we build over time. Our north-star values are to be Human, Curious, Playful, and Helpful. We are driven by a shared mission to become the Most Loved Lifestyle Brand in the World.

THE FORMULA.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Packaging Development to bring thoughtful design, technical expertise, and operational discipline to the packaging our community reaches for every day.

As part of our Product Development team, you’ll own packaging development across a portfolio of programs spanning color cosmetics, skincare, sets, and fragrance. From translating creative concepts into manufacturable components to improving the packaging already in our customers’ hands, you’ll help ensure every detail delivers on the Glossier experience.

You’re an experienced packaging professional who can move confidently between the big picture and the technical details. You know how to assess feasibility, anticipate risks, challenge assumptions, and guide partners toward practical solutions. You bring structure to complex work and take pride in making both products and processes better. You’ll partner closely with Product Development, Creative, Marketing, Project Management, Supply Chain, Sourcing, and Quality, along with packaging suppliers and contract manufacturers.

BRINGING IT ALL TOGETHER.

Packaging Development & Technical Ownership

• Own packaging development from concept and feasibility through tooling, qualification, commercialization, and launch across assigned new products, reformulations, seasonal programs, and existing product improvements in color cosmetics, skincare, and fragrance.

• Translate creative direction and product requirements into packaging solutions that balance customer experience, functionality, quality, cost, sustainability, and manufacturing capabilities.

• Lead technical feasibility assessments, evaluating materials, component construction, dispensing systems, tooling, assembly, development timelines, and production requirements.

• Establish packaging specifications, critical dimensions, tolerances, and performance requirements; review technical drawings and guide suppliers through development and approval.

• Lead packaging risk assessments and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), partnering with Product Development and Quality to establish appropriate compatibility, stability, transit, and performance testing.

• Evaluate test results, recommend technical solutions, and resolve packaging issues throughout development, scale-up, and production.

• Oversee component, artwork, proof, color standard, and range board approvals, ensuring alignment with approved specifications and design intent.

Program Execution & Supplier Partnership

• Independently manage multiple complex packaging programs, maintaining clear development plans, milestones, dependencies, and approval requirements.

• Serve as the primary packaging technical partner for suppliers and contract manufacturers, setting clear expectations and holding partners accountable for development deliverables.

• Identify risks early, communicate implications clearly, and recommend solutions that protect launch timing, quality, and agreed cost objectives.

• Lead packaging development reviews and communicate progress, decisions, and issues requiring escalation to cross-functional partners.

• Partner with Sourcing and Supply Chain to assess supplier capabilities, tooling proposals, lead times, and cost tradeoffs.

• Support tooling trials, line trials, and initial production runs, confirming packaging performs as intended under manufacturing conditions.

Process Improvement & Portfolio Optimization

• Strengthen packaging development workflows, introducing practical tools, templates, and checkpoints that improve consistency, accountability, and speed.

• Own the accuracy and completeness of packaging specifications, component records, and bills of materials within Specright, establishing clear documentation and change-control practices.

• Identify opportunities to improve existing packaging through component standardization, material changes, manufacturing efficiencies, cost optimization, and quality improvements.

• Partner with Quality and suppliers on root-cause investigations and corrective actions for packaging issues, incorporating lessons learned into future development.

• Maintain an organized packaging reference library, including approved standards, supplier capabilities, materials, and emerging technologies.

• Evaluate packaging innovations and sustainability opportunities, recommending applications that are technically sound and relevant to Glossier’s products and priorities.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

• Act as a trusted packaging subject matter expert, helping cross-functional partners understand technical considerations and make informed decisions.

• Guide and mentor colleagues through technical reviews, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.

• Bring a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach to competing priorities, making clear recommendations and escalating decisions at the right time.

• Build strong working relationships across internal teams and external partners, creating shared accountability for successful execution.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MIX.

• 7+ years of progressive experience in packaging development or packaging engineering, including substantial experience in prestige beauty.

• Demonstrated expertise across color cosmetics, skincare, and fragrance packaging, with an understanding of the distinct technical and performance requirements of each category.

• A track record of independently leading complex packaging programs from concept through commercialization, including custom components and tooling.

• Strong technical knowledge of primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging materials, manufacturing processes, decoration methods, dispensing systems, and assembly, including fragrance bottles, pumps, collars, and closures.

• Experience reviewing engineering drawings, specifications, dimensional tolerances, tooling designs, and component performance requirements.

• Working knowledge of packaging qualification methods, including compatibility, functionality, transit testing, and manufacturing line validation.

• Experience leading technical problem-solving with suppliers and contract manufacturers, including root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple programs, anticipate dependencies, and communicate tradeoffs clearly.

• A demonstrated ability to improve development processes and identify opportunities to enhance quality, efficiency, and cost.

• Experience maintaining packaging specifications, bills of materials, and change records in a PLM or specification management system; Specright experience is a plus.

• The ability to influence cross-functional decisions and mentor others through technical expertise and collaborative leadership.

• A bachelor’s degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• Familiarity with CAD software, SolidWorks, rapid prototyping, and 3D printing is a plus.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required for supplier meetings, development trials, and production support.

In accordance with applicable law, the following represents a good faith estimate of the minimum and maximum compensation range for this position:

• The estimated annual pay range for this role is$122,000 - $158,000 per year.

• Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and location, and the final offer will reflect the totality of the candidate’s background.

• There may be future opportunities for continued pay progression based on continued strong performance in the role.

• Full time positions are also eligible for a competitive compensation and benefits package that includes medical health insurance, 401K, Paid Time Off, Short Term and Long Term Disability leave, and a range of other benefits.

• Learn more at the Glossier Career page.

jobs.description:

Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Provider Engagement Specialist to support imaging providers across the United States as they interact with OneImaging workflows and ensure a smooth, high-quality experience. This role is responsible for handling provider inquiries, troubleshooting issues, and delivering timely, professional support throughout their interactions with our platform. This position is critical to maintaining strong provider relationships and ensuring an exceptional service experience.

Provider Support & Communication

Documentation & Workflow Management

Core Competencies

• Learning Agility: Quickly absorbs new information, adapts to workflow updates, and applies feedback.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Director, Product Development
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE.

Glossier is a people-powered ecosystem, brought to life by engaging online and offline experiences. In 12 years, we have built an iconic brand that goes far beyond beauty. Our brand is built on trusted emotional connection, empathy, and consistency in how we show up for people every day. We are woven into everyday moments of people’s lives, becoming part of their routines, their self-expression, and their confidence. We are defined not just by what we make, but by how we make people feel and the relationships we build over time. Our north-star values are to be Human, Curious, Playful, and Helpful. We are driven by a shared mission to become the Most Loved Lifestyle Brand in the World.

THE FORMULA.

We’re looking for a Director, Product Development to help our products, and the operation behind them, be their very best. Think of this role as a carefully crafted formula: equal parts technical expertise, operational instinct, and follow through, with a healthy dose of curiosity about how things can work better.

With a primary focus on Color and Skincare, you’ll lead the daily execution and technical oversight of our product development programs, directly managing Packaging Development and partnering closely with Product leadership, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, Creative, and external manufacturing partners. Reporting to [reporting line to be confirmed], you’ll translate established product priorities into clear plans, keep existing programs moving, and bring structure and visibility to the details that make great execution possible.

You know what it takes to run a development operation: clear ownership, realistic timelines, thoughtful technical decisions, and strong relationships. You’re comfortable getting into the details, asking the right questions, and identifying issues before they become obstacles. Just as important, you can step back, connect the dots, and find practical ways to improve the process.

The North Star: Make the way we develop and deliver products as thoughtful as the products themselves.

If you find satisfaction in solving a tricky technical challenge, untangling a process, or helping a team work better together, you may be exactly the ingredient we’re missing. So, is this you? Read on carefully to see what it takes to bring this formula to life.

BRINGING IT ALL TOGETHER.

From keeping active programs on track to strengthening technical execution and finding smarter ways of working, the Director, Product Development will play a key role across Product Development Operations & Execution, Technical Oversight & Packaging Development, and Leadership & Cross Functional Partnership.

Product Development Operations & Execution

• Lead the daily operation of active Color and Skincare development programs, translating approved briefs and product priorities into clear timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and deliverables.

• Manage execution across established programs, including renovations, reformulations, packaging updates, shade extensions, and other portfolio maintenance initiatives.

• Maintain a master project list that gives partners across functions a shared view of program status, dependencies, upcoming decisions, and risks.

• Establish practical, consistent ways of working, including project kickoffs, development reviews, approval checkpoints, and clear handoffs between teams.

• Identify bottlenecks, competing priorities, and resource constraints early; recommend solutions and escalate decisions with clear options and implications.

• Improve development processes, tools, and documentation to reduce rework, strengthen accountability, and make execution more predictable.

• Track program timing, development costs, and performance against agreed targets, using lessons learned to improve future execution.

• Identify opportunities within the existing portfolio to improve product quality, simplify components and processes, reduce costs, and support supply continuity.

Technical Oversight & Packaging Development

• Provide technical oversight across formula and packaging development, helping teams evaluate feasibility, resolve issues, and meet agreed product performance, quality, cost, and timing requirements.

• Directly manage the Packaging Development team, setting priorities, reviewing technical work, and supporting effective execution across primary and secondary packaging programs.

• Guide packaging decisions across materials, components, functionality, tooling, decoration, and manufacturability, balancing the Glossier experience with operational requirements.

• Partner with Quality, Regulatory, testing partners, and manufacturers to define testing requirements and track completion of stability, compatibility, performance, and packaging validation.

• Review technical findings with the appropriate functional experts, ensuring risks are understood and required approvals are secured before programs advance.

• Oversee the readiness and accuracy of development specifications, bills of materials, testing records, and change documentation in partnership with the teams responsible for maintaining them.

• Partner with contract manufacturers and component suppliers on pilot runs, line trials, scale up, and production readiness, ensuring a clear handoff into ongoing operations.

• Lead technical troubleshooting related to development with internal and external partners, identifying root causes and coordinating corrective actions.

• Manage the technical execution of approved formula, packaging, material, and supplier changes, including updates needed to support market requirements.

Leadership & Cross Functional Partnership

• Lead and develop the Packaging Development team through clear expectations, regular feedback, technical coaching, and thoughtful workload planning.

• Build a team culture grounded in curiosity, collaboration, accountability, and pride in the details.

• Serve as the operational point of connection across Product Development, Packaging, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, Creative, and Finance.

• Run focused program reviews that surface the right information, clarify decisions, and keep work moving.

• Manage daily development relationships with contract manufacturers, laboratories, packaging suppliers, and other technical partners, holding them accountable to agreed deliverables.

• Partner with Supply Chain and Operations on supplier changes, recurring product issues, and opportunities to improve manufacturing efficiency and continuity.

• Manage assigned development budgets and work with Finance and Supply Chain to assess cost implications and improvement opportunities.

• Keep Product leadership informed through concise updates on progress, risks, resource needs, and recommendations.

KEY INGREDIENTS.

We know you’re here to do great work, raise the bar, and make a meaningful impact, and we’re here for that, too. While there’s no single path to success, we’ve found that the key ingredients below set the foundation for doing your best work, thriving in the role, and ultimately making it your own (i.e. successfully bringing this formula to life).

• 8+ years of experience in beauty product development, technical development, commercialization, or development operations, including experience managing people.

• Meaningful experience across Color Cosmetics and Skincare, with a strong understanding of how formulas, packaging, testing, and manufacturing come together.

• Demonstrated experience running daily development operations and managing multiple programs with competing timelines and dependencies.

• A track record of improving existing processes, introducing useful structure, and delivering measurable improvements in timing, quality, cost, or efficiency.

• Strong technical knowledge of packaging development, including materials, components, tooling, testing, and compatibility between formulas and packaging; experience managing packaging professionals.

• Experience supporting scale up, production trials, technical troubleshooting, and the transition from development into commercial production.

• Strong vendor management experience, including working directly with contract manufacturers, laboratories, and domestic and international packaging suppliers.

• Sound judgment and a practical approach to solving problems, with the ability to assess tradeoffs, make recommendations, and recognize when specialist input is needed.

• Strong organizational and analytical skills, with close attention to documentation, timelines, costs, and follow through.

• A clear, thoughtful communication style and the ability to build productive relationships across creative, technical, and operational teams.

• A practical, involved leadership approach: you enjoy developing people, creating clarity, and rolling up your sleeves to help the team succeed.

• A genuine interest in beauty and a commitment to protecting the quality, performance, and experience our community expects from Glossier.

• Travel as needed to meet with vendors, support trials, or work with external partners.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

HVAC Technician

Job Type: Full Time, Non-Exempt

Shift: Monday to Friday from 7:00 am to 4:00 pm

Pay: $30.50 to $34.00+ per hour

Location: Taneytown, MD

Who You Are:

As an HVAC Technician, you’ll be responsible for installing, maintaining and repairing heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems to ensure optimal climate conditions for cannabis cultivation, processing, and storage.

You’ll ensure precise temperature, humidity, and airflow to support healthy plants, top-quality products, and regulatory compliance. Working closely with cultivation and operations teams, you’ll help keep systems running efficiently.

What You’ll Do:

• Install, maintain, and repair HVAC systems: Keep air handlers, dehumidifiers, ventilation units, and CO₂ enrichment systems running smoothly for optimal plant growth.

• Monitor and adjust climate controls: Ensure ideal temperature, humidity, and air circulation levels to maintain a stable cultivation environment.

• Troubleshoot and repair issues: Quickly diagnose and resolve HVAC-related problems to minimize downtime and maintain efficiency.

• Perform preventive maintenance: Regularly clean, replace filters, and inspect system components to extend equipment life and prevent breakdowns.

• Ensure compliance: Follow state and local cannabis industry regulations for climate control, air filtration, odor mitigation, and EPA refrigerant handling guidelines.

• Support energy efficiency efforts: Assist in identifying and implementing solutions to optimize system performance and reduce operating costs.

• Maintain accurate records: Track system performance, maintenance schedules, and compliance reports for internal and regulatory needs.

• Collaborate with teams: Work closely with cultivation, processing, and retail teams to meet facility climate requirements.

• Follow safety and SOP guidelines: Adhere to OSHA standards, company procedures, and assist with contractor coordination for major repairs and inspections.

What You’ll Bring:

• High school diploma or equivalent (required)

• Technical school certification or 1-2 years of experience in commercial or residential HVAC (required)

• At least 5 years of hands-on experience in HVAC installation, repair, and maintenance

• EPA 608 Universal certification (required)

• Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, including heating, cooling, dehumidification, and ventilation

• Understanding of climate control for indoor cultivation, with expertise in temperature and humidity management

• Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration components of HVAC systems

• Attention to detail and efficiency, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

Even Better If:

• You have an HVAC certification (preferred).

• You’ve worked in controlled environment agriculture, food processing, or the cannabis industry—a big plus!

• You have a basic understanding of cannabis industry regulations related to air quality and climate control.

• You’re familiar with Building Management Systems (BMS) and how they integrate with HVAC operations.

• You have experience with Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), including installation, troubleshooting, and programming.

The employee is occasionally required to lift up to 50 lbs. $30.50—$34 USD

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

THE ROLE

Zeta Global is seeking a Senior Customer Success Manager, CRM. In this role, you will serve as a strategic partner to enterprise clients, helping them maximize the value of Zeta's marketing technology solutions to drive customer engagement, retention, and growth.

You will own relationships with a portfolio of clients, working closely with marketing leaders and cross-functional teams to develop data-driven strategies, optimize campaign performance, and deliver measurable business results. The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of lifecycle marketing, a consultative approach to client relationships, and the ability to translate complex marketing challenges into actionable solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own Strategic Client Relationships: Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a portfolio of enterprise clients, building strong relationships with key stakeholders and understanding their business objectives, marketing strategies, and KPIs.

• Drive Loyalty Strategy & Performance: Partner with clients to develop and execute loyalty and lifecycle marketing strategies that improve customer engagement, acquisition, retention, and lifetime value.

• Deliver Data-Driven Insights: Analyze campaign performance, customer engagement trends, and marketing KPIs to identify optimization opportunities and provide actionable recommendations.

• Maximize Platform Adoption: Guide clients in leveraging Zeta's platform capabilities, ensuring they are effectively utilizing available solutions to achieve their marketing and business goals.

• Lead Strategic Business Reviews: Present campaign results, performance insights, and strategic recommendations to client stakeholders, demonstrating measurable value and identifying opportunities for continued growth.

• Support Client Retention & Growth: Proactively identify account risks, address client challenges, and partner with commercial teams to uncover opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and expanding client relationships.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with internal teams across Customer Success, Analytics, and Operations to execute client initiatives, resolve challenges, and deliver a seamless client experience.

• Champion the Voice of the Customer: Share client feedback, industry trends, and emerging needs with internal stakeholders to inform product enhancements and improve the overall customer experience.

• Drive Operational Excellence: Manage multiple client priorities, oversee key deliverables, and ensure timely execution while maintaining a high standard of client service.

REQUIREMENTS

• 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Account Management, or a related client-facing role within MarTech, SaaS, or digital marketing.

• Strong understanding of email marketing, marketing automation, loyalty programs, and customer lifecycle strategies.

• Experience managing enterprise client relationships and serving as a strategic advisor to senior marketing stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to analyze marketing performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to balance multiple client accounts, competing priorities, and cross-functional initiatives.

• A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience working with enterprise email service providers (ESPs), customer data platforms (CDPs), or marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, Braze, Iterable, or similar technologies.

• Familiarity with email marketing performance metrics, including deliverability, engagement, conversion, and customer retention.

• Experience with audience segmentation, personalization, customer journey orchestration, and omnichannel marketing strategies.

• Understanding of marketing data, analytics, and campaign measurement.

LOCATION

This is a remote position based in the United States.

BENEFITS & PERKS

• Unlimited PTO

• Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Employee Equity and Stock Purchase Plan

• Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!!

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this role is $90,000 - $100,000 depending on location and experience.

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services (Application Security)
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Sydney

About the Role

Cloudflare’s Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services provides customers with a dedicated, hands-on technical expert embedded directly within their environment. This is not a traditional support or purely advisory engagement—it is a staff-augmentation model where you act as an extension of the customer’s team, taking the lead in managing, optimizing, and evolving their Cloudflare solutions.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are a recognized subject-matter expert in your specialization and a trusted advisor to both the customer and Cloudflare leadership. You will own the most complex, high-stakes customer engagements, and contribute to the evolution of Cloudflare's service methodologies and offerings. You operate with a high degree of autonomy, make architectural decisions that impact mission-critical infrastructure, and partner with executive stakeholders to align technical outcomes with business objectives.

This role is ideal for senior technologists who have a proven track record of owning end-to-end customer transformations, leading through influence, and scaling expertise across teams.

What You Will Do

Embed & Integrate

• Become a trusted, embedded member of the customer’s technical team, operating within their tools, processes, and change-management frameworks.

• Follow the customer’s change-management process for all hands-on modifications, ensuring risk mitigation and operational continuity.

Hands-On Execution

• Design, configure, and optimize Cloudflare solutions directly within the customer environment.

• Implement changes, build prototypes, develop automation scripts, and troubleshoot issues in real time.

Strategic Advisory & Architecture

• Provide proactive architectural guidance, roadmap alignment, and best-practice recommendations.

• Produce Solution Designs, HLDs, LLDs, databuilds, procedures, test plans, deployment plans, migration plans, as-builts, and other artifacts necessary for delivery and smooth handoff.

Workshops & Knowledge Transfer

• Lead technical workshops, knowledge-transfer sessions, and special-event preparation (e.g., product launches, traffic events, security drills, quarterly business reviews).

• Ensure continuity by documenting decisions, runbooks, and configurations in the customer’s collaborative workspace.

Customer Advocacy & Liaison

• Act as the voice of the customer within Cloudflare, surfacing product gaps, feature requests, and escalation items to Engineering, Support, and Product.

• Partner closely with the Account Executive, Solutions Engineer, Customer Success Manager, Delivery Leaders and other stakeholders to align on account strategy and expansion opportunities.

Experience & Skills

Core Requirements

15+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role.

Recognized Expertise in one of the following focus areas with a proven track record of leading complex, enterprise-scale engagements:

• Applications — Advanced tuning of WAF, Bot Management, API Gateway, DDoS protection, Rate Limiting, and performance optimization for global web properties. Experience designing security architectures for large-scale, multi-zone deployments.

• Network — Hands-on management of Magic Transit, BYOIP, complex L3/L4 routing, DDoS resilience, and low-latency global connectivity design. Experience with network transformations and MPLS/SD-WAN migrations.

• Leadership & Mentorship — Demonstrated experience mentoring junior team members, leading technical workshops, and contributing to the development of service methodologies, best practices, and reusable assets.

• Strong Networking Foundation — Expert-level understanding of the OSI model, TCP/IP, TLS, DNS, and HTTP.

• Hands-On Technical Skills — Demonstrated ability to implement, configure, and troubleshoot complex solutions. Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform) and scripting (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Bash) is highly desirable.

• Project & Program Management — Ability to manage multiple competing priorities, work to deadlines, and deliver results in ambiguous or fast-moving environments. Experience scoping and estimating complex engagements.

• Communication & Executive Presence — Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. Ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audience

• Regional Experience — Experience working with enterprise customers in APJC. Understanding of regional compliance requirements, business culture, and technical ecosystems.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in heavily regulated industries (Public Sector, Financial Services, Healthcare) or complex legacy-migration environments.

• Relevant industry certifications: CISSP, CCIE, AWS, GCP, Azure certifications, or equivalent.

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and enterprise change-management processes.

• Familiarity with Zero Trust / SASE — Securing distributed workforces with Access, Gateway, CASB, RBI, and DLP. Proven experience implementing Zero Trust architectures at enterprise scale.

• Prior experience with Cloudflare’s product suite and edge-network ecosystem.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Care Access

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care. We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.

With programs like Future of Medicine, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and Difference Makers, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access, visit www.CareAccess.com.

How This Role Makes a Difference

The Senior Data Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and enterprise data solutions that support the organization's operational, analytical, and reporting needs. This position oversees the ingestion, transformation, integration, and delivery of complex data from multiple sources to ensure the availability, reliability, and integrity of enterprise data assets. The Senior Data Engineer collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to develop modern data architectures, optimize data processing workflows, and enhance platform performance using industry best practices and cloud-based technologies. This role provides technical leadership in advancing the organization's data infrastructure, supporting data governance initiatives, and delivering high-quality data solutions that enable informed business decision-making.

How You'll Make An Impact

• Data Engineering Strategy and Architecture: Design and implement scalable, reliable, and efficient data pipelines to support clinical, operational, and business needs. Develop and maintain architecture standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across data engineering workflows. Build automated systems for data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration leveraging cloud-native and open-source tools.

• Data Infrastructure and Performance Optimization: Optimize data storage and processing in data lakes and cloud data warehouses (Azure, Databricks). Develop and monitor batch and streaming data processes to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. Maintain documentation and lineage tracking across datasets and pipelines to support transparency and governance.

• Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work cross-functionally with analysts, data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver fit-for-purpose data solutions. Review and refine work completed by other team members, ensuring quality and performance standards are met. Provide technical mentorship to junior team members and collaborate with contractors and third-party vendors to extend engineering capacity.

• Technology and Tools: Use Databricks, DBT, Azure Data Factory, and SQL to architect and deploy robust data engineering solutions. Integrate APIs, structured/unstructured data sources, and third-party systems into centralized data platforms. Evaluate and implement new technologies to enhance the scalability, observability, and automation of data operations.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively suggest improvements to infrastructure, processes, and automation to improve system efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance performance.

The Expertise Required

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory), and modern software engineering practices.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to address complex data challenges and drive toward scalable solutions.

Certifications/Licenses, Education, and Experience

• Minimum Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum Experience: 5+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of building cloud-based, production-grade data pipelines. Strong expertise in Databricks, SQL, dbt, Python, and cloud data ecosystems such as Azure. Experience working with structured and semi-structured data from diverse domains.

How We Work Together

• Location: Remote within the United States. This role requires 100% of work to be performed in a remote office environment.

• Travel: This is a remote position with less than 10% travel requirements. Occasional planned travel may be required as part of the role.

• Physical demands associated with this position Include: The ability to use keyboards and other computer equipment.

The expected pay range for this role is $120,000 - $160,000 USD per year for full time team members.

Benefits & Perks (US Full Time Employees)

• 100% Employer paid medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options

• Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Accounts

• Bi-weekly HSA employer contribution

• Company paid Short-Term Disability and Long-Term Disability

• 401(k) Retirement Plan, with Company Match

jobs.description:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

Principal Consultant (Acquisition Solutions)

Appian Customer Success is obsessed with delivering exceptional customer outcomes and driving mission-critical business impact. Grounded in our core values of Excellence and Intensity, we act as elite technical advisors to our commercial clients. By joining this high-performance team, you will champion a culture of candid communication and excellence while accelerating global adoption of our AI-Powered Process Automation platform.

As a Principal Consultant, you will occupy a leadership position at the intersection of enterprise business strategy and complex technical delivery. This role matters now more than ever because you won't just execute projects - you will define the client experience and how they are delivered. You will partner directly with Appian Architects and Technical Delivery Managers, lead large-scale consulting initiatives, and serve as a vital mentor to the next generation of engineers, ensuring our clients achieve world-class Enterprise-Grade Orchestration.

This role is based at our HQ in McLean, VA. Appian was built on a culture of in-person collaboration, which we believe is a key driver of our mission to be the best. Employees hired for this position are expected to be in the office 4 - 5 days per week to foster that culture, ensure we thrive through shared ideas and teamwork, and maximize opportunities to connect with the exceptional people across Appian. While working in-person with customers is our main priority, we also believe the office environment enables more opportunities to celebrate wins, collaborate effectively, and build strong relationships across teams.

What You’ll Do

• Lead Enterprise Delivery: Command the entire project lifecycle to define, design, and implement custom automation solutions using the Appian platform for major commercial clients.

• Direct High-Performing Teams: Lead and mentor consultants through fast-paced software implementations, instilling a dedication to going "beyond completion."

• Partner with Leadership: Collaborate directly with Appian Architects and Technical Delivery Managers to design resilient, scalable, and secure system architectures.

• Architect Complex Integrations: Build secure, high-throughput APIs to seamlessly connect multiple external enterprise environments using REST, SOAP, and JDBC connections.

• Data Infrastructures: Oversee the creation and production launch of advanced relational data models and sophisticated SQL database designs.

• Drive Client Self-Sufficiency: Collaborate with client executives and technical stakeholders to drive deep platform adoption and empower them to build process applications independently.

Basic Qualifications

• Degree: Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Experience: 8+ years of hands-on experience in software development or technical implementation consulting.

• Team Leadership: Experience leading technical teams and a passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent.

• Core Engineering: Strong foundational grasp of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), database design, data modeling, and SQL (queries, joins, views).

• Travel: Willingness to travel up to 20% to support vital customer engagements.

• US Citizenship: Candidates being considered for a Public Sector roles must be a U.S. Citizen

• Experience with enterprise acquisition or procurement solutions

Preferred Qualifications

• Mastery of modern cloud computing ecosystems, specifically Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud, or Elastic Containers.

• Deep technical knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning, automated test suites (Test-Driven Development), and continuous integration frameworks.

The base salary range provided represents a good faith and reasonable estimate of the range at the time of posting. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a government clearance differential. Actual compensation will be dependent on a number of factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant work experience, qualifications, internal peer equity, and market and business conditions that exist when extending an offer. A discretionary bonus may be awarded in recognition of individual and company performance.

In addition, Appian provides generous benefits offerings that include a 401(k) plan with company match, flexible time off, paid parental leave, medical, dental, and vision plans, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness programs, flexible spending accounts, health savings account contributions, an employee referral bonus program, and learning and development resources. Certain positions may be eligible for equity awards.

Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation, commission, bonus, or benefit plans.

Base Salary Range

$100,000—$225,000 USD

Tools and Resources

• Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.

• Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.

• Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

Benefits

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. About Appian

Appian provides AI automation for the most important business processes at the world’s largest organizations. Our platform is known for its unique power, reliability, and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and have proven expertise in enterprise operations. For more information, visit appian.com.

Follow Appian: LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and X.

Appian is an equal opportunity employer that strives to attract and retain the best talent. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Appian provides reasonable accommodations to applicants in accordance with all applicable laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at ReasonableAccommodations@appian.com. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.

jobs.title: Director, In Vivo Pharmacology and Disease Biology
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY
Prolynx is a preclinical biotechnology company with a vision to become the industry leader in ultra-long-acting medicines that improve outcomes for patients with obesity, cardiometabolic, and other diseases. The company is developing a next-generation portfolio of incretin and non-incretin therapeutics designed for once-monthly and once-quarterly dosing. Its proprietary, first-in-category platform uses a hydrogel-based microsphere technology with independently tunable release-linker chemistry to enable highly predictable pharmacokinetics and sustained drug exposure. Prolynx is backed by leading investors including 5AM Ventures, OrbiMed, and Monograph Capital and is based in Emeryville, CA.
Join a multidisciplinary team of talented scientists developing innovative and differentiated medicines - where we pursue purposeful science and let data and patient needs drive decisions.  Prolynx provides an environment where you work, learn, and grow alongside experienced drug developers, inventive scientists, and business professionals.  Bring your passion, creativity, and energy to our mission. At Prolynx, contributions are valued regardless of title, people are trusted to own their area of expertise, and teammates readily step in to help one another. We share what we know and succeed together. If that sounds like the place for you, we’d like to meet you.
The Role
We are seeking an experienced scientific leader to build and direct our In Vivo Pharmacology and Disease Biology function. In this newly created role, you will set the strategic direction for in vivo pharmacology across the portfolio, lead / manage a network of CRO partnerships with an opportunity, over time, to build an internal team.  As a member of the Preclinical Leadership Team, you will serve as a senior scientific voice shaping program strategy, resourcing and go/no-go decisions alongside the Chief Scientific Officer and other functional leaders.
You will design and validate disease-relevant animal models in mice, rats and non-human primates (NHPs) to test, rank, and characterize innovative sustained release therapies.  You will demonstrate the efficacy across full monthly or quarterly dosing intervals, define the exposure-response relationships to enable human dose projections and ascertain the impact on the molecular disease pathobiology of the indications being studied.  The candidate will assess the impact of our novel and differentiated therapies on disease comorbidities and biomarkers; and, has demonstrated experience in rigorous data analysis, interpreting and writing pharmacology reports and authoring the preclinical / pharmacology sections of IND submissions and other regulatory documents as programs move from lead selection through candidate nomination and into the clinic.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager II, Axon 911
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

About Axon 911

Axon 911 brings together Prepared and Carbyne under Axon. Together, we are creating the only platform that combines modern 911 infrastructure with an AI intelligence layer—helping public safety agencies move faster, make better decisions, and deliver better outcomes in the moments that matter most.

911 is the backbone of public safety, yet the professionals behind it have long been held back by outdated technology. Axon 911 is here to change that. Joining this team means more than taking a job—it means helping shape the future of emergency response and building a safer, more connected world.

Position Overview

As a Senior Product Manager II at Axon 911, your mission is to achieve “The Perfect Response”. This means, we will be step by step through emergency response today, identify where there are gaps that lead to unnecessary loss of life or ‘unforced errors’, ideate on how to solve those challenges — either creating a product that fixes the issue OR create a new workflow/system that preventing that issue from even being possible.

You will be in charge of large, cross-functional initiatives that push the boundaries of communication and data-sharing for 911 telecommunicators, dispatchers, and responders. Specifically, you will:

• Be your domain’s CEO: Do whatever it takes to get the mission accomplished — identify the summit we want to climb in your division, identify the limiting factor, ruthlessly prioritize against that limiting factor, and make meaningful strides towards the perfect response.

• Lead Major Cross-Functional Projects: Plan and deliver complex features/products impacting multiple customer personas (field responders, 911 calltakers, 911 dispatchers, etc). Define clear goals, align teams on product vision, and ensure consistent, high-impact delivery.

• Shape and Communicate Roadmaps: Establish product roadmaps that reflect company strategy, balancing competing priorities and securing stakeholder buy-in. Keep diverse teams focused on delivering outcomes that advance our mission.

• Champion Deep Customer Understanding & Relationships: Conduct extensive customer research — go onsite for ridealongs in field responder vehicles, or sit-alongs in 911 centers. Develop deep relationships with emergency responders, conduct and synthesize extensive user research. Showcase the better future we are building, and rally to make that change a reality in the world. You will embed empathy and real-world needs into every decision.

• Facilitate Stakeholder Alignment: Influence through clear articulation of the product vision, reconciling conflicting priorities and securing organizational commitment to drive large-scale projects forward.

• Mentor and Develop PM Talent: Provide structured guidance to other product managers, sharing insights and lessons learned to enhance collective knowledge and leadership capabilities.

• Drive Complex Initiatives: Tackle project blockers decisively, balancing speed with strategic impact. Keep cross-functional teams aligned on objectives and deliver on high-stakes deadlines.

Please note: This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of four days per week in our Manhattan office.

What Makes You a Great Fit

• Extensive Product Management Expertise: You bring 5+ years of experience delivering large-scale, cross-functional projects in B2B or B2G SaaS environments, either building 0-to-1 products or scaling deeply technical products from 1→100.

• Creativity: You are truly creative in your approach to developing new technologies. You do not just think 1+, you always look for the 10x in every situation and how to turn the problem upside down.

• Technical Acumen: You’re adept at collaborating with engineering teams, translating high-level vision and product goals into actionable technical requirements.

• Strategic Mindset: You excel at weaving market research, user feedback, and data analysis into coherent strategies that position products as market leaders.

• Leadership & Collaboration: You have a proven record of building alignment across engineering, design, sales, and marketing teams, ensuring everyone is working toward a unified goal. This is no easy feat.

• Adaptability & Growth Orientation: You thrive in rapidly changing environments, continuously iterating based on market and user feedback.

• Self-Driven & Empathetic: You are you driven. You proactively identify opportunities. You do not wait. You inspire teams. You keep the customer’s needs at the heart of every decision.

There are few jobs that will have as direct of an impact on people’s lives. The products you develop here will directly save people’s lives every day across the 1000 cities Axon 911 works with. Join Axon 911 and shape the future of public safety.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Development Programs

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers.

Base Pay Range

$162,150—$216,200 USD

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com.  Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert:  Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process.  All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers.  If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not @axon.com, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

• Be your domain’s CEO: Do whatever it takes to get the mission accomplished — identify the summit we want to climb in your division, identify the limiting factor, ruthlessly prioritize against that limiting factor, and make meaningful strides towards the perfect response.

• Lead Major Cross-Functional Projects: Plan and deliver complex features/products impacting multiple customer personas (field responders, 911 calltakers, 911 dispatchers, etc). Define clear goals, align teams on product vision, and ensure consistent, high-impact delivery.

• Shape and Communicate Roadmaps: Establish product roadmaps that reflect company strategy, balancing competing priorities and securing stakeholder buy-in. Keep diverse teams focused on delivering outcomes that advance our mission.

• Champion Deep Customer Understanding & Relationships: Conduct extensive customer research — go onsite for ridealongs in field responder vehicles, or sit-alongs in 911 centers. Develop deep relationships with emergency responders, conduct and synthesize extensive user research. Showcase the better future we are building, and rally to make that change a reality in the world. You will embed empathy and real-world needs into every decision.

• Facilitate Stakeholder Alignment: Influence through clear articulation of the product vision, reconciling conflicting priorities and securing organizational commitment to drive large-scale projects forward.

• Mentor and Develop PM Talent: Provide structured guidance to other product managers, sharing insights and lessons learned to enhance collective knowledge and leadership capabilities.

• Drive Complex Initiatives: Tackle project blockers decisively, balancing speed with strategic impact. Keep cross-functional teams aligned on objectives and deliver on high-stakes deadlines.

Please note: This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of four days per week in our Manhattan office.

What Makes You a Great Fit

• Extensive Product Management Expertise: You bring 3+ years of experience delivering large-scale, cross-functional projects in B2B or B2G SaaS environments, either building 0-to-1 products or scaling deeply technical products from 1→100.

• Creativity: You are truly creative in your approach to developing new technologies. You do not just think 1+, you always look for the 10x in every situation and how to turn the problem upside down.

• Technical Acumen: You’re adept at collaborating with engineering teams, translating high-level vision and product goals into actionable technical requirements.

• Strategic Mindset: You excel at weaving market research, user feedback, and data analysis into coherent strategies that position products as market leaders.

• Leadership & Collaboration: You have a proven record of building alignment across engineering, design, sales, and marketing teams, ensuring everyone is working toward a unified goal. This is no easy feat.

• Adaptability & Growth Orientation: You thrive in rapidly changing environments, continuously iterating based on market and user feedback.

• Self-Driven & Empathetic: You are you driven. You proactively identify opportunities. You do not wait. You inspire teams. You keep the customer’s needs at the heart of every decision.

There are few jobs that will have as direct of an impact on people’s lives. The products you develop here will directly save people’s lives every day across the 1000 cities Axon 911 works with. Join Axon 911 and shape the future of public safety.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Development Programs

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. $150,938—$201,250 USD
