jobs.title: Sr. Revenue Enablement Manager, Partnerships & Supply
jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Your Mission:

As Revenue Enablement Manager, Partnership & Supply, you'll be the dedicated enablement partner for the teams that build and grow Engine's relationships with hotel and lodging partners. Our supply is a core part of what makes Engine work, and these teams keep it strong. New-hire onboarding is owned by a partner team. You own everything after it: ongoing enablement and everboarding that help partner and supply teams sign, activate, and grow partners. You'll report to the Manager, Revenue Enablement once that role is filled, and to the Director of Revenue Enablement until then. Here's what you'll take charge of:

Own Partnership & Supply Enablement

• Everboarding Programs: Plan, build, and deliver training after onboarding for partner and supply teams, including skill-building paths, refreshers, and certifications on Engine's partner value proposition, programs, and processes.

• Partner Sales Motion: Build and maintain the certification programs, training, job aids, and playbooks behind our partner sales motion, covering areas such as partner acquisition, negotiation, activation, and growing existing partner relationships.

• Content & Knowledge Management: Keep partner and supply documentation, playbooks, and knowledge resources current and easy to find.

• Onboarding Alignment: Partner with the onboarding team so what's learned in onboarding carries through once reps are ramped.

• AI-First Enablement: Build AI first. Use AI to create partner certifications, job aids, playbooks, and knowledge resources at scale, and keep them current as programs and processes change.

Partner with the Partnership & Supply Business

• Know the Supply Business: Build a deep understanding of how the partner and supply teams work, what partners need, what the teams are measured on, and what's changing in the lodging market.

• Embedded Partnership: Spend regular time with partner and supply leaders, front-line managers, and reps. Join team meetings and pipeline reviews to understand needs and turn them into enablement that improves performance.

• Rollout Support: Partner with Product, Growth, Revenue Operations, and the broader Revenue Enablement team to communicate and train on launches, process changes, and tool updates, freeing leaders to coach and sell.

Programs & Measurement

• Measure What Matters: Track and report enablement impact for partner and supply teams, such as certification and program adoption, partner acquisition and activation, pipeline and conversion, and partner growth [TBD: confirm Partnership & Supply KPIs].

• Performance Inspection: Drive results through inspection, evaluation, and accountability on the skills and playbooks you design.

• Enablement Tech Stack: Make sure partner and supply teams get full value from our tools, including partner tools [TBD: confirm, e.g., PRM, Crossbeam]. Work with our tools and systems team so new tools actually get adopted.

Why This Role: AI-First at Engine
At Engine, AI isn't a side project. It's how we work. Our access to create with AI is incredibly unique, and this role is a rare chance to get exposure to a ton of AI tools and learn from the best. The expectation is simple: AI first, to create scale, so our partner and supply teams always have what they need to win. Building this way grows Engine, and it grows your skill set too. If you're growth-minded and excited to build what's next, you'll thrive here.

What You'll Bring to Engine:
We're looking for someone who's ready to make an impact and grow alongside us:

• Experience: 4+ years in revenue enablement, sales enablement, sales training, or a customer-facing revenue role, including 2+ years designing and delivering enablement or training programs. [TBD: confirm years]

• Partner & Supply Familiarity: Experience enabling or working on partnerships, supplier or channel teams, or account management, ideally in travel, hospitality, or a two-sided marketplace.

• Facilitation: You can lead a room, in person or virtually, and you can turn complex programs and processes into training people actually use.

• Business Acumen: You learn new business models quickly and can turn pipeline and performance data into a focused training or coaching response.

• Skills: Strong project management, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, and you can influence across Sales, Product, Growth, and Revenue Operations.

• Tech-Savvy: Bonus points if you're fluent in Salesforce, conversation intelligence tools (e.g., Momentum), enablement/LMS platforms (e.g., GTMBuddy, LetterAI), and partner tools such as PRM platforms or Crossbeam.

• AI-First Mindset: You reach for AI first to create scale, and you're excited to get hands-on with a wide range of AI tools. You're growth-minded and eager to keep building your skill set.

• Mindset: You're ready to roll up your sleeves, work independently, and deliver results that matter.

Nice to Have:

• Hands-on experience in hotel or lodging partnerships, supplier relations, revenue management, or OTA market management.

• Background in B2B travel, hospitality, or marketplace businesses.

• Experience building enablement for a new sales motion from scratch.

• Examples of enablement content, job aids, or knowledge resources you've built with AI.

Location & Travel:
This role is preferably based in or near one of our hubs in Denver, CO; Tempe, AZ; or Chicago, IL, and we're open to remote candidates elsewhere in the US. Expect to travel about one week per month to work with teams in person, plus major company events.

We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range

$115,600—$160,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

• Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.

• Benefits: Check out our full list at engine.com/culture

• Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

jobs.title: Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician (Shift Lead, Overnights) - Larkspur, CA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, and the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a Veterinary Technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation $30-$62, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Mission Success Manager
jobs.description:
Second Front Systems is looking for a customer-focused, mission-driven, high-agency Mission Success Manager to strengthen our Mission Success team.

Operating at the frontline of the Second Front customer journey, you will be responsible for your customers' success, guiding their experience from the moment they sign with Second Front, through kickoff, implementation, authorization, steady-state support, and renewal.

You will serve as the dedicated primary point of contact for a portfolio of commercial customers deploying on Game Warden, and the daily connective tissue between customers, engineering, security, and product, ensuring that your customers achieve authorization, and secure deployment of their SaaS solutions.

As a key partner to essentially every function within the Second Front ecosystem, you will be the core connective tissue between those teams and our customers, serving as not just critical link to them but also to the missions that our customers support.



Note: Candidates must reside in one of our approved hiring hubs:
• DC/Maryland/Virginia
• Denver/Colorado Springs, CO


What You'll Do
• Build deep relationships with customer technical and executive teams.
• Lead customer kickoffs, onboarding, regular syncs, and Quarterly Business Reviews.
• Own high-severity technical escalations. Coordinate cross-functional resolution with support and engineering teams.
• Navigate customers through technical implementation, the Authority to Operate / FedRAMP compliance processes.
• Own renewal and upsell opportunities to secure contract expansion and revenue retention.
• Synchronize feedback from deployed customers into product roadmap recommendations.



What You Bring
• 5+ years in customer/mission success, technical delivery, or related role, preferably supporting PaaS or cloud infrastructure in government contracts.
• Direct experience working in or supporting Department of War (DoW) missions or Federal Civilian agencies.

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Sparkfund

Sparkfund is the utility services company unlocking capacity on the grid. Through its Distributed Capacity Procurement (DCP) model, Sparkfund enables utilities, energy majors, and large-load customers to deploy front-of-the-meter batteries and gensets as distribution infrastructure. By adding targeted capacity exactly where and when the grid needs it most, DCP helps meet demand, support reliability, and put downward pressure on rates. Sparkfund supports program design, grid value assessment, asset host engagement, and value chain management to ensure on-time, on-budget deployment with maximum system value and lowest cost.

With more than 3,200 projects deployed across 43 states and more than 300MW of energized assets constructed, Sparkfund is transforming customer-sited assets into a valuable portfolio resource for the benefit of our society. To learn more about Sparkfund, visit sparkfund.com.

Integrated Marketing Manager

Location: Remote (U.S.-Based)
Department: Marketing & Communications
Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt
Travel: Approximately 10–20%

About the Role

Sparkfund pioneered Distributed Capacity Procurement (DCP) and is working to establish distributed capacity as a new category for how utilities grow the grid. We’re looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to help tell that story, turning our team’s expertise into content that shows up in the feed and on stage.

Reporting to the VP of Marketing & Communications and working closely with the Director of Creative & Marketing Strategy, this role builds and runs Sparkfund’s content and events programs and coordinates marketing across paid, earned, shared, and owned channels.

You’ll partner with technical experts and business leaders to activate and share their expertise across industry events, webinars, panels, white papers, blogs, and more, educating the market on distributed capacity and the DCP model.

The ideal candidate is a strong writer, a content expert, and an experienced integrated marketer who enjoys managing multiple initiatives and turning ideas into results.

As Sparkfund scales in the distributed capacity market, we’re expanding our thought leadership, with content and events as the foundation and room to grow from there.

How We Work at Sparkfund

Our values shape how we work, make decisions, and show up for our customers and each other. They are also part of how we evaluate success at Sparkfund.

Excellence

We hold ourselves to high standards and continuously look for ways to improve.

In this role, Excellence means producing thoughtful, accurate, and compelling content, delivering well-organized events, maintaining consistent brand standards, and continuously improving how we communicate with our audiences.

Stewardship

We take ownership, follow through on our commitments, and make thoughtful decisions with the long term in mind.

In this role, Stewardship means managing marketing resources, budgets, timelines, and relationships responsibly while ensuring our content and events create meaningful value for Sparkfund and its stakeholders.

Positivity

We approach challenges constructively, assume positive intent, support one another, and bring solutions.

In this role, Positivity means working collaboratively with subject matter experts, executives, and teammates, approaching competing priorities with flexibility, and bringing creativity and a solutions-oriented mindset to our work.

What You'll Do

Content Development & Thought Leadership

• Execute Sparkfund's content strategy by developing engaging blogs, articles, white papers, case studies, infographics, talking points, and other marketing materials.

• Partner with internal subject matter experts and executives to translate technical expertise into compelling thought leadership that educates the market on distributed capacity and Sparkfund's DCP model.

• Develop presentations, briefing materials, speaker decks, and talking points for conferences, industry engagements, and media opportunities.

• Create and maintain sales enablement materials, including program collateral, case studies, one-pagers, and proposal content supporting utility and large-load customer conversations.

• Manage the content calendar and asset library, ensuring materials are accurate, on-brand, and delivered on schedule.

• Publish and maintain website content while incorporating search engine optimization (SEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) practices.

Integrated Marketing & Events

• Coordinate marketing execution across paid, earned, shared, and owned channels, including digital, website, social media, email, and public relations.

• Manage Sparkfund's industry event presence, including conferences, sponsorships, speaking engagements, and related logistics.

• Identify and pursue speaking opportunities for company leaders and subject matter experts, including conference sessions, panels, and industry presentations.

• Coordinate speaker submissions, preparation, presentations, schedules, and on-site event support.

• Maintain the company events and industry organization calendar, ensuring activities align with marketing priorities.

• Manage event-related budgets, vendors, timelines, and deliverables.

• Help transition agency-supported content and event activities in-house by establishing scalable processes and repeatable workflows.

• Track and report on content and event performance, identifying opportunities to improve reach, engagement, and overall effectiveness.

Program Marketing & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with the Director of Creative & Marketing Strategy to develop and maintain program marketing materials that support customer and partner engagement.

• Create and update program explainers, training presentations, co-branded materials, and prospect-facing collateral.

• Coordinate with internal teams, freelance vendors, and external partners to manage content production, timelines, and reviews.

• Ensure consistent messaging, brand alignment, and coordination across marketing initiatives.

• Collaborate with Commercialization, Program Management, and other teams to ensure marketing activities support broader business objectives.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in integrated marketing, content marketing, multichannel marketing, or a related discipline.

• Experience in B2B marketing, particularly with utilities, government organizations, or large enterprise customers.

• Strong writing, editing, and content development skills, with the ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, compelling messaging.

• Experience coordinating marketing activities across multiple channels, including content, digital, social media, email, events, or public relations.

• Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate across teams and communicate effectively with senior leaders, technical experts, and external partners.

• Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and adapt to changing business needs in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

• Agency experience in marketing, communications, or public relations.

• Experience in the energy, utilities, or infrastructure industries.

• Experience developing thought leadership content with executives and technical subject matter experts.

• Hands-on experience coordinating conferences, sponsorships, speaking engagements, and industry events.

• Familiarity with HubSpot or similar marketing platforms and content management systems.

• Experience with SEO, GEO, and digital content performance measurement.

• Experience using AI-powered content development, marketing, or productivity tools.

• Familiarity with grid modernization, utility resource planning, or distribution-grid technologies.

What Will Help You Succeed

Content Development & Storytelling

You know how to turn complex information into clear, engaging content that resonates with different audiences. You're comfortable interviewing subject matter experts, identifying the most important messages, and producing content that is both technically accurate and accessible.

Integrated Marketing Execution

You understand how content, events, digital channels, and campaigns work together. You can manage calendars, coordinate multiple initiatives, and ensure marketing activities are aligned, consistent, and delivered on time.

Event & Project Management

You're organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning events and projects from planning through execution. You anticipate needs, manage logistics, communicate proactively, and follow through on commitments.

Relationship Management & Collaboration

You build strong working relationships with executives, technical experts, colleagues, and external partners. You know how to bring people together, manage expectations, and keep projects moving without needing direct authority.

Ownership & Accountability

You're comfortable taking responsibility for your work, making day-to-day decisions, and identifying when additional input or guidance is needed. You take pride in delivering quality results and continuously improving processes.

Intellectual Curiosity & Adaptability

You're eager to learn, particularly when working with new technologies, industries, or complex subjects. You enjoy a growing organization where priorities evolve, new opportunities emerge, and you have the ability to help build better ways of working.

Compensation

The expected base salary range for this position is 107,000–137,200 annually, based on experience, qualifications, geographic considerations, and internal alignment.

Where applicable, this position may also be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Any such compensation is separate from base salary and is not guaranteed. Eligibility, amounts, and payment are subject to applicable plan terms, company performance, individual performance, and other business considerations.

Benefits

Sparkfund offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

• Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with a 2% employer match

• Flexible vacation policy

• Paid federal holidays

• Flexible Fridays, (half-day Fridays every week)

• 12 weeks of gender-neutral paid caregiver leave

• One-time work-from-home stipend for eligible remote roles

• Monthly phone and internet allowance

Work Environment

Sparkfund is a remote-first company with emerging hub offices in Denver, Minneapolis, and Washington, DC.

This position is fully remote within the United States, with occasional travel of approximately 10–20% to utility partner locations, company gatherings, conferences, and industry events.

The role requires the ability to work in a standard remote office environment and periodically support in-person events, which may involve extended periods of standing and light lifting of event materials.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Sparkfund is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Sparkfund also provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, in all phases of the hiring process and throughout employment. If you need an accommodation, please let us know.

Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties, responsibilities, and requirements may change at any time based on business needs. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply — even if you do not meet every listed qualification — as skills and competencies can develop in different ways.

jobs.title: Center-Based Behavior Technician
jobs.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. We will provide comprehensive training so that you are equipped and empowered to help each child, even if you don’t currently have experience. Children can be unpredictable and potentially confrontational, so this role is not for the weak of spirit, mind, or body. Part of the joy of working with kids is exercise! Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds.

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

Pay Range: $18-24

• Passionate about helping children with autism

jobs.title: Director / Senior Director, Toxicology
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY
Prolynx is a preclinical biotechnology company with a vision to become the industry leader in ultra-long-acting medicines that improve outcomes for patients with obesity, cardiometabolic, and other diseases. The company is developing a next-generation portfolio of incretin and non-incretin therapeutics designed for once-monthly and once-quarterly dosing. Its proprietary, first-in-category platform uses a hydrogel-based microsphere technology with independently tunable release-linker chemistry to enable highly predictable pharmacokinetics and sustained drug exposure. Prolynx is backed by leading investors including 5AM Ventures, OrbiMed, and Monograph Capital and is based in Emeryville, CA.
Join a multidisciplinary team of talented scientists developing innovative and differentiated medicines - where we pursue purposeful science and let data and patient needs drive decisions.  Prolynx provides an environment where you work, learn, and grow alongside experienced drug developers, inventive scientists, and business professionals.  Bring your passion, creativity, and energy to our mission. At Prolynx, contributions are valued regardless of title, people are trusted to own their area of expertise, and teammates readily step in to help one another. We share what we know and succeed together. If that sounds like the place for you, we’d like to meet you.
THE ROLE
We are seeking an experienced leader in toxicology to build and direct nonclinical safety strategy as Prolynx advances its ultra-long-acting, hydrogel-based conjugate therapeutics toward and through the clinic. You will lead the toxicology function and address needs across the portfolio, addressing systemic safety of peptide payloads, and you serving as the primary nonclinical safety voice on program teams, with regulatory agencies, and with senior leadership.
Prolynx has an efficient, outsourced model for nonclinical safety. You will lead a global network of toxicology CROs and work hand in hand with expert nonclinical consulting partners to design, execute, and monitor critical studies.  You will author reports and regulatory documents, ensure that all studies are designed well, conducted to GLP standards, and accepted by regulators. As a member of the Preclinical Leadership Team, you will serve as a senior scientific voice shaping program strategy, resourcing and go/no-go decisions alongside the Chief Scientific Officer and other functional leaders.

jobs.title: Vice President, Creative Strategy (Social Media)
jobs.description:
ABOUT ORCHESTRA

Orchestra is a strategic communications and marketing company built for today’s complex and fragmented world. From decoding audiences to designing bold strategies, Orchestra integrates people, platforms, and stories that stick to help clients build lasting influence. The company offers programs that span from the highest level strategic business counsel through to tactical execution. Orchestra brings together 700+ people with experience across consumer and lifestyle, technology, nonprofit and philanthropy, real estate, sports, travel, hospitality, and more. Made up of leading firms BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communications professionals, and Versus Media Group, a strategy-first political media team. Learn more at www.orchestraco.com.

People of all backgrounds and abilities are strongly encouraged to apply. Orchestra is committed to building and maintaining a diverse staff, and recognizes that its continued success depends on hiring and retaining high-quality creative professionals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Opportunities for advancement exist, and we are committed to helping all staff develop and grow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Orchestra is seeking a Vice President, Creative Strategy (Social Media) to lead the development of social-first strategies and campaigns that help consumer brands earn attention, participate meaningfully in culture, and connect with audiences. This individual will turn social behavior, audience insights, cultural shifts, platform dynamics, and business objectives into clear strategic direction and ideas built to resonate in social environments.

This individual will serve as both senior strategic leader and hands-on practitioner — establishing how social-first strategy shows up in our work while personally leading research, uncovering insights, developing strategic narratives, writing briefs, and building and presenting strategies. This role is designed for someone who understands that social is more than a distribution channel; it is where audiences participate in culture, form communities, influence one another, and increasingly shape how brands earn relevance.

While social will be the starting point, the work will extend beyond it. This individual will collaborate cross-functionally across Orchestra's agencies and teams to turn social and cultural insights into ideas that can travel across earned media, influencer partnerships, experiential, and other brand touchpoints.

Role location: This role will ideally be based in our NYC our office.

ACCOUNTABILITIES & QUALIFICATIONS

As the Vice President, Creative Strategy, you will:

• Lead the development of social-first brand, content, channel, and campaign strategies rooted in audience behavior, cultural insight, platform dynamics, performance data, and client business objectives

• Personally lead the strategic process from research through recommendation.

• Translate how people behave, communicate, discover, share, and participate across social platforms into actionable insights and opportunities for brands

• Define the strategic architecture behind social-first campaigns, including audience, brand role, cultural opportunity, channel roles, content territories, and creator and community opportunities

• Serve as a senior strategic counselor to clients, bringing proactive points of view on social and culture, challenging assumptions, and identifying opportunities for brands to show up in more relevant and distinctive ways

• Turn social and cultural insights into campaign territories and ideas, partnering across communications, influencer, experiential, account, and production teams to bring them to life across channels

• Lead and participate in brainstorms, bringing audience, cultural, community, creator, and platform intelligence that opens up unexpected opportunities for brands

• Pressure-test campaign concepts against both the strategy and the realities of social behavior, ensuring ideas feel native to the platforms and communities where they will live rather than adapted for social after the fact

• Maintain a consistent pulse on emerging platforms, communities, creators, behaviors, and internet culture, translating shifts into meaningful implications and opportunities for clients

• Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks for social-first campaigns, using performance and audience response to identify strategic learnings and evolve recommendations over time

• Play a senior role in new business, helping diagnose client challenges and developing the insights, strategic narratives, and campaign territories that support winning pitches

• Establish the frameworks, tools, and standards for social-first strategy as a growing capability across Orchestra, while helping teams strengthen how social behavior, audience insight, and culture inform their work

What you bring:

• A strategist's ability to see the bigger picture and a practitioner's willingness to personally dig into the research, find the insight, build the strategy, and develop the idea

• Deep understanding of audiences, social behavior, and culture, with sharp instincts for distinguishing an observation or trend from a true insight

• A track record of developing strategies that have shaped breakthrough, culturally relevant campaigns for major consumer brands

• Strong fluency across social platforms, creators, communities, earned media, and culture, with an understanding of how social-first ideas can travel beyond social

• A compelling storytelling ability, turning complex research, data, cultural observations, and business challenges into clear and persuasive strategic narratives

• Executive-level client presence and the confidence to challenge assumptions, navigate ambiguity, and counsel senior stakeholders

• A collaborative, entrepreneurial approach and excitement for building a new capability while remaining hands-on in the work

Essential skills:

• 10+ years of experience in social strategy, brand strategy, cultural strategy, or a related discipline, with significant experience in a social, communications, marketing, or integrated agency environment

• Demonstrated experience independently leading social-first strategy for major consumer brands, from research and insight development through strategic recommendation, ideation, and client presentation

• Deep experience with social listening, audience research, cultural analysis, competitive intelligence, trend forecasting, and qualitative and quantitative research methodologies

• Proven ability to develop strategic frameworks, narratives, and briefs that connect audience and cultural insights to business objectives and campaign opportunities

• Deep understanding of social platforms including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, Pinterest, and emerging channels, as well as the behaviors and communities shaping how those platforms are used

• Experience developing social-first strategies and ideas that extend across creators, earned media, content, partnerships, experiential, and other brand touchpoints

• Strong experience contributing to new business, including research and insight generation, strategic development, ideation, pitch development, and presentation

• Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior clients and communicate complex strategic thinking clearly, confidently, and persuasively

• Strong facilitation skills, with experience leading strategic working sessions, brainstorms, and cross-functional teams through ambiguous challenges

• Ability to operate as both strategist and executor, setting direction while also rolling up sleeves to research, write, build, and deliver

• Extremely strong presentation, written communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills

WORKING AT ORCHESTRA

Salary range (commensurate with experience and skills): $163,000 + bonus potential

Orchestra is the first communications company built for today’s media landscape. Since 2022, it’s acquired nine firms, including: BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communication professionals. Learn more at: www.orchestraco.com.

By providing your information, you are consenting to allow us and our subsidiaries to keep your information on file and to contact you regarding job opportunities, recruitment events and other related updates.

jobs.title: Sr. UI Engineer, Front End
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Sr. UI Engineer to help us make specialty medications more accessible and affordable for patients. Keep reading to learn more about the role, our team and why House Rx is the right next step in your career.

The Role

Join our Product & Engineering team as a Senior UI Engineer, a technical leader who brings delightful, accessible, and high-performance user experiences to life. You’ll shape the front-end architecture of our pharmacy management platform, partner closely with product and design, and set the standard for UI engineering excellence across the team. This is a UI-focused role, but you'll regularly work across the stack.

Our stack is React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Node.js/Express, Postgres, AWS, plus an in-house Storybook design system and TanStack Query/Zustand on the client.

What You’ll Do

• Build and ship UI. Build React applications, design-system components, and complex clinical workflows, owning performance, accessibility, and responsive behavior end to end.

• Architect the front end. Design scalable client-side architecture (state management, routing, testing, CI/CD) and define API contracts with back-end engineers so both sides evolve together.

• Raise the quality bar. Lead code reviews and automated testing, and champion semantic HTML, ARIA, modern CSS, and keyboard navigation.

• Mentor. Help junior and mid-level engineers grow through pairing, reviews, and guidance on technical decisions.

• Help shape how we build with AI. See below.

What Success Looks Like

• Day 1: You ship code to production. We release daily, and we want you in that flow from the start.

• First 30 days: You own your first project, from scoping through delivery, working with product, design, and back-end engineers.

• First 60 days: You’ve led a project end to end and are driving code reviews and raising the bar on accessibility, testing, or performance.

• First 90 days: You’ve proposed and begun executing a plan for the design system, state management, or test coverage.

Building With AI

AI is a big part of how we build. Engineers here use AI coding tools daily — Claude Code, MCP integrations into our internal systems (Linear, Slack, Figma, our data warehouse), and agentic workflows for things like code review and research

In this role you’ll:

• Use AI development tools efficiently, proficiently, and responsibly in your daily work.

• Help set practices for AI-assisted development: what to delegate, how to review generated code, and how to keep quality high at a fast release cadence.

• Help shape how the broader team adopts and uses these tools well

What We’re Looking For

Required

• 5+ years building production web applications with React and TypeScript

• Experience building or contributing to component libraries/design systems in production

• Strong responsive CSS and accessibility skills (WCAG 2.2)

• Experience with front-end performance tooling (Lighthouse, Web Vitals)

• Experience designing RESTful API interfaces and integrating them cleanly in the UI

• Comfort working across the stack (Node.js, Postgres) as part of regular, not occasional, work

• Experience using AI development tools in real work, with a clear view of their strengths and limits

• Comfort working in a remote, fast-moving environment with daily releases

Leadership & Ownership

• Experience owning a system or project end-to-end — from scoping through long-term evolution, not just a single release

• Experience leading or heavily influencing cross-functional work with product and design, including managing trade-offs between them

• Experience communicating technical decisions and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have

• Experience building UIs that handle sensitive data (HIPAA/PHI, audit trails, role-based views)

• Experience leading a design-system build or migration

• Experience writing RFCs or design docs that changed team direction

• Experience with healthcare, pharmacy, or other regulated-industry software

You don’t need a specific degree. A CS or engineering degree, or equivalent hands-on experience, works for us. If you meet most of the required list and are excited about the work, please apply.

Why House Rx

• Meaningful work. Your code directly affects whether patients can access life-saving medications.

• Autonomy. You’ll have real influence over technical strategy.

• A fast cadence. We release daily, so you’ll see your work reach users quickly.

• A supportive team. We’re collaborative, curious, and down-to-earth. Our Slack emoji and GIF collection is legitimately impressive.

Benefits

• Flexible work hours and flexible paid time off

• Generous parental leave

• Comprehensive healthcare, vision and dental benefits

• Competitive salary and equity stake

jobs.title: Senior Investment Analyst - Commercial Real Estate Finance
jobs.description:
At Northmarq, you can be part of something special. Northmarq is a unique capital markets resource for commercial real estate investors, providing our clients access to experts in debt, equity, investment sales, loan servicing, and fund management. We offer you a career path with best-in-class training, and we foster inclusive teams committed to collaboration, mentoring, and growth. At Northmarq, we will help you unlock your potential – whether you are an industry veteran or you’re just getting started. Your new career is waiting. Start something special today. Northmarq was voted by Real Estate Forum as one of The Best Places to Work in Commercial Real Estate!

Northmarq is seeking a Senior Investment Analyst to support Production Debt + Equity team in our Atlanta office. The individual will join an active and top-performing Origination Production team while providing support to the office through financial analysis and underwriting, loan request/investment report packaging, due diligence, closing, and various support functions.

Northmarq does not provide immigration sponsorship for this position. Candidates must possess unrestricted authorization to work in the U.S. for any employer, without the need for sponsorship now or in the future, to be considered for this position.

*This position is an in-office position, with an immediate start date.

Position Responsibilities:

• Underwriting – Prepare underwriting of commercial real estate properties based on historical financial statements, borrower models or projections, and market standards to determine a projected income and provide reliable valuation and loan analysis.

• Packaging - Prepare loan request packages in compliance with company guidelines and investor requirements. These reports include narrative analysis of the borrower, property, location, and market, as well as underwriting, valuation, leases/rent roll analysis, and photographs, aerials, and maps.

• Pre-closing – Compile deal-specific lists of potential lenders, coordinate and internally track lender outreach. Collect loan quotes, creating detailed quote matrices for distribution to the borrower. Manage associated Salesforce updates.

• Closing – Provide closing coordination at the direction of Managing Director or Producer, including acting as liaison with the servicing department. Responsibilities include collecting and reviewing due diligence, ordering and reviewing third party reports, and reviewing lender documentation (term sheet, commitment, loan docs, etc.) Maintaining open communication with borrowers, lenders, legal counsels, third party vendors, and internal servicing and insurance departments on an as-needed basis.

• Research & Lead Generation – At the direction of the Managing Director or Producers, provide reliable borrower, property, and market level data by using available third party and internal resources. Research will include but is not limited to ownership records, property transaction history, demographics, and sales and rent comparables. At the direction of Managing Director or Producer, conduct and sustain continuous and annual lead generation efforts, leveraging internal prospecting tools and third-party platforms.

• Client Service – At the direction of Managing Director or Producer, responsible for providing lenders, borrowers, and internal teams with a best-in-class experience by providing reliable, high-quality service in a prompt, friendly, and professional manner.

What We're Looking For:

• Minimum 2+ years of full-time financial analysis and or underwriting experience in Commercial Real Estate Capital Markets, with strong proficiency in agency CRE (Fannie/Freddie) underwriting preferred. A comprehensive understanding of various property types is also essential.

• Four-year college degree required with a major in real estate, finance, accounting, or business area preferred.

• Strong understanding of cash flow analysis and demonstrated analytical skills with the ability to calculate NOI, DSC, ROC, IRR, etc.

• Candidate must possess strong verbal communication skills – ability to interact effectively and professionally with a wide variety of internal/external parties.

• Strong Tech knowledge and skills, including in-depth expert knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) Knowledge of Salesforce, ARGUS, and InDesign software is a plus

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to multi-task while under pressure and an aptitude for problem-solving

• Resourceful with a strong initiative and ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Strong work ethic and willingness to work extended hours when necessary

Northmarq offers a highly competitive benefits package including: medical, dental, vision, paid time off, 401K match and an annual discretionary contribution based on business performance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance, education assistance, volunteer paid time off, charitable contribution match and so much more!

Northmarq carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

About the role

Vannevar is seeking an experienced full-stack engineer to advance the design and implementation of our Decision Advantage product. This critical platform enables defense and intelligence operators to gain comprehensive situational awareness of the information environment, helping them understand and counter adversary influence operations and information warfare tactics. You will build the applications our warfighters and intelligence analysts use daily for mission-critical work, developing advanced products and features for information distillation, analysis, and visualization that enable rapid assessment of the information environment. Working alongside designers, engineers, subject matter experts, and operational users, you will transform complex intelligence requirements into intuitive, mission-ready workflows that directly support national security objectives.

In this role, you will work in a small cross-functional team focused on delivering Decision Advantage capabilities to defense customers engaged in strategic competition with near-peer adversaries. You will work on all aspects of the product - everything from data (extraction, ingestion), backend (storage, indexing, APIs), frontend, AI analysis (agents), and more. The platform has a strong foundation to build upon and there is a ton of opportunity to make an impact as we take it to the next level.

Note: this role is also open to staff+ candidates.

What you’ll do

• Design, build, and ship a cutting-edge data collection and search platform using TypeScript, React, Tailwind, and Node.js

• Partner with customers, mission owners, designers, and other engineers to understand user workflows and create 10x better solutions for their problems

• Implement and maintain search and agentic AI systems for high-scale data, both tabular and graph-shaped

• Help define and shape the future of the product

What we look for

• 5+ years of professional software development experience

• Expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, Postgres, and AWS

• Customer obsession and keen product intuition. You think in workflows and end-user experience, not just code.

Nice to have

• Active security clearance or ability to obtain one and desire to travel to visit users, collect feedback, and debug issues

• Prior experience developing AI-native products

• Prior experience working in a user-facing product role

What we offer

We’re proud to offer competitive benefits that support our employees. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• Remote friendly with WeWork access

• Unlimited PTO, shared downtime during the federal holiday calendar, and company-wide off time at the end of each year

• 401(k) match

• Lifestyle & wellbeing stipends

• Salary top-up during military reserve duty

• Fully paid parental leave

• Child and pet care reimbursement during travel

jobs.title: Sr. Director Demand Generation & Marketing Operations

jobs.title: Global Supply Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base is hiring a Global Supply Analyst to help source and manage the suppliers behind our home battery systems. You'll support sourcing from RFQ to award, build cost models, and help keep suppliers on track as we scale production. You'll work closely with senior supply managers, engineering, manufacturing, and logistics, and take on more ownership quickly.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Support RFQs end to end: gather requirements, send RFQs, compare bids, and recommend suppliers.

 - Build and maintain should-cost models and pricing benchmarks to find cost-downs and prepare for negotiations.

 - Help negotiate piece price, tooling, and payment terms, and keep contracts and agreements organized.

 - Track supplier performance on cost, quality, and delivery, and flag problems early.

 - Manage lead times, capacity, and open orders with suppliers as we ramp production.

 - Research new suppliers and market trends in your assigned categories.

 - Present clear findings and recommendations to the supply chain team and engineering partners.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - A degree in engineering, supply chain, business, or a related field.

 - 0–2 years of experience in sourcing, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or a related internship.

 - Strong Excel and data analysis skills.

 - Clear, direct written and verbal communication.

 - Strong organization, with the ability to keep many things moving at once.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities.

 - Willingness to travel domestically and internationally, about 25% of the time.




PREFERRED SKILLS

 - Internship or work experience in sourcing, procurement, or manufacturing at a hardware company.

 - Familiarity with manufacturing processes such as injection molding, sheet metal, or electronics assembly.

 - Experience with MRP or ERP systems.

 - A technical or analytical background that helps you understand how parts are made and what drives their cost.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Our supply chain team sources components, runs manufacturing operations, and builds the supplier partnerships we need to make the lowest-cost, highest-quality home batteries at scale. Homeowners across the country rely on Base for whole-home backup and lower electricity bills. Our network of home batteries also helps keep the grid stable as demand climbs from AI, electrification, and extreme weather. We build in-house and expand at a speed and cost incumbents can't match, and this team makes that possible.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description:
THE ROLE


Growth owns the systems that power our go-to-market motion: our CRM, connected to enrichment, sales engagement, outbound agents, lifecycle, routing, visitor intelligence and paid, with GTM OS, our internal platform, tying them together. We are hiring a GTM Engineer to run that motion and build the agents and data layer it depends on.



Nash builds the autonomic logistics platform: a system that senses what is happening across a network, decides what to do about it and adjusts as the results come back, without waiting to be told. Our go-to-market should run the same way. A signal comes in, an agent decides what to do with it, the rep gets the account ready to work, and every outcome writes back so the next decision is better than the last.



Most of the pieces exist. GTM OS is in production, the agents run, the stack is connected. Your job is to turn them into one reliable engine that produces pipeline, hold it to a production bar, then decide what it does next.



WHAT YOU'LL DO


 - Build and run the AI agents that work across our GTM motion: account research, signal qualification, message construction, routing and reply handling, from design through evals, rollout and the monitoring that keeps them honest

 - Build the infrastructure to run paid and ABM as one system: audiences generated from the CRM, campaigns launched and paused by rules you write, engagement flowing back into the agents, and spend tied to accounts worked and pipeline created

 - Own the account context layer every agent and campaign is grounded in: entity resolution, evidence typing, freshness and provenance, and the segment, industry, region and product rules that define our market

 - Build on GTM OS, our internal platform, and make what it can do available to sales and marketing inside the tools they already use

 - Be the technical owner of our go-to-market systems, the CRM and everything connected to it, from the data model and routing logic to the integrations and automations that keep the whole stack current and consistent

 - Own sending infrastructure and deliverability: domain strategy, warming, suppression and sender reputation across every program that sends

 - Hold the production bar: evals, observability, permissions and auditability, so the system reports its own failures before a rep finds them

 - Be measured on what the motion produces: reply and meeting rates, pipeline and revenue, cost per account worked. Agent reliability and data quality are how you get there
   
   

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - A go-to-market record: outbound, paid, ABM or lifecycle programs you ran, with the pipeline they produced and the systems you built to run them

 - Software you shipped and kept running: a service, agent or pipeline in production that other people depended on, with something we can look at

 - Outbound that scales and still reads like a person: sequences triggered by something that just changed for the buyer and tied to what we sell, reply rates to show for them, and the judgment to pull apart a message that is not landing

 - Paid media fluency: you have run budgets and built audiences, and you know which decisions should stay with a person

 - Hands-on experience applying AI to go-to-market systems: agents, LLM-based automation, MCP-style integrations, and the evals that tell you whether any of it works

 - Fluency in Python or TypeScript, and daily work with Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent, with specific opinions about where the tooling fails

 - Integration experience: you have built and debugged integrations through APIs and understand auth, rate limits, sync direction and failure modes

 - Salesforce as a developer: the data model, the API, and Apex, or the track record to pick it up fast

 - Data fluency: SQL, warehouse concepts, and the habit of tracing a data quality issue from source to destination

 - You can turn a vague request into scoped work and explain the tradeoffs


HOW TO APPLY


Send us your resume, links to things you have built and kept running (a repo, a live service, an agent, a sequence with its results), and a short note on the system or motion you are most proud of and why. If you would rather skip the cover letter, send a Loom walking us through a piece of work, or a Replit prototype of a GTM agent you would build for Nash. Both are very much encouraged.



Want to grab our attention and bypass the recruiting platform? Record a video introducing yourself at testimonials.nash.ai http://testimonials.nash.ai with code JOIN-NASH. Your application notifies us in Slack the moment it lands, and we get some much needed testing coverage on our latest Claude build :)




More about Nash http://Nash.AI


NASH IS THE PLATFORM THAT POWERS MODERN LOGISTICS.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.




WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT US

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

jobs.title: Cloud Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Dark Wolf is seeking a Cloud Systems Operation Engineer to join our team and play a crucial role in maintaining, securing, and optimizing our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. The candidate will be responsible for Tier 3 maintenance, automating routine system administration tasks, and ensuring our cloud environments remain compliant with stringent security standards. Our engineers are asked to solve challenging operational and security problems for unique customers and have a direct impact on the reliability, resilience, and security of systems used by those customers.

Key Responsibilities:

• Providing Tier 3 (T3) maintenance and advanced technical support for cloud systems and infrastructure.

• Executing monthly and emergency system patching, specifically addressing Information Assurance Vulnerability Alerts (IAVA) and Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV).

• Driving vulnerability remediation efforts across cloud environments and provide accurate, timely input for Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M).

• Ensuring continuous STIG (Security Technical Implementation Guide) compliance and oversee the creation, deployment, and management of hardened system images.

• Automating routine maintenance tasks and system/user onboarding processes to improve operational efficiency.

• Building, maintaining, and securing automated CI/CD pipelines specifically tailored for system patching and configuration management using GitLab.

• Collaborating with development and security teams to ensure patches and updates are seamlessly integrated without disrupting active services.

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of proven experience in cloud operations, cloud engineering, or a related field.

• Hands-on experience operating and managing infrastructure within Amazon Web Services (AWS).

• Experience building, maintaining, and utilizing CI/CD pipelines, specifically with GitLab.

• Proven capability in Tier 3 technical support, system troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.

• Experience applying security remediations, performing IAVA/KEV patching, and managing POA&Ms.

• Strong understanding of STIG compliance and experience working with hardened machine images.

• Experience scripting and automating routine system maintenance and administrative tasks.

• US Citizenship and an active Top Secret security clearance.

Desired Qualifications:

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation) to assist in pipeline automation.

• Familiarity with programming or scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) to enhance automation capabilities.

• Advanced AWS certifications (e.g., SysOps Administrator, DevOps Engineer).

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

The estimated salary range for this position is $90,000.00 - $150,000.00, commensurate on experience and technical skillset.

This role is field-based, with up to 85% travel nationwide, and is focused on helping dental practices adopt intraoral scanning and digital workflows with confidence.



You’ll serve as a trusted clinical advisor to clinicians, operational leaders, and executive stakeholders—helping teams adopt new technology, digital workflows, improve clinical performance, and accelerate early success. This role combines clinical training expertise with operational execution and post-training insight to deliver measurable value at the intersection of training, technology, and practice growth.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

MAP | WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses.

About WPP

MAP is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

We’re hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer to bridge marketing strategy and technical execution, building the architectures that power modern customer experiences. As the technical lead on client engagements, you’ll own end-to-end delivery from discovery and solution design to hands-on build and QA across Adobe Target, AEP, Real-Time CDP, CJA, and tag management platforms. We’re looking for someone who loves solving complex MarTech challenges, takes pride in the precision of what they build, and collaborates effortlessly with clients and teams.

What will your day look like?

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will serve as the technical lead across client engagements, bridging business strategy with hands-on technical architecture, implementation, and quality assurance. You will own complex technical workstreams end-to-end leading discovery, translating measurement and business requirements into scalable architectures across Adobe Target, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Real-Time CDP, Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), and modern tag management platforms.

• Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Lead technical discovery and requirements-gathering sessions with developers, analysts, marketers, and product teams. Document comprehensive solution designs, technical requirements, implementation approaches, and system dependencies while proactively identifying risks and limitations.

• Adobe Target & Experimentation Engineering: Build, implement, and QA A/B and multivariate tests in Adobe Target using the Visual Experience Composer (VEC), form-based activities, and custom code. Implement profile scripts, audience qualification logic, and Target Recommendations. Design measurement frameworks covering success metrics, guardrail metrics, sample size, test duration, and statistical significance.

• Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) & Real-Time CDP Architecture: Architect and work with XDM schemas and dataset ingestion pipelines. Configure streaming, edge, and batch segmentation, audience evaluation, and downstream activation. Configure the AEP Identity Service, identity namespaces, and ECIDs to ensure accurate customer profile stitching.

• AEP Web SDK Implementation: Lead hands-on implementation and configuration of Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK, datastreams, edge decisioning, and personalization. Monitor and debug network payloads and server responses to ensure accurate data flow into AEP datasets and downstream tools.

• Tag Management & Data Layer Architecture: Architect, evaluate, and implement data layer designs across Adobe Launch/Tags and Google Tag Manager (GTM). Manage and troubleshoot rule conditions, custom extensions, data elements, and tag firing.

• Full-Stack Client-Side Debugging: Trace data from the browser through the data layer, tag management, Adobe Edge/AEP, datasets, and downstream reporting or activation. Diagnose and fix complex issues involving JavaScript errors, cookies, local/session storage, identity stitching, event duplication, data loss, and reporting discrepancies.

• Client Advisory & Technical Leadership: Act as a trusted technical lead on engagements. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, present architectural recommendations, and constructively challenge requirements to balance business goals with technical feasibility and maintainability.

Who are you going to work with?

• Direct Leadership: Reports to the Engineering Director or Practice Lead, Marketing Technology & Personalization.

• Internal Capabilities: Partner closely with developers, analysts, data architects, QA engineers, and client engagement teams to deliver robust growth systems.

• Clients & Stakeholders: Interface directly with client-side developers, digital analysts, product managers, marketing leads, and technical business stakeholders.

• The Wider Network: Collaborate across specialized agency and capability teams within the broader WPP ecosystem.

What do you bring to the table?

• 4+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, web analytics, personalization, experimentation, or related technical consulting/engineering roles.

• Consulting & Agency Background: Prior client-facing, consulting, or agency experience preferred, with proven ability to lead discovery sessions, present solutions, and manage technical communication.

• Adobe Target & Experimentation:

• Deep experience building, implementing, and QA’ing A/B and multivariate tests.

• Hands-on proficiency with VEC, form-based activities, custom code activities, Target Recommendations, and profile scripts.

• Understanding of experimentation methodology (testable hypotheses, success/guardrail metrics, sample size, test duration, and statistical significance).

• Implementation familiarity via Adobe Launch/Tags, at.js, and/or AEP Web SDK.

• Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) & Real-Time CDP:

• Strong working knowledge of XDM schemas, dataset ingestion, and source/destination connections.

• Experience with streaming, edge, and batch segmentation, audience evaluation, and activation.

• In-depth understanding of the AEP Identity Service, identity namespaces, ECID, customer identifiers, and their impact on profile stitching.

• Clear understanding of event data vs. profile attributes and when each should be applied.

• AEP Web SDK Fluency:

• Hands-on implementation and troubleshooting of AEP Web SDK, datastreams, identity, decisioning, and personalization.

• Expertise troubleshooting event payloads and network requests using browser DevTools.

• Tag Management & Data Layer Design:

• Hands-on experience with Adobe Launch/Tags and Google Tag Manager (GTM).

• Deep understanding of data layer design, rule conditions, extensions, and data elements.

• Proven ability to trace data flow from the data layer through tag management into downstream analytics and marketing platforms.

• Technical & Coding Skills:

• JavaScript: Strong proficiency reading, writing, and debugging custom JavaScript.

• HTML/CSS: Comfortable building test variations and troubleshooting rendering and styling issues.

• Browser Debugging: Deep expertise troubleshooting console errors, network requests, cookies, local/session storage, and cross-browser behavior.

• End-to-End Diagnostics: Proven ability to diagnose identity issues, event duplication, data loss, audience qualification bugs, and inconsistent reporting.

A leader in personalized customer experiences

VML MAP is a world-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer-centric. Together, we are 1000 + technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55+ nationalities.

A global network

We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 60+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences.

#LI-EMEA
