jobs.title: Mental Health Associate
jobs.description:
At Rivermont Schools, we serve students with emotional, behavioral, and developmental challenges through individualized education and therapeutic support. Our values of compassion, collaboration, and growth guide everything we do. Join us in helping students achieve their highest potential.

As a Mental Health Associate with Rivermont Schools, you’ll support students with special needs by assisting with academics, daily routines, and positive behavior. This role works closely with teachers, therapists, and families to ensure consistent care and a supportive learning environment.

What You'll Need

 - High school diploma (or equivalent) and basic computer skills (Outlook, Word)

 - Strong communication, reading, writing, and documentation skills

 - Reliable, punctual, and adaptable team player

 - Patient, calm, and resilient when supporting escalated students

 - Passion for helping students with learning or behavioral differences

What You'll Do

 - Assist students with academics, social skills, and daily living needs while adapting to all age groups, from elementary through high school

 - Observe behavior, document notes, and share updates with the team to adjust strategies

 - Support self-help skills by helping students with toileting, feeding, and hygiene to promote independence

 - Use de-escalation techniques and calming strategies to maintain a supportive, structured environment

 - Partner with teachers, therapists, BCBAs, and parents to provide consistent and individualized support

Why You’ll Love Working Here

 - Enjoy both paid time off and extra paid school breaks (for select roles), plus paid holidays

 - Wellness perks including gym discounts, mindfulness apps, and prescription savings

 - Tuition reimbursement, career development programs, and leadership training

 - 401(k) retirement savings with a 4% company match and immediate vesting

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - Free Employee Assistance Program with confidential counseling, life coaching, and mental health resources

 - Life insurance, disability coverage, and Health Savings Account (HSA) contributions at no cost to you

Rivermont Schools is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at talent@newstory.com.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Growth
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




ABOUT THE ROLE

Millions of people meet UiPath for the first time through a sign-up page, a template or a first automation, and this role owns what happens next. Your job is to find out why people adopt, stick with or drop our products, then build and ship the changes that move those numbers.

This is an engineering role first. You'll write production code across our platform, from the first landing page to the moment someone publishes their first automation. You'll also do the product thinking: picking which problem to solve, defining what success looks like, and proving it with data.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Help define the growth metrics the team owns, from sign-up and trial activation through to upgrade.

 - Study product telemetry and public signals (community forums, social media, video comments) to find where users get stuck and why.

 - Turn each finding into a testable hypothesis, then build, ship and A/B test the fix yourself.

 - Work in any part of the codebase that a fix needs, rather than handing it off to another team.

 - Use AI coding agents as your team, taking ideas from concept to production quickly.

 - Explain each experiment clearly to engineering, product, design and leadership: why you ran it, what success meant, and what you learned.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Principal-level engineering experience, with recent hands-on work shipping full-stack production code (TypeScript, React and backend services, or similar).

 - An AI-native way of building: you use coding agents every day and can describe your workflow in detail.

 - A track record in growth, activation or funnel work at a product-led company, with metrics you personally moved.

 - Strong product sense: you find the problem, propose the solution and decide how to measure it, without waiting for a spec.

 - The ability to move fast with a small footprint. You've delivered real results without a large team behind you.

 - Clear written and spoken communication, including making a case to senior leaders.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Growth experience at an enterprise product-led company where self-serve users turn into business customers.

 - Experience optimizing for AI agents as users, such as agent-friendly docs, APIs and discovery.

 - A public presence: talks, posts, open source or content that developers actually read.

 - Familiarity with automation, workflow or developer-platform products.


WHY THIS ROLE

You'll be a founding engineer on a high-visibility team, working directly with senior engineering and product leaders. You'll have the freedom to act as the mini CTO of your own ideas, building on the newest parts of UiPath's agentic automation platform and reshaping how people discover and adopt it. What you ship will show up quickly in the numbers the whole company watches.

#LI-MH1

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy https://www.uipath.com/legal/trust-and-security/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry.  In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

We're growing our world-class engineering team to usher our CRM platform into the next generation of software — and we're looking for a Principal Engineer, Agentic AI to join our Core Platform Team

Most Lead roles at "Big Tech" companies involve maintaining a single microservice or acting as a small cog in a 100-person machine. At Steer, you aren't just a contributor; you are the architect of a platform aiming for 100% market dominance. This is a high-impact role for someone who doesn't just write great code, but who can see around corners, challenge conventions, and lead entire products from vision to launch.

We are actively refactoring our existing teams to be agentic-first — meaning our engineers don't just use AI as a tool, they architect systems around autonomous, AI-driven workflows. This is not a future initiative; it is how we build today.

We’re looking for builders who bring exceptional focus, ownership, and commitment to their work. At Steer, we want engineers who are “all in” on our mission, fully engaged with their work, and invested in our shared success. This means making Steer your primary professional focus and bringing the dedication and accountability needed to deliver exceptional results.

Why Steer?

• True Ownership: You will lead massive products from start to finish within lean, high-velocity teams.

• Hyper-Growth & Vision: We are currently at a fraction of our total addressable market in the automotive industry. The potential for scale is massive, and you will be a leading developer shaping this space

• Freedom to Innovate: You don't need side projects to explore new techniques. We provide the autonomy and the platform to experiment with and implement the latest tech directly into our core product.

• AI-First & Agentic Culture: We are refactoring our teams to be agentic-first. We prioritize high-level problem-solving and AI/LLM expertise, and we actively encourage the use of AI tools to accelerate coding across any language and to power autonomous production workflows.

What You’ll Do

• Technical Strategy & Ownership: Focus on the core components of the Steer CRM, specifically optimizing how we ingest and process data to revolutionize our automation tools.

• Architectural Vision: Lead the design of reusable full-stack components and services that ensure our platform remains performant as we scale toward market dominance.

• Adaptive Development: Pivot at a moment's notice based on evolving business needs, shifting focus between new integrations and core infrastructure to keep our ecosystem seamless.

• Customer-Centric Engineering: Partner closely with Product to understand user pain points, ensuring every architectural decision adds tangible value to the auto repair shops we serve.

• Code Excellence: Champion best practices in security, test automation, and maintainability. Conduct deep-dive code reviews that elevate the entire engineering organization.

• Modern DevOps & Agentic Infrastructure: Influence our CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and IaC practices. Design and maintain AI-integrated, agentic-ready infrastructure that enables autonomous workflows.

What You Have

Must Have:

• 7+ years of professional experience building complex, web-based SaaS products.

• The “All-In” Mindset: A deep commitment to Steer’s mission and success. We look for engineers who take exceptional pride in their work, hold themselves to high standards, and demonstrate full ownership and accountability for their projects. They approach complex, seemingly impossible challenges with determination, proactively drive solutions, and are committed to delivering exceptional results in a fast-paced environment.

• AI & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience working with LLMs and prompt engineering. You use AI to bridge gaps and accelerate development.

• AI in Production: Proven experience deploying AI-powered features and autonomous (agentic) workflows in production-grade infrastructure.

• AI-Driven CI/CD: Hands-on experience integrating AI tooling into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., automated code review agents, AI-assisted testing, or agentic workflow orchestration).

• Database Expertise: Proficiency with both relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases, including schema design and query optimization.

• Exceptional Communication: The ability to translate complex technical concepts into product outcomes and collaborate effectively with leadership.

Nice to Have:

• Familiarity with our current stack: .NET, Node.js (TypeScript), and React.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

• Previous experience as a founding engineer or in an early-stage startup environment.

• Experience building or integrating with Claude marketplace plugins (Anthropic ecosystem), including prompt chaining, tool use, or MCP integrations.

Interview Process

• Initial Screen — 30 min with Lead Recruiter

• Hiring Manager Interview — 60 min with the Head of Engineering & Product

• Technical Interview — 60 min with a Principal Engineer

• Collaborative Interview — 30 min with Lead Product Manager

What We Offer

• Equity Options: Own a piece of the company's success.

• 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in the US.

• 100% Employer-Paid Medical Insurance.

• Flexible PTO: With a 15-day minimum.

• FSA, HSA, and 401k options.

• Learning Stipend & WFH Equipment: Everything you need for a world-class home office.

• Innovative Culture: A seat at the table to influence the latest AI technology in a collaborative, agentic-first environment.

Why Join Steer?

At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

jobs.title: Direct Support Professional (DSP) - Harford County
jobs.description:
At Aspire Living & Learning, we don't just talk about making an impact, we live it. For more than 40 years, we've supported neurodiverse children and adults across New England and Maryland as they discover their passions, unlock their potential, and live more independently in their communities. Our person-centered services evolve with people's needs, from education and behavioral health to residential and community-based supports. We empower people to live lives shaped by their own interests, choices, and strengths. Join our collaborative, mission-driven team and bring your skills to work that makes a real difference every day.

Aspire Living & Learning is currently seeking a Direct Support Professional (DSP) to provide direct support to individuals with developmental disabilities in Harford County. The DSP will provide support with daily activities, including household chores, meal preparation, recreational activities, learning activities, and physical fitness activities. The DSP will represent the needs, wants, and interest of individuals served or supported by the program, and provide input on program planning and implementation for individuals. As part of your role, you may assist individuals with transportation to community activities, helping them build valuable life skills. Depending on program needs, transportation may involve the use of a company vehicle or, when necessary, a personal vehicle—with mileage reimbursement provided as applicable.

Rate of Pay: $18.20 per hour

Location: Harford County

Qualifications:

• Prior experience working with individuals with disabilities in a professional setting strongly preferred.

• Basic computer skills, experience using Therap a plus!

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Empathy, enthusiasm, and a passion and dedication for helping others.

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• In some locations, a valid US driver’s license and auto insurance may be required, with at least 3 years of driving experience. Access to reliable transportation is required, and some positions may require the use of a personal vehicle to transport supported individuals, depending on program needs.

Employees at Aspire enjoy working with a collaborative and dedicated team that values a culture of belonging and care. We take pride in offering a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, including:

• Comprehensive Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance - Choose from multiple medical plans, with vision coverage included at no extra cost.

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Saving Account (HSA) options - Use pre-tax dollars for medical and dependent care expenses.

• Lifestyle Spending Accounts with JOON - Monthly funds for wellness, fitness, commuting, childcare, pet care, and more.

• 403(b) Retirement Plan with Employer Match - A 100% match on contributions up to 2% of your salary.

• Generous Paid Time Off - Paid sick, personal, and vacation days, plus holidays.

• Professional Growth Opportunities - Access to training, leadership and management courses, mentorship, and career advancement.

• Employer-Paid Life & Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Telehealth Services and more!

If you want to join us in making a difference and positively impact the lives of others while charting your own path of development, then we at the Aspire team would love to hear from you.

Aspire Living & Learning believes it must play an active role in creating a community of employees that is diverse, inclusive and equitable. Our work benefits greatly from the contributions of people of color, people from working class backgrounds, women, LGBTQ people, and individuals with disabilities. Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other marginalized communities.

jobs.title: Senior Web Developer - Growth Marketing
jobs.location: United States, New York; United States, Remote
jobs.description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

The world's biggest companies come to dataiku.com to figure out how to make AI work for them. Your job is to make that experience fast, sharp, and built to convert. You’ll own the code behind dataiku.com: every component, A/B test, and tracking tag that ships goes through you.

You'll be embedded in the marketing organization: reporting to the Head of Web, part of Growth, Demand Generation & Digital Marketing, and working every day with our Web team and Designers. You'll team up with the rest of the Growth teams to find what converts. With IT and R&D, you'll ship code that meets the same standards as our product.

What you'll work on:

Build

• Product launches, events for 1,000+ attendees, interactive experiences, and campaign pages: you will own all the development of all the marketing web experiences. You'll take them from Figma to production with the web team, marketers, and design.

• Own the Contentful content model and component library: content types, validations, references, and reusable sections. Design system first, always, so marketers can build pages without breaking design, forms, tracking, or SEO.

• Ship code that's QAd and ready. You'll check it across devices, browsers, and tracking before anyone else has to.

Optimize

• Make pages fast and keep them fast. Core Web Vitals are your scoreboard.

• Build A/B tests and personalized experiences with Growth and Paid. Read the results, ship the winner, run the next one.

• Keep the technical SEO and AEO tight: structured data, redirects, hreflang, crawlability, and the files and markup that help AI systems read the site.

Measure

• Own tracking in Google Tag Manager across organic and paid, including taking over day-to-day tag maintenance from our external provider: the data layer, GA4 events, pixels, conversion APIs, and consent mode.

• Spot the broken funnel or the attribution gap before anyone asks, and come up with the fix.

Automate

• Build AI agents into the release process: code-reviews, first-pass QA, accessibility checks, and link and metadata audits, so people spend review time on judgment calls.

• Work with marketers and the growth team to embed them into agentic processes.

You are a good fit if:

• You've spent at least 4+ years in web development, ideally on marketing sites, at an agency, or on a growth team.

• You have hands-on experience managing a website in Contentful.

• You're strong in React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• You already build with AI coding tools and can show what you've shipped with them.

• You notice the 2px misalignment, and you fix it with a component, not a one-off.

• You care how fast a page loads, and you know how to make it faster.

• You've worked hands-on with GTM and GA4, or you learn tools fast and can prove it.

• You ask "what's this page for?" before "what color is the button?"

• You don't wait for a ticket. If something is broken, slow, or manual, you fix it.

• You can explain a tradeoff to a marketer, and you can say no to a launch that isn't ready.

• You have a portfolio or GitHub you're proud of.

• You're on the US East Coast (New York hybrid preferred) and happy to overlap with European mornings: the team spans Paris and the US.

Nice to have

• Next.js and Vercel.

• A/B testing or personalization tools, especially Contentful Personalization (formerly Ninetailed).

• Server-side GTM, consent management, Google Ads enhanced conversions, LinkedIn or Meta conversion APIs.

• Technical SEO and structured data.

Why you'll like it here:

• What you ship goes live fast, and you'll see it in traffic, conversion, and pipeline within weeks.

• The website is one of Dataiku's largest marketing channels, and you'll help build the in-house capability to run it, owned inside the team rather than spread across agencies.

• Your audience is the data and AI leaders at 1 in 4 of the world's top companies.

• One intake, clear priorities. Less chasing, more building.

• AI-first workflow: Claude Code and Codex for coding, and Dataiku, our own platform, for data.

• Room to grow into experimentation and analytics engineering.

• Fortune named us one of the Best Workplaces in New York.

Compensation and Benefits

The final compensation package for this role will be determined during the interview process and is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, geographic location, internal equity, education, skill set, experience and training. Eligible roles may also be entitled to receive commission or other variable compensation through Dataiku's incentive compensation program.

Dataiku also offers comprehensive benefits, including stock options, medical, dental, and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, pre-tax commuter benefits, a 401k company match, paid vacations and sick leave, paid parental leave, employer paid disability coverage, and additional health and wellbeing perks and benefits. Dataiku reserves the right to amend or modify employee perks and benefits at any time.

US only national base pay ranges

$188—$235 USD

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com

Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity

Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity here.

jobs.title: Wholesale Account Executive - Central NJ
jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we’re redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Wholesale Account Executive
Job Type: Full Time
Territory: Central NJ
The candidate in this position must be located in Central NJ, must have reliable transportation, and the ability to travel 100% of the time throughout their assigned territory

jobs.title: Account Executive, Upgrades
jobs.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry.  In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

This is a full-cycle sales role: you’ll identify opportunities in your book of customers, make outbound calls, learn how each shop operates, demonstrate the right solution, handle objections, and close upgrades to Steer CRM or our phones product.

You’ll work with repair shop owners and managers who already know Steer, but you’ll need to earn each conversation and make a clear case for why an additional product fits their business. We’re looking for someone who enjoys prospecting, takes ownership of their pipeline, and can build trust with small business owners.

The role is remote.
Compensation: $60,000 base salary; $120,000 on-target earnings (OTE), including commission.

What You’ll Do

• Proactively call and follow up with existing Steer customers to uncover opportunities for CRM and phones upgrades.

• Manage the entire sales cycle, from first outreach through discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.

• Learn each shop’s goals and current workflow, then explain how the right Steer product could help.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through consistent outreach and thoughtful follow-up.

• Keep customer conversations, opportunities, and forecasts accurate in the CRM.

• Partner with customer-facing teams to understand account history and support a smooth transition after the sale.

• Meet or exceed revenue and activity goals while providing a good experience for customers.

What You Bring

Required

• Experience owning and closing sales opportunities, ideally in a full-cycle or expansion sales role.

• Confidence making outbound calls and creating opportunities rather than relying only on inbound leads.

• Strong discovery, presentation, objection-handling, and closing skills.

• The ability to explain software in practical terms to busy small business owners.

• Organized pipeline management and consistent follow-through.

• A coachable, self-directed approach and comfort working toward a quota.

Nice to Have

• Experience selling SaaS, CRM, communications, or phone products.

• Experience growing revenue within an existing customer base.

• Familiarity with automotive repair shops or other service businesses.

Interview Process

• Initial screen — 30 minutes with Lead Recruiter

• Executive Interview — 30 minutes with Head of Sales

• Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes with Sr. Sales Manager

• Problem Solving Interview - 60 minutes with Director of People

• Reference checks

Benefits

• 100% remote

• 100% employer-paid medical insurance

• Flexible PTO with a 15-day minimum

• Generous parental leave

• FSA and HSA

• Employee Assistance Program

• 401(k)

• Learning stipend

• Work-from-home equipment

• Opportunities for career growth and development

Why Join Steer?

At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

jobs.title: Material Planner
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base is hiring a Material Planner to make sure our factories have the right parts at the right time. You'll own material planning for key components and assemblies, turn production plans and engineering changes into supply plans, and hold suppliers accountable for delivery. You'll also build the planning processes and tools we need as we scale. You'll work closely with manufacturing, engineering, procurement, quality, and finance. We want someone who knows supply chain fundamentals and wants to improve how planning works, not just run the current process.



What You'll Do

 - Own material planning for assigned components and assemblies across production, engineering builds, and ramps.

 - Turn production demand into supply plans in our ERP, balancing service levels, inventory, and cost.

 - Set and maintain planning parameters and master data so the system reflects real supplier capabilities.

 - Get materials ready for engineering changes, new parts, and product transitions while keeping obsolescence low.

 - Report clear-to-build status, material coverage, and run-out risk, and run scenarios for production and leadership.

 - Size safety stock and order quantities based on data.

 - Be the day-to-day contact for assigned suppliers: drive on-time delivery, resolve shortages, and escalate when needed.

 - Support supplier ramps for new programs and production phases.

 - Improve planning processes, tools, and reporting as we add factories and products.



What You'll Bring

 - A degree in supply chain, industrial engineering, operations, finance, or a related quantitative field.

 - 5+ years in material planning, supply chain, or manufacturing at a hardware or industrial company.

 - Strong working knowledge of MRP/ERP systems in discrete manufacturing, including BOMs, part lifecycles, and procure-to-pay.

 - Strong data analysis skills and the ability to make clear calls under tight timelines.

 - A track record of working across teams and holding suppliers to their commitments.

 - Clear, direct written and verbal communication.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities.



Preferred Skills

 - Experience with manufacturing ERP and MES systems.

 - Experience using AI or agentic tools to build and speed up planning workflows and analyses.

 - Experience with electromechanical assemblies that mix off-the-shelf and custom parts, including assemblies built by contract manufacturers.



About the Team


Our supply chain team sources components, runs manufacturing operations, and builds the supplier partnerships we need to make the lowest-cost, highest-quality home batteries at scale. Homeowners across the country rely on Base for whole-home backup and lower electricity bills. Our network of home batteries also helps keep the grid stable as demand climbs from AI, electrification, and extreme weather. We build in-house and expand at a speed and cost incumbents can't match, and this team makes that possible.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.description:
Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex.
Overview

Serves as a senior people strategy leader for a business unit or function, partnering with executive leaders and their organizations of 1,000-3,000 employees. Brings business context, HR expertise, and integrated judgment to the leadership table, helping executives make better decisions about organization, talent, workforce capability, culture, and change. Connects business strategy with HR Centers of Excellence to build high-performing, future-ready teams that drive growth and strengthen the organization.

jobs.title: Senior Manager (Team Lead), Pipeline Development
jobs.description:
Location: USA, Remote (AMER remit, US working hours)

Reports To: AMER GTM Leadership team

Role Overview

Wunderkind is looking for a hands-on, high-energy Senior Manager (Team Lead), Pipeline Development to lead our AMER Business Development team. This is a role for a leader who wants to be close to the work every day: running stand-ups, joining call blocks, coaching the next conversation and celebrating every SQL and SAO that follows. You’ll lead a team of up to 10 Business Development professionals who open doors into Enterprise and Strategic brands, and you’ll own the performance that turns their effort into a pipeline our sellers can close.

Our GTM leadership owns the pipeline strategy, the playbook, territory design, headcount and compensation. That leaves you free to focus on what great team leads do best: bringing that playbook to life, running the US working day, holding the standard and making every BDA better than they were in the  quarter before. If you’re a coach at heart who gets more energy from a rep’s breakthrough than from a strategy deck, and you’re looking for a role where you can build consistency, scale performance and watch a team grow under your leadership, we’d love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities

• SQL and SAO Delivery: Own your team’s delivery of Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs) against target across our Enterprise and Strategic accounts in AMER, week in and week out.

• Activity Metrics: Drive the daily and weekly activity standards that power pipeline, from calls and sequences to meetings booked, and keep the team’s effort focused on the accounts that matter most.

• Run the AMER Day: Lead the rhythm of the US working day, running stand-ups, listening in on calls, coaching the next conversation, running pipeline reviews and managing weekly accountability. Under you, everyone knows where they stand and what comes next.

• Coaching: Coach every BDA through call reviews, role plays and regular one-on-ones, building the skills and confidence that turn good reps into great ones.

• Performance Management: Recognize great performance loudly and address underperformance early, fairly and with a clear plan, so the bar stays high and everyone knows how to reach it.

• Lead by Example: Show the team what great Enterprise outreach looks and sounds like by by picking up the phone alongside your BDAs and living the standards you set

• Process Improvement: Run our pipeline playbook with discipline, spot where processes can work better, and bring improvements to the playbook’s owner for approval before rolling them out with your team.

• AE Partnership: Keep every BDA closely aligned with their paired Account Executive, so each SQL and SAO is handed over with the context needed to move it toward Closed-Won.

Qualifications & Requirements

• Enterprise SaaS Pipeline Experience: A minimum of 5 years in pipeline generation specifically within a SaaS environment, selling into Enterprise and Strategic accounts where product commitments are a minimum of 12 months.

• Proven Team Leadership: At least 3 years leading and coaching a high-performing team, and the ability to articulate clearly how you have managed teams for success.

• Hands-On by Design: Experience leading individual contributors directly, as this role is built for a front-line coach and isn’t suited to someone who manages through managers or team leads.

• Marketing SaaS Background: A strong preference for experience in Marketing SaaS or adjacent spaces, such as martech, adtech or ecommerce technology.

• Sustained Impact: A track record of building strong team performance and keeping it strong over time, through busy quarters, shifting priorities and the occasional curveball.

• Pipeline Toolkit: Confident with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and sales engagement platforms, and comfortable using AI tools to sharpen account research and personalization.

Ideal Candidate Attributes

• Coach at Heart: You get your biggest wins from watching employees book their first Enterprise meetings, and you know how to turn feedback into confidence.

• Steady and Resilient: You’re able to bring calm, consistency and staying power to our people - keeping your team focused and energized through tough weeks and big quarters alike - while still managing GTM Pipeline with urgency.

• Standard Setter: You hold a high bar with warmth, and your team always knows what great looks like because you show them.

• Execution Focused: You love the craft of pipeline and take pride in running a proven playbook brilliantly and improving it alongside your team.

• Right Role, Right Now: You’re excited by a role that puts all of your energy into your team’s performance, and you’re happy to leave strategy, headcount and compensation to our GTM leadership while you make the day-to-day truly exceptional.

Travel Requirements: Occasional travel across the US

The base salary range for this role is $100,000–$115,000. This role is also eligible for the team’s variable incentive plan. Compensation is determined based on factors including location, experience, skills, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer (Robotics)
jobs.description:
About Tutor
We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.

Tutor Intelligence is changing that.
Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.
Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.
Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.
Why Tutor?
Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.
Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.
The Role
Do you like being the person who figures out why something broke, gets it running again, and then makes sure it never breaks that way again? Tutor robots work on real production lines in factories and warehouses across the country. When one stops, a customer's line stops, and someone needs to get it moving again, fast.
As a Technical Support Engineer, you are the first engineer on the scene when a Tutor robot needs help. You'll work hand in hand with our customer-facing support teams, the tutors and customer success managers who talk to customers every day, to diagnose robot issues remotely, get robots back into production, and keep fleet uptime high. Between calls, you'll fix the things that cause them: improving customer-facing UI, fixing small robot-side bugs, and making hardware error messages clear enough that the next person can solve the problem without calling you. When an issue is bigger than a small fix, you'll track it with data and bring it to our core software team with the evidence they need to fix it at the root.
We're looking for someone who stays calm when a robot is down and a customer is waiting, who is responsive by default, and who can't leave a recurring problem alone. You work independently with limited oversight and deliver consistently: a trusted, reliable member of the team.  The initial focus will be on our Cassie platform.

This is a high-autonomy individual contributor role for someone who thrives in technically complex, quickly evolving environments and wants to build a durable research program and not simply execute a queue of studies.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What you’ll do:

• Build and own an ongoing research program across Core Pillars, beginning with Agent Console and spanning foundational discovery, product evaluation, and post-launch learning.

• Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering to identify consequential decisions and conduct focused mixed-methods research using qualitative and quantitative evidence.

• Develop a strong understanding of AI agents, complex technical workflows, and enterprise users so you can identify meaningful questions and engage credibly with customers and partners.

• Develop a clear point of view from the evidence, influence product strategy and design, and remain involved through implementation and measurement.

• Advance how research is practiced by using AI-assisted workflows, connecting qualitative insight with behavioral data, building reusable knowledge, and enabling partners to conduct focused research.

Who you are:

• You can independently own a meaningful portfolio of research from opportunity identification through execution, decision-making, and follow-through.

• You have deep qualitative research skills and can confidently use product telemetry, surveys, and other quantitative evidence.

• You connect research to product decisions and business outcomes, and you stay involved long enough to understand whether the intended results were achieved.

• You use AI thoughtfully in your research practice and can explain how it has improved the speed, scale, quality, or impact of your work.

• You can quickly learn complex technical domains and conduct effective research with enterprise and technical users.

• You communicate clearly, build trusted partnerships, and influence stakeholders with a practical, evidence-grounded point of view.

Nice to have:

• Experience researching AI products, developer tools, observability, infrastructure, or other complex B2B software is a strong plus.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Key Responsibilities

• Translate complex AI, data, analytics, and fraud solutions into executive-ready presentations, visualizations, briefings, and client-facing narratives.

• Build and maintain dashboards for utilization, margin, burn rate, pipeline, staffing, delivery health, and risk management.

• Automate recurring operational activities, including reporting, staffing views, pipeline tracking, proposal assembly, and status reporting, using Python, SQL, low-code/RPA tools, and generative AI.

jobs.description:
TALOS: INSTITUTIONAL FABRIC FOR THE DIGITAL ASSET MARKET

Founded in 2018, Talos https://www.talos.com provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Whether in-office or remote, you’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 


GM, HEAD OF DATA

We are seeking someone to lead the Talos data business and position it for strong, sustainable growth. You’ll own the P&L, product strategy and client relationships for our digital assets data offering, built on the Coin Metrics acquisition. Working closely with engineering, sales and executive leadership, you’ll shape how our data products are built, packaged and taken to market. This is a high-ownership role for an experienced business leader who has built or run a data business before and believes digital assets are where markets are heading.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the P&L for the data business, including revenue, costs, forecasting and performance reporting to executive leadership.

 - Set and execute product strategy: decide where to invest, what to scale and what to sunset, based on product traction and market demand.

 - Build a commercial model that serves both self-service customers and enterprise clients, including packaging, pricing and distribution.

 - Lead the research, product and data science teams, making sure research drives product development and supports Talos more broadly.

 - Partner with sales, marketing and engineering, which sit outside your reporting line, to align priorities and deliver revenue growth.

 - Own client outcomes and account health, resolving issues and driving retention and expansion.

 - Define the positioning and brand strategy for the data business within the wider Talos group.

 - Build a high-performing, motivated team with a strong sense of ownership and shared identity.

 


QUALIFICATIONS 

 - Proven experience leading a business unit or owning a P&L, ideally at a market data, index or financial data provider.

 - A track record of turning around or growing a business, with clear, measurable results.

 - Strong data product expertise, including monetisation, packaging, pricing and go-to-market for both self-service and enterprise models.

 - A background in capital markets. Digital assets experience is a plus, but a strong understanding of and conviction about the asset class is essential.

 - Demonstrated ability to influence and deliver through cross-functional teams without direct authority.

 - Experience building and leading research, product or data science teams.

 - Sound commercial judgement and accurate forecasting.

 - Executive presence and the ability to engage and constructively challenge senior leadership.

 - A builder’s mindset, suited to fast-moving, entrepreneurial environments rather than established incumbents.

 
 

Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture!

Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company."

 


BENEFITS

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

 - Retirement plan contributions

 - Unlimited Vacation + a PTO bonus: Employees that take 15 days of vacation, with 5 days being consecutive, receive a $2000 USD bonus.

 - Bonus and stock ownership

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Paid parental leave for 20 weeks, after 1 year of service

 - Global offsites and team outings

 - A wellness credit of $50 accrued monthly, to go towards things like gym memberships, ski-passes, and work out classes.

 - A lunch credit of $25 USD towards lunches for days in-office

jobs.description:
Peachy’s mission is to clear care barriers and make wrinkle treatment more accessible than it’s ever been through Preventative Botox, Prescription Retinoids, and Daily Use Sunscreen. Our approach? Transparent pricing, unmatched quality of care, and solutions backed by science. Plain and simple.

Job Title: Aesthetic Nurse Practitioner - Weekends Only

Location: Chicago, IL - Peachy West Loop

Start Date: Monday, January 4th, 2027

Join Peachy

Join one of the fastest-growing medical aesthetics companies in the country. At Peachy, our Nurse Practitioners specialize exclusively in wrinkle prevention through personalized consultations and treatment with FDA-approved neuromodulators.

Whether you're an experienced injector or completely new to aesthetics, we'll provide the training and support you need to build a successful career in medical aesthetics. Through our paid clinical training program, ongoing mentorship, and proprietary technology, you'll deliver exceptional clinical outcomes while creating an outstanding client experience.

Peachy Providers earn a competitive hourly rate plus quarterly performance bonuses. Our top-performing Providers earn 20%+ in bonus compensation annually!

Schedule:

• 4 weekend days per month (A "Weekend Day" is either Saturday or Sunday - Typically 9 AM - 5 PM)

While this is a Weekend-Only position, new providers will be asked to work several weekdays shifts during their first 90 days. This dedicated onboarding period provides the opportunity to build a strong partnership with their Lead Nurse Practitioner, receive additional clinical support, and become fully integrated into the Peachy care team.

Why Peachy?

• Paid aesthetic injector training - no prior aesthetics experience required

• Competitive hourly compensation + quarterly performance bonuses

• 100% employer-paid medical malpractice coverage

• Complimentary quarterly wrinkle treatment + prescription retinoid

• Proprietary AI-powered treatment planning technology

• Ongoing clinical education, mentorship, and professional development

• Career growth opportunities as Peachy continues expanding nationwide

No Aesthetics Experience? No Problem.

Our comprehensive paid training program is designed to teach the clinical and technical skills needed to become a successful aesthetic injector while maintaining Peachy's exceptionally high standards of care.

During training you'll learn:

• Botox®, Xeomin®, Dysport®, and Jeuveau® injection techniques

• Facial anatomy and wrinkle assessment

• Personalized consultation and treatment planning

• Neuromodulator dosing protocols

• Peachy's proprietary AI-powered treatment planning platform

• Clinical documentation and best practices

• Hands-on supervised injection training

You'll be fully compensated throughout your training period to ensure a seamless transition into your new career.

What You'll Do

• Complete Peachy's comprehensive clinical training program and participate in ongoing continuing education

• Deliver exceptional hospitality and customer service during every client interaction

• Perform wrinkle assessments and develop individualized treatment plans

• Educate clients on Peachy's wrinkle prevention offerings, including Botox®, Xeomin®, Dysport®, Jeuveau®, prescription retinoids, sunscreen, and aftercare products

• Perform cosmetic neurotoxin injections in the three FDA-approved treatment areas for facial wrinkles

• Maintain accurate clinical documentation and patient charting

• Follow all operational procedures, clinical protocols, and company initiatives

• Maintain infection prevention standards, including proper hand hygiene, PPE usage, and equipment sterilization

• Uphold HIPAA privacy and confidentiality standards

Who You Are

• Communicates Effectively: Communicates clearly and professionally while actively listening and building trust with clients and teammates.

• Drives Results: Takes ownership, overcomes obstacles, and consistently delivers exceptional client outcomes.

• Interpersonal Savvy: Builds genuine relationships with clients and colleagues while creating an inclusive, welcoming environment.

• Situational Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced environment and adjusts quickly to changing priorities and client needs.

• Manages Complexity: Uses sound clinical judgment and critical thinking to make informed decisions.

Lives Our Core Values

• Providing the Positive

• Continually Raising the Bar

• Earning & Keeping Trust

• Being Client Obsessed

• Reveling in the Constraints

What You Have

• Active Nurse Practitioner license in the state where you're applying

• Active Board Certification as an Adult, Family, or Women's Health Nurse Practitioner

• Active BLS Certification

• Strong preference for Nurse Practitioners with at least six months of autonomous clinical practice experience

• Recent procedural experience (such as IV placement, suturing, or other hands-on clinical procedures) is strongly preferred

• Flexibility to work across multiple Peachy studio locations within a reasonable distance of your home studio

• Availability to work a Weekend Schedule including Saturdays, Sundays, and some holidays. Part-Time Weekend providers are scheduled for 4 Weekend Days per month. Full day shifts from 9 AM - 5 PM.

• During your first 90 days, you'll work a handful of weekday shifts in addition to your Weekend Only schedule. These shifts provide additional clinical mentorship, oversight, and time to partner with your Lead NP.

• Must be at least 18 years of age and authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship

Ideal Clinical Background

Successful Peachy Providers come from a variety of procedural and patient-facing specialties, including:

• Emergency Medicine

• Urgent Care

• Women's Health

• Family Medicine

• Dermatology

• Plastic Surgery

• ICU

• PACU

• Other procedural clinical environments

Physical Requirements

• Frequently kneel, bend, sit, and stand for extended periods

• Safely administer injections in FDA-approved facial treatment areas

• Lift and transport items weighing up to 30 pounds

• Operate standard office equipment and technology

Pay & Perks:

• Competitive compensation + performance-based bonuses

• 100% employer-paid medical malpractice coverage

• Complimentary quarterly wrinkle treatment + retinoid

• Employee discount for Peachy services and products

• 401K program participation + employer match after 90 days of employment

• Medical, Dental, Vision eligibility*

• Paid time off*

* Benefit applies to Full-Time employees

The target base pay for the Nurse Practitioner role in Chicago, IL is $54.00 - $60.00/hour USD. Compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and geographic location. Peachy reserves the right to modify compensation ranges as business needs evolve.

jobs.title: Street Sweeper Operator
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The ParkX Street Sweeper Operator is responsible for maintaining the cleanliness and appearance of streets and public roadways within assigned areas. This includes safely operating a street sweeper truck along designated routes to remove trash, debris, leaves, and other waste, contributing to the overall appearance and safety of the community. This position requires a strong sense of responsibility, attention to detail, and the ability to operate the vehicle safely while maintaining a professional and courteous attitude.

Responsibilities

• Operate the street sweeper vehicle to remove trash, debris, leaves, and other materials from assigned routes.
• Follow safe operating practices, as well as all applicable traffic laws and site protocols.
• Conduct inspections of the assigned vehicle and equipment before and after each shift.
• Complete daily cleaning and maintenance tasks in exterior areas as directed by the Senior Operations Manager, Janitorial.
• Report to the assigned location before the start of the shift wearing the approved ParkX uniform.
• Follow all safety protocols and ensure the proper use of cleaning tools and equipment.
• Maintain a professional and courteous attitude toward property staff, residents, clients, and visitors.
• Support management teams with special cleaning or maintenance projects as requested.
• Keep machinery and supply storage areas organized and free of hazards.
• Complete all required documentation at the end of each shift and ensure a proper handoff of responsibilities to the next shift.
• Monitor inventory and notify management when additional cleaning materials or supplies are needed.
• Report any maintenance issues or unsafe conditions in exterior areas to management.
• Adhere to assigned cleaning schedules and checklists.
• Participate in team meetings and stay informed of operational updates related to site cleaning and maintenance.
• Provide coverage for coworkers during absences and assist in different exterior areas as needed.
• Be available to work weekends and outside regular business hours, particularly during events or peak-demand periods.
• Represent ParkX values and comply with company attendance, uniform, and conduct policies.
• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Requirements

• High school diploma or equivalent.
• Valid driver's license with no major driving violations.
• Availability to work outside regular business hours and on weekends during events.
• Outgoing personality with the ability to interact with individuals from diverse backgrounds and develop and maintain strong relationships.
• Excellent problem-solving, time management, and effective communication skills.
• High level of credibility, dependability, and integrity.
• Ability to hold oneself and others accountable while consistently striving for excellence.
• Positive, proactive attitude with a focus on growth and innovation.
• Customer service-oriented and results-driven mindset.
• Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
• Excellent verbal communication, active listening, and organizational skills.
• Ability to build strong working relationships within a team environment.
• Ability to multitask and prioritize responsibilities while maintaining strong attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Physical Demands

jobs.title: Principal Control Systems Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry  we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. 

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design the system‑level architecture for control systems across facilities, making strategic platform and technology choices in collaboration with program and system owners

 - Direct real‑time and embedded control solution implementation, selecting and guiding use of PLC, FPGA and other real‑time platforms, balancing performance, reliability, safety and cost trade‑offs

 - Work together with system integrators, electrical engineering, cabinet builders, and technicians to specify, design, review, test, install, and commission control cabinet hardware and field devices

 - Work together with the software team to architect and deliver fully integrated SCADA, HMI and data systems for alarms, logging, historian, analytics, data reduction, dashboards, etc., ensuring scalability and high performance

 - Orchestrate system integration across multiple complex subsystems and teams; define observability, logging and diagnostic strategies and lead root‑cause investigations and post-mortem studies of active systems to deliver lessons learned and contribute to continuous availability improvement

 - Shape requirements, documentation and validation approaches at system level, including design specs, interfaces and test strategies for reliability, safety and long‑term maintainability

 - Coach and mentor senior and junior engineers, identify capability gaps, grow technical capabilities in key skill areas, and champion best practices for software engineering, testing, quality, and ways of working within the controls team and beyond




WHO YOU ARE

 - Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Control/Automation, Mechatronics/Robotics, Physics or similar; PhD or equivalent experience preferred, with recognition as a technical expert in control/embedded or real‑time systems

 - Typically 10+ years in control/embedded systems, factory or plant automation, automated test systems, or complex scientific experimental work, with architectural ownership across multiple projects or products

 - Deep experience in at least one relevant domain (e.g., high energy lasers, nuclear, robotics, power/energy, automotive, aerospace, industrial automation) with understanding of domain constraints standards and regulations, as well as supplier ecosystems and main players

 - Proven track record specifying control cabinet hardware; defining house standards, ensuring compliance with regulations, liaising with system integrators, and creating test plans and quality control processes

 - Proven track record specifying control software and/or SCADA and data acquisition systems; defining interfaces, patterns and coding standards across teams, and guiding technology trade‑offs

 - Extensive experience with embedded and real‑time platforms (e.g., PLCs in ST IEC 61131‑3, FPGAs, RTOS‑based systems, robotics), including selecting platforms and scaling architectures with clear RAM vs cost/reliability trade‑offs

 - Understanding of software/firmware engineering best practices (version control, branching, design for test, CI/CD, automated testing, defensive programming) and experience introducing or improving these practices, and organizing or conducting training programs across teams or organizations

 - Excellent communicator (English), able to influence technical direction at organization level, handle and resolve ambiguities in requirements and processes, and build alignment across hardware, software, product and operations teams in hybrid, cross‑site environments

 - Practical, hands‑on approach with a strong track record orchestrating large‑scale HW/SW integration, resolving integration challenges, and leading complex debugging and fault‑finding on real systems

 - Desirable skills and knowledge (please highlight any of the following in your application):
   
   - Deep experience with PLC programming in ST (IEC 61131‑3); Beckhoff PLCs and TwinCAT system design and architecture, multi-PLC distributed control
   
   - SCADA (especially Ignition) and/or designing and deploying SCADA systems and applying cross-site HMI standards for large-scale and complex systems
   
   - Embedded or real‑time systems (FPGAs, RTOS, microcontrollers, robotics), including platform selection and long‑term maintainability strategies
   
   - LabVIEW architect level (CLA) with focus on FPGA and embedded targets,
   
   - Experience with complex scientific equipment or large‑scale facilities, including diagnostics, vacuum systems, motion platforms and safety interlocks
   
   - Image processing and machine vision, motion control and robotics, high‑precision stepper/piezo systems and encoders




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

 - Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

 - Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

 - Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

 - Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

 - Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

 - Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

 - Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

 - Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

 - Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 - Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

 - Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.
