Affirm seeks to provide better financial products to improve the lives of consumers and we are looking for an Operations Associate who will join our team to humbly serve our customers. As part of our Customer Operations team, Operations Associates ensure timely and accurate resolution of complex customer inquiries through omni-channel communication, and partner with cross-functional teams to implement new systems and products. Our ideal candidate is ready to learn and develop their career as a part of a dynamic and collaborative team.

What You'll Do

• Resolve escalated customer inquiries via predominantly email, with occasional need for phone calls to support customers.

• Responsible for maintaining a high level of professionalism and maintaining excellent Quality Assurance scores with clients while working to establish a positive rapport

• Utilization of your in-depth product and financial knowledge to communicate, investigate, and resolve customer issues on a larger variety of case types.

• Participate and assist in ongoing training to develop new skills and responsibilities

• Participate in the incubation phase of new products and features and assist with ad-hoc projects as needed

• Responsible for independently managing schedules and emails channels in order to drive higher productivity performance and quality scores.

• Proactive willingness to collaborate cross-functionally with other Affirm teams to analyze, assess and resolve complex customer issues

• Opportunity to participate in voluntary specialized processes in addition to day to day responsibilities

• Initiate document creation, including meeting minutes, N-Pagers, and procedural updates

What We Look For

• Willingness to support operation functions on evenings, weekends and public holidays

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Proficient in both English and French

• Capable of delivering high quality work independently and/or virtually while remaining flexible in a fast-growth environment

• 1-3 years required experience interacting with customers in an omnichannel environment (phone, email, chat, etc)

• Experience within the financial industry is a plus

• Sound judgment and proactive problem solving skills

• Ability to apply analytical thinking in decision making with keen organizational skills and attention to detail

• Team player with an interest in collaborating with and learning from cross-functional partners

• Strong follow-through and ability to manage competing priorities

• Mac (iOS) and Google Workspace (formerly G Suite) knowledge a plus

• Comfortable with working with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to assess and drive performance

Pay Grade - B

Equity Grade - 1

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. jobs.title: Marketing Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Marketing Operations team is responsible for the systems, processes, and data infrastructure that power Stripe's global marketing engine. We partner closely with Growth, Demand Generation, Regional Marketing, Lifecycle, Sales Development, and Marketing Technology teams to ensure campaigns are executed with precision, prospect data is accurate and actionable, and our marketing technology stack operates at scale.

We are systems thinkers and operational leaders focused on improving the workflows, tooling, data quality, and processes that enable marketing and sales teams to move faster and more effectively. Our work spans campaign operations, marketing automation, prospect data management, and cross-functional program delivery.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Program Manager to lead cross-functional programs that grow Stripe's reach to new businesses in direct support of Stripe’s mission. This role sits at the intersection of technology, data, and program management, and it requires someone who can move fluidly between strategic planning and hands-on execution via deep partnerships with engineering.

You will serve as a process owner for key marketing and sales development operations work streams, partnering with stakeholders in marketing, sales development, product, and engineering to deliver scalable solutions that improve efficiency, data quality, and pipeline impact.

Responsibilities

• Responsibilities can include the following and will vary by area of coverage

• Create and lead programs to build an agentic acquisition program for how Stripe engages with prospects

• Own end-to-end program delivery for initiatives; maintain program communications, track milestones, lead cross-functional workstreams, and provide regular updates on roadmap progress

• Lead programs to address recurring sales development and/or marketing operational challenges; define objectives, success metrics, and build repeatable processes that scale

• Partner with marketing, product and engineering teams to scope business requirements, coordinate discovery, and translate operational needs into product requirements for internal tooling

• Coordinate review cycles, pilots, and feedback collection during program execution; summarize required changes, identify launch-blocking issues, and escalate risks as needed

• Drive ongoing operations improvements through process innovation, automation, and the adoption of AI-powered tools to increase productivity and transform workflows

• Maintain scalable documentation and support coordination with offshore production teams and cross-functional partners across time zones

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 6+ years of experience in B2B marketing/sales/revenue operations or a related program management role in a high-growth technology environment

• 3+ years of experience working day-to-day with marketing automation platforms, CRM platforms, prospect data, and lead management

• 3+ years of experience in end-to-end program management of cross-functional marketing, sales, and engineering initiatives

• Experience building AI agents, including examples of agents you have deployed and examples of ways you are using AI on a daily basis beyond chat

• 3+ years of experience doing your own analysis using queries, dashboards, and AI and partnering with analysts and data scientists for more complex analytics needs

• 3+ years of experience defining your own scope and goals and collaborating with a distributed, global team to deliver on them

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to convey complex operational concepts to diverse stakeholders across marketing, sales, and engineering

Preferred qualifications

• 3+ years of experience with Salesforce or Marketo, including lead and contact management, campaign attribution, and marketing-to-sales data flows

• Experience implementing AI tools to improve marketing operations workflows and productivity

• Experience working with global teams on a day-to-day basis

• Experience in the financial services, payments, or B2B software industries

jobs.title: Customer Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.


AND HERE'S WHERE YOU COME IN

We're looking for talented individuals to join our Seller Sales team – the heart and soul of Motorway. As a Seller Sales Specialist, you'll be the friendly face and expert guide for our customers, ensuring they have a smooth and enjoyable journey with us.




WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT

We're not your typical call centre. We're not about rigid scripts and endless queues. We're about using technology to revolutionise the car industry. We're about empowering both buyers and sellers to get the best possible deal. And we're about building a team of passionate people who are excited to be part of something truly innovative. Here's what that means for you:

 - Impactful Work: You're not just answering calls; you're guiding customers through our cutting-edge online platform, using your skills to solve real problems and make their car selling experience amazing.

 - AI-Powered Technology: We utilize the latest AI tools, allowing you to deliver a seamless and efficient customer experience. Say goodbye to clunky systems!

 - Tangible Results: Every day, you'll directly help people navigate the car selling process, ensuring they get the best deal and avoid the stress of traditional methods.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Building genuine connections: Connecting with car sellers and dealers, answering their questions, and building trust.

 - Finding creative solutions: Using your initiative and problem-solving skills to tackle any challenges that come your way.

 - Mastering our systems: Becoming a whiz with our CRM systems, ensuring data accuracy and efficiency.

 - Putting customers first: Always advocating for the customer and looking for ways to improve their experience.


ABOUT YOU

 - You genuinely enjoy helping people and have a knack for building rapport.

 - You're a natural communicator, whether it's on the phone, via email, or through chat.

 - You're detail-oriented and take pride in your work.

 - You're a quick learner and enjoy solving problems.

 - You thrive in a collaborative environment.


WE'VE GOT YOUR BACK, IN LIFE'S BIGGEST MOMENTS AND THE EVERYDAY ONES TOO.

 - Competitive salary

 - Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway’s success

 - 25 days holiday

 - Sea-front office with bi-weekly massages and free snacks

 - Private medical insurance via BUPA

 - Life assurance

 - Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)

 - Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

 - 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

 - EV leasing scheme

 - Cycle to work scheme

 - Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

 - 1 paid volunteering day a year


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Initial Call (30 mins): A casual chat to discuss your experience and learn more about Motorway.

 - Onsite Interview (60 mins): Meet the team, get a feel for the role, and participate in a skills-based assessment, which may include a role-playing exercise.

You can expect to hear back from us within a week business days of each interview stage. You'll have the opportunity to speak with a talent partner throughout the interview process should you have any questions or need any type of accommodations.




WORKING PATTERNS

Tuesday to Saturday, 8:45am to 5:30pm

Sunday to Thursday, 8:45am to 5:30pm

 - You're a go-getter. You've got loads of energy, you're resourceful, and you make things happen. You don't need someone telling you what to do, you love taking ownership and figuring things out.

 - You've got an eye for talent. You can spot exceptional people, ask great questions, and see potential that others might miss. You've got great instincts and high standards.

 - You love the thrill of the hunt. You get a buzz out of finding brilliant people, getting creative with sourcing, building relationships and convincing someone who's not looking to take a conversation.

 - You're creative. You've got big ideas about how to get in front of great talent, whether that's an amazing event, a clever campaign, or something nobody's tried before.

We don't mind whether you're coming from agency or in-house. We're looking for someone with serious drive, great instincts, and a track record of hiring exceptional people. If you're ambitious, love getting creative, and want to help build something special in SF, you'll love it here.




SUPPORTING YOU

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

 - Market-leading private medical insurance. The proper kind, so you're never weighing up your health against a bill.

 - Competitive PTO. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

 - First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

 - Enhanced 401k. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

 - Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

 - Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

 - Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

 - Two budgets that have your back. $1000 to invest in your setup, $500 a year to invest in yourself.

jobs.title: Account Executive - GovCon (NYC or Washington DC)
jobs.description:
Join AutogenAI – Revolutionizing Proposal Writing with generative AI

AutogenAI is a leader in generative AI SaaS, transforming how organizations draft and optimize winning proposals through cutting-edge natural language processing technology. We are one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world, expanding rapidly to meet the increasing demand for AI-driven solutions across industries.

Our innovation stems from a belief that language AI technology will revolutionize business communication over the next decade. We empower our clients to grow faster and more efficiently by delivering AI language engines customized to their needs that save time, improve content quality, and increase win rates in highly competitive markets.

AutogenAI is a company where everyone can have a career-defining experience and success is achieved by fostering a culture where innovation and ambition thrive. As we scale, passionate professionals are invited to join our journey of innovation, helping shape the future of AI-powered business solutions.

Job Summary:

As an Account Executive at AutogenAI, you will play a pivotal role in building and scaling our US business. You will create your own pipeline, break into target accounts across the Federal/GovCon ecosystem and other proposal-intensive markets, and close 5 – 6 figure value SaaS deals with small and mid-tier contractors. You'll run your territory like your own business, with the operational discipline to know exactly where every opportunity stands and what it will take to win.

You won't inherit a finished sales machine. We're looking for someone who enjoys helping build one. This role offers direct exposure to executive leadership, real influence over how we sell in the US, and a clear path for career progression in a hyper-growth startup.

Our customers are the people who capture, write, manage and win proposals. If you have lived that world yourself, whether in Federal, SLED, commercial or AEC, you will speak our buyers' language from day one, and we will value that experience highly.

📍 Location and Travel: NYC hybrid (3 days per week) preferred. We will also consider senior, highly experienced candidates based in the DC/Northern Virginia area who bring deep, established relationships across the GovCon ecosystem (regular travel to NYC and customer events required).

No security clearance required.

What You'll Be Responsible For:

• Selling into the GovCon Ecosystem: Engage small and mid-tier US government contractors. Sell across Business Development, Capture, Proposal, Growth, IT/Security, Procurement and executive leadership.

• Product Demos: Own, run and customize your own demo environment. Be prepared to run generic and custom demos daily.

• Closing Complex Deals: Run a consultative, value-driven sales process from first conversation to signature. Lead strong discovery, multi-thread across buying committees, negotiate effectively and close opportunities.

• Creating Your Own Pipeline: Generate your pipeline through strategic outbound, executive prospecting, networking, events and reactivating dormant accounts. Break into target accounts and build relationships from scratch rather than relying solely on inbound or BDR-sourced opportunities.

• Running Your Territory Like a Business: Build and execute account plans and maintain disciplined pipeline coverage. Track your conversion rates and know your numbers at every stage of the funnel.

• Forecasting and Deal Inspection: Keep CRM data accurate and current, and deliver reliable forecasts. Identify deal risk early and clearly articulate the status, next steps and path to close for every opportunity.

• Helping Build the US Sales Motion: Test new approaches, sharpen messaging and improve process as we scale. Feed customer and market insights back to Product and Marketing.

• Working as One Team: Partner closely with BDRs, Solutions, Customer Success and leadership to win new business, onboard customers smoothly and expand accounts over time.

• Representing AutogenAI: Build our presence at GovCon industry events, associations and networks to drive brand awareness and new opportunities.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

• Experience: 4+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS or technology sales. Exceptional performance and evidence of results matter more than tenure.

• A True Hunter: You genuinely enjoy prospecting, negotiating and winning new business, and you're comfortable breaking into accounts where you have no existing relationships.

• Product & Demo Enthusiasm: You enjoy learning the product and running multiple targeted demos. You’re confident tailoring walkthroughs to prospect needs and using the product to drive discovery and deal progression, rather than relying heavily on an SE.

• Self-Generated Pipeline: A consistent history of building your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking and account penetration, rather than relying on inbound or BDR-sourced opportunities.

• Deal Execution: Excellent at discovery, multi-threading and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes. Comfortable guiding customers through security and compliance reviews.

• Operational Rigor: You run your territory like your own business. CRM discipline, accurate forecasting, pipeline management and deal inspection are second nature

• Tools and Methodology: Proficiency with Salesforce (or similar CRM) and established sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC.

• A Builder's Mindset: Proven success in a startup, scale-up or similarly high-growth environment. You're energized by building something rather than inheriting it.

• Hunger and Accountability: You're commercially ambitious, competitive, resilient, curious and highly accountable, with a strong sense of urgency. You're coachable and collaborative, but you don't need to be pushed into action.

Strongly Preferred:

None of the following are required, but they will set you apart. Candidates who bring one or more of them will receive strong preference, especially when combined with the SaaS sales track record described above.

• Proposal Experience: Hands-on experience in proposal management, proposal writing, capture or bid management in Federal, SLED, commercial or AEC markets. Having sat in our customers' seats is a significant advantage in this role.

• Shipley Training: Formal Shipley training (for example, proposal management, capture management or the Business Development Lifecycle) and fluency in Shipley best practices.

• APMP Certification: APMP Foundation, Practitioner or Professional certification.

• GovCon Fluency: Experience selling into US Government Contractors or a strong working knowledge of the Federal/GovCon market.

Also Valued:

• Education: Bachelor's degree preferred. Candidates without a degree will be considered where they have a strong record of success in complex B2B sales, business development, proposal and/or capture roles.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Competitive Salary: $120,000 - $140,000 base (50/50 commission split, up to $280,000 OTE uncapped)

• Stock Options: Meaningful equity in the company.

• Comprehensive medical/dental/life insurance: Insurance coverage for individuals and families partially paid by the company as well as opportunity to participate in pre-tax health Flexible Spending Account.

• Retirement Plan: Ability to invest your pre-tax dollars in a 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions.

• Paid Time Off: Unlimited vacation (Yes, you read right!)

• Flexible Work Options: NYC hybrid (3 days per week). See Location and Travel above for DC-area candidates.

• Paid parental leave: 12 weeks if you’ve just given birth, 4 weeks if your partner has just given birth (after one year of service)

• Additional Perks: Your choice of laptop (Mac or Windows), regular company events to connect with teammates, and opportunities for continued professional development.

Values in Action:

These aren’t just principles we print and forget – they’re how we work, how we treat each other, and how we deliver for our customers. They shape the company we are, and the one we aspire to become.

• Customers, Always: Everything starts with our customers. We walk in their shoes, speak their language, and build for their delight and success. We win when they win.

• Make It Happen: We move fast and take ownership. No waiting, no red tape – just action, urgency, and focus on outcomes.

• Learn and Invent: We stay curious. We learn what we can from past masters - and make up the rest. Change is constant, and so is our growth.

• Act Like Owners: Titles don’t solve problems - people do. We own challenges, break the rules when it’s necessary, and focus on what matters.

• Turn It Up to 11: There is no “Good enough”. We raise the bar, push boundaries, and keep building. There’s always a next level.

• Lead With Respect: We listen first, speak honestly, and value every perspective. Integrity, follow-through, and kindness matter.

• Build Trust Through Transparency: We default to openness. We give feedback, share information, and assume positive intent - no secrets, no silos.

AutogenAI is a merit-based equal opportunity employer, drug-free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer - Developer Platform
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Singapore, Sydney, or Tokyo

About the Role:

Do you love solving complex problems and interacting with people? Are you passionate about helping customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking a Technical Customer Support Engineer to join our team. You will work with our customers on a variety of technical support issues as well as the Technical Operations team that is responsible for running our global distributed network. This is a position where you will learn the inner workings of Cloudflare's technology and gain a deeper understanding of internet technologies. You will focus on providing support on our Developer Platform products: Workers, Workers AI, Pages, KV, Stream, R2, D1, DO etc.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience:

• You are familiar with Developer Platform products

• You have previous experience working as part of a team in a customer-facing role

• You have experience solving HTTP, DNS and other networking-related problems

• You have experience with a common web development language (for example, Javascript)

• You understand how the Internet works

• You have experience working in a support role where you thrived every time you resolved a ticket

• You are comfortable communicating through various support channels and always put the customer first (Emails, Live Chats, Phone calls and virtual meetings)

• You are a motivated self-starter and always looking to expand your existing skill set

Bonus Points

• You are familiar with Cloudflare and have a site actively using our platform

• You have a solid grasp of problem-solving with command line tools (curl/dig/traceroute/tcpdump)

• You are familiar with Nginx, Apache, IIS or any other web servers

• You are committed to gaining a deeper understanding of the following technologies: DNS / CDN - Cache / SSL / Cloudflare Workers

• You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers

• You have experience with Cloudflare Workers and/or JavaScript

• You have experience with Video encoding and streaming solutions

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: CEI Inspector II
jobs.description:
About the Position

We’re seeking a CEI Inspector II professional who will provide Construction, Engineering, and Inspection (CEI) services for transportation projects located in the state of Georgia. This is intermediate level technical work supporting higher level inspectors and engineers in functional areas such as construction inspection and surveying; scheduling and status; roadway design; traffic signal equipment; traffic signalization and geometrics; materials sampling; inspection and testing. Work usually involves a significant amount of decision making and use of judgment and may include providing work directions to others.

This is a long-term, full-time, on-site position targeting Northwest Georgia. Training materials will be provided to obtain the required certifications.

Responsibilities

• May perform project engineering duties in lieu of the Project Engineer on smaller construction projects.

• Will perform independent complex inspections of roadways and structure construction processes and materials to ensure compliance with the construction contract.

• Will perform moderately complex inspections or supervise other inspectors conducting routine and standardized inspections.

• Work includes inspecting asphalt and concrete for acceptable materials and mix; pavement for proper spreading, rolling, depth, alignment and compaction; roadways and structures for conformance to plans and specifications; structural materials and members; placement of culverts; structural operations such as foundation excavation; placement of piling, reinforcing and structural steel, concrete and backfill; and traffic control and erosion control devices.

• May also perform a more complex variety of calculations and computations.

• Will perform contract documentation duties, which include field measurements of pay items as well as other Department required documentation.

• Work may include participating in Concept Meetings, Field Plan Reviews (Preliminary and/or Final), CPM schedule reviews, project close-out, and other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Attributes

• Possess excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Possess excellent multi-tasking and organizational skills.

• Possess excellent collaboration skills.

Minimum Requirements

• High School Diploma or GED.

• 3+ years of progressive transportation technician experience as an employee or consultant for a State Highway Agency, or an equivalent combination of training and directly related experience.

• Considerable knowledge of materials, methods, and equipment used in highway construction.

• Considerable knowledge of mathematical functions, including geometry and trigonometry.

• Drafting skill and skill in the use of office equipment such as calculators and computers.

• Ability to read, interpret, and explain construction plans, contract provisions, specifications, and inspection procedures.

• Ability to take notes and prepare or review reports.

• Ability to instruct other employees in proper work methods.

• Must be licensed to operate motor vehicles in accordance with Georgia Law.

• Proficiency with computers (e.g., Microsoft Office 365, Microsoft Outlook, internet, etc.).

Required Certifications

Please Note: For titles containing GDOT certifications or passing scores on Engineering Skills Development Tests, certifications and passing scores must be obtained within six (6) months of beginning work on the GDOT project. Certifications from other agencies or states may possibly be substituted.

• GDOT WECS.

• GDOT Field Concrete Technician Certification.

• GSWCC Level 1a (Erosion Control).

• Passing scores on GDOT’s Construction Engineering Inspection Training tests – Group 1 (General Provisions, Auxiliary Items, Basic Highway Math, Basic Highway Plan Reading).

• Passing scores on GDOT’s Construction Engineering Inspection Training tests – Group 2 (Pavements, Bases, Subbases, Minor Drainage Structures, Construction Erosion Control).

Compensation Details

Expected Salary: $52k-$73k/year ($25-$35/hour). Luster provides the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might offer for this position based on the successful candidate’s level of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, education, certifications, licenses, geographic location, etc. Luster reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on circumstances not related to any status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

Just LOOK at the Benefits We Offer!

• Unlimited flexible time off

• Paid holidays

• Paid parental leave

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• Flexible spending accounts (healthcare and dependent or elder care)

• Long-term disability insurance

• Short-term disability insurance

• Life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment

• 401(k) plan with guaranteed employer contribution

• Formal career planning and development program

• $2,500 annually toward professional development

• Wellness program with monthly wellness stipend

• Company cell phone or cell phone plan reimbursement

• Free personalized meal planning and nutrition support with a registered dietitian

• Free personal financial planning services

• Employee assistance program

• Employee discounts

• Employee referral bonus

Specific plan details and coverage for each benefit noted above will be provided upon offer.  #IN-LNJS

If you wish to be considered for a position where there is not an active job posted, please search for our 'General Application' and apply.

Luster is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to criminal history, race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. This employer participates in E-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I-9 to confirm work authorization.

All positions may be subject to a background check and drug test once a conditional offer of employment is made for any convictions directly related to its duties and responsibilities, in accordance with all applicable local, state, and/or federal regulations.

jobs.title: Performance Marketer
jobs.description:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the role (what you'll be doing)

This is a high-ownership role at the centre of the Hims & Hers growth engine. You'll be an integral part of the team that owns paid media (brand and performance) strategy, execution, and results end to end across our most critical acquisition channels, while partnering closely with creative, product, and analytics teams to drive measurable, scalable outcomes. This role is for someone who thinks in systems, brings rigour to experimentation, and has the commercial instincts to turn data into growth. You'll report to the Performance Lead within the Growth team.

As our Performance Marketer, you will:

• Be an integral part of the team that owns the paid growth engine: help define and execute channel strategy across Google, YouTube, Meta, TikTok and emerging platforms, making campaign and budget allocation decisions by triangulating first-party, blended and attributed data sources.

• Drive creative-performance loops: partner closely with creative teams to ideate, brief, test and iterate on high-performing ad concepts. Build a creative review process that uses structured creative analysis to identify key performance variables and sharpen subsequent briefs.

• Lead a rigorous test-and-learn roadmap: build and run structured experiments across audiences, creative, bidding strategies and landing experiences to continuously improve efficiency and scale.

• Own performance analytics and reporting: translate campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations, and diagnose performance issues and opportunities using first- and third-party data to drive ongoing optimisation.

• Champion measurement excellence: apply best practice across attribution, incrementality testing and full-funnel performance tracking so decisions are grounded in reliable signal.

• Influence cross-functional growth strategy: collaborate with product, analytics and senior leadership to shape priorities and stay ahead of platform changes, industry trends and emerging opportunities.

• Take ownership of your paid accounts: you'll be responsible for everything that comes with these platforms, from building accounts from scratch, to assisting with or overseeing pixel implementation, to ensuring best-in-class campaign structure, then launching, maintaining and optimising ads.

About you (who you are)

• Experienced: you have 4+ years of significant hands-on experience running several accounts, each with multiple channels, in performance marketing or paid media.

• Strong on Google Ads: you have a track record of driving efficient customer acquisition on Google (Search, Performance Max, YouTube and Demand Gen), plus hands-on experience with Meta and other channels as part of a multichannel acquisition strategy.

• Deeply analytical: you're comfortable working with first- and third-party data, attribution models and blended performance metrics, and can translate complexity into clear, confident recommendations.

• A structured experimenter: you build test-and-learn frameworks rather than one-off tests, and you know how to separate signal from noise to inform strategy.

• Close to creative teams: you collaborate with them daily to help write a compelling creative brief, influence product roadmap conversations, and present performance strategy to senior stakeholders with equal confidence.

• Confident with AI tools: you regularly use AI to help analyse data and flag concerns before forming your own recommendation and driving its execution.

• Commercially numerate: you translate performance metrics into business outcomes. You understand what CAC means for our business, how we influence it, and how to build budgets that hit order targets. You love the numbers.

• Proactive and commercially minded, with genuine curiosity about platform mechanics, consumer behaviour, and what makes paid media work at scale.

Nice to haves

• Background in D2C, consumer or subscription-based businesses, with a focus on ROI, LTV and retention.

• Experience with incrementality testing, media mix modelling, or advanced attribution methodologies.

• Hands-on experience running TikTok or YouTube as supplementary acquisition channels at scale.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software, Compound) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

• What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.

• Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.

• Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.

• Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.

• Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in Australia?

• Grow with us globally - Get mentorship from leaders across Australia, the UK, Germany, and Japan, collaborate with teams in the Philippines and South Africa, and explore new markets or travel internationally. ****Recognised on Hatch’s Hotlist as one of Australia’s top employers, we support early-career professionals to become future global leaders.

• Shape your career - Access learning budgets, conferences, certifications, peer shadowing, and a global knowledge-sharing culture.

• Work where well-being matters - Experience catered wellness talks, exercise classes, free barista coffees, funded social clubs, and quarterly rooftop parties.

• Innovate with purpose - Use state-of-the-art tools and contribute to bold, impactful solutions in healthcare.

• Support at every stage - Benefit from parental and miscarriage leave, health, professional development, and personal days, and our Employee Assistance Program.

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

jobs.title: Senior Design Lead (Bangkok based, relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

A bit about the Brand team

Agoda’s Brand team brings together, brand managers, media planners, project managers, designers, and creatives. We shape how consumers, business partners, and employees experience Agoda, building recognition and brand trust. Working as an internal agency, we develop brand campaigns and marketing communications across digital channels, events, presentations, and other brand touchpoints.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Design Lead who combines exceptional design craft with experience managing and developing designers. This role carries both individual contributor and people management responsibilities. You will personally develop concepts and design key work, while guiding the team and raising the quality of its output.

A central focus will be making Agoda’s distinctive brand assets more recognizable, versatile, and effective through repeated use. You will shape how these assets appear across campaigns, channels, and markets, building familiarity while finding fresh, purposeful ways to express the brand.

You bring a refined eye for impactful design and a strong understanding of visual and message hierarchy. You can demonstrate your thinking through your own work, coach others to strengthen theirs, and use AI confidently in visual design and campaign development.

In this role you’ll get to

• Personally concept and design. Own design projects from brief through final execution, producing original work and contributing actively to the team’s everyday creative output.

• Strengthen Agoda’s distinctive brand assets. Develop consistent, inventive applications that make our assets more recognizable, versatile, and effective across touchpoints and over time.

• Lead and develop designers. Manage and coach the team, set clear expectations, and run constructive creative reviews. Give actionable feedback and demonstrate solutions through your own design work.

jobs.title: AI Quality and Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT PATRIANNA

Patrianna is a fast-scaling product development company headquartered in Gibraltar, with a dynamic, global team powering our growth. We operate at the intersection of technology and entertainment, building innovative solutions that shape the future of social gaming and deliver outstanding experiences to millions of players worldwide.

We're driven by speed, ambition, and bold ideas. At our core, we're product creators and problem-solvers who thrive in a high-performance environment. We're looking for exceptional talent—smart, adaptable, and motivated individuals eager to make an impact, scale business functions at pace, and continuously improve.

Whether you're a domain expert or an agile thinker who thrives in change, at Patrianna you'll have the freedom to innovate, take ownership, and help us lead the next wave of gaming innovation.

Join us—and be part of something extraordinary.


THE ROLE

You'll make sure our AI agents and critical workflows actually work by building smart automated testing and evaluation, then using AI to test AI.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 1. You'll build and maintain API, integration and end-to-end regression tests that keep our critical workflows rock solid.

 2. You'll evaluate AI agents on task completion, response quality, tool use and permissions, and measure how model, prompt and context changes affect results.

 3. You'll build quality checks into our CI/CD pipelines and turn every production defect into a regression case, so the same bug never bites twice.

 4. You'll put agents to work exploring workflows, generating tests and reproducing bugs, then rigorously check what they find.

 5. You'll share the tools and methods that work with the wider AI team and our central QA department, raising the bar for everyone.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 1. Strong test automation and programming skills in TypeScript or Python

 2. Solid hands-on experience with web apps, APIs, Git and CI/CD

 3. A structured approach to judging AI output against clear, measurable criteria

 4. A knack for reproducing, isolating and pinning down bugs fast, with a sharp eye for root cause

 5. A direct communicator who documents decisions and shares what works

 6. Bonus: agentic browser testing, LLM evaluation frameworks, Supabase, Vercel or GCP


WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT

 1. You'll be at the cutting edge. AI agent evaluation is new territory, and you'll help define how it's done here.

 2. Real ownership. We act like one of three team members: accountable, trusted and close to the impact.

 3. Progress over perfectionism. We set achievable deadlines, ship, learn and improve.

 4. Genuinely open culture. Conversations happen in open Slack channels, outcomes live in Monday.com http://Monday.com, and calls are on Google Meet with cameras on because we like feeling connected.

 5. No fluff. If it can be said in 20 words, we won't use 1,000.

 6. Great people. We want to work with the best, and we have a strict no ass-hole policy.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas — nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.

As our Client & Partner Solutions Manager, you will lead our global team responsible for delivering a premium experience and exceptional solutions to Axi’s VIP clients and partners.

This is more than a service leadership role. You will use client and partner insights to identify opportunities to improve how we operate, influence product and service development, strengthen retention, and ultimately support Axi’s growth.

You will lead a high-performing team, drive operational excellence and work closely with stakeholders across the business to make sure the voice of our clients and partners translates into meaningful action.

Your EDGE Assignment / You Will

• Lead and execute Axi’s global Client & Partner Solutions strategy and operating model, aligning service standards, workflows, tools and escalation paths across all regions.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Observability
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer on our Observability team, you’ll design, build and run the observability platform that SentinelOne engineers use to monitor our global products. You’ll own key parts of the stack from start to finish. You’ll work independently within the team’s roadmap and be a go-to resource for teammates.

We’re looking for someone with hands-on Kubernetes and observability experience who enjoys running high-volume systems for collecting, storing and analyzing telemetry data in production. Your work will give engineering teams better visibility into their systems and help them ship faster and more safely.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Design and build scalable, resilient parts of our telemetry platform (Grafana, Prometheus, Thanos/Mimir/Cortex, OpenTelemetry) so SentinelOne engineers can deploy and monitor features quickly and safely.

• Own small-to-medium features from requirements refinement and technical design through to production rollout.

• Work with the engineering teams that use the platform to understand their needs, refine requirements, and flag work that is underspecified.

• Work across large-scale Kubernetes environments (EKS, GKE) on AWS and GCP.

• Keep the services you own reliable and cost-efficient, for example by right-sizing cloud resources and tuning telemetry volume.

• Automate repetitive operational work to reduce toil and pager load.

• Manage infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) and follow security, compliance, and change-management procedures in production.

• Take part in on-call: troubleshoot complex production issues, improve runbooks and dashboards, lead postmortems, and see corrective actions (CATs) through.

• Review peers' code and designs and give clear, constructive feedback.

• Mentor teammates and share knowledge through docs, demos, and internal talks.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• 5 or more years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or a related systems-focused field.

• Hands-on experience running observability stacks in production: Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos (or Mimir/Cortex), and OpenTelemetry.

• Production experience with Kubernetes (EKS, GKE) and tools such as Helm and Kustomize, and experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or GCP).

• Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools, specifically Terraform and Ansible.

• Experience keeping large-scale SaaS or distributed systems reliable, including on-call and incident response.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and common deployment strategies (rolling, blue-green, canary).

• Proficiency in Go or another mainstream language (e.g., Python).

• Familiarity with on-premises, hybrid, or air-gapped Kubernetes deployments is preferred.

• Experience with GitHub Actions specifically, or with progressive delivery tools (e.g., Argo CD, Argo Rollouts, Flagger) is preferred.

• Experience reducing telemetry costs, for example through cardinality management or retention tuning, is preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Salary starting from 4000 EUR/month. Annual bonus based on company performance, paid in two installments. The final base salary may be adjusted based on the individual skills and experience of the selected candidate.

Equity & Rewards

• Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

• Performance-based bonus

Time Off & Wellbeing

• Flexible time off, on top of the standard 5 weeks PTO

• Paid company wellness days and fully paid short-term sick/nursing leave

• Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

• Life and disability insurance

• Pension Insurance contribution

• Global business travel medical insurance

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

• Global home office allowance

• Meal allowance

• Hybrid work in Prague (Karlin), Brno (Clubco) or remote in CZ/SK. Only Prague-based employees are required to work from the office at least 2 days/week.

Wellness & Lifestyle

• MultiSport benefit program

• Wellness Coach app

 2. You'll build and own CI/CD pipelines, deployment checks and recovery procedures so shipping is fast and safe.

 3. You'll set up logs, metrics, traces and alerts across apps, AI agents and their dependencies. Every alert will be one someone can actually act on.

 4. You'll lead incident diagnosis, keep runbooks sharp and regularly test recovery, including safe automated rollback.

 5. You'll automate repetitive ops work and use AI to speed up log analysis, root-cause hunting and fixes.

 6. You'll make reliability a shared habit by documenting decisions, setting clear SLOs and helping teams own what they ship.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 1. Strong cloud operations experience, with deep hands-on CI/CD and IaC skills (e.g. Terraform).

 2. Confidence diagnosing distributed systems through logs, metrics and traces, including when the clock is ticking.

 3. Proven hands-on incident response experience. You've been on call, led the fix and written the post-mortem.

 4. Solid scripting skills (e.g. Python, Bash, Go) and strong knowledge of networking, secrets management and service identities.

 5. An AI-first approach to automation. You reach for AI tooling to remove toil, not add it.

 6. Bonus points for GCP, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Airflow, Vercel, Supabase, Kubernetes or OpenTelemetry, plus SLO/error-budget experience.


WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT

 1. Real ownership: You won't just maintain someone else's setup. You'll shape how we build, ship and recover.

 2. Cool stuff, at scale: Your work keeps games running smoothly for millions of players.

 3. No-nonsense culture: We're direct, transparent and accountable. Conversations happen in open Slack channels, outcomes are documented in Monday.com http://Monday.com, and deadlines are agreed, not imposed.

 4. Progress over perfectionism: We ship, learn and improve, and we don't wait for perfect.

 5. Great people only: We have high standards, a strong team spirit and a strict no ass-hole policy.

 6. Connected, wherever you are: We use Google Meet with cameras on, because we like actually knowing each other.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas — nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.

jobs.title: Test Stand Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

TEST STAND MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN

Maintenance technicians at the Rocket Development and Test Facility work in a fast-paced testing environment, where the extraordinary becomes the everyday. This role helps with the build, activation, modification, and improvement of fluid and mechanical systems that test the most powerful high-volume rocket engines in the world. With a focus on repairs and reliability, maintenance technicians are expected to use every tool they have to keep the rocket development and production test stands working well. This work includes performing corrective, preventive, and predictive maintenance on test systems, troubleshooting mechanical and electrical hardware, and giving operations and design feedback to drive improvements across our entire test site.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Modify and maintain test stands and ground support equipment that support testing of fully integrated flight vehicles, individual rocket engines, and various rocket components

• Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair hardware associated with rocket test stand systems, typically part of fluid, structural, and mechanical subsystems

• Maintain structural/mechanical systems and related components such as rollers, bearings, rams, and similar items

• Maintain fluid systems and related components such as process piping, pumps, valves, filters, and similar items

• Collaborate with design and operations engineers to maintain systems in peak operating condition, provide feedback on designs and operations, and promote continual improvement of ground support equipment

• Develop novel methods to streamline and increase the reliability of internal processes across the entire test site

• Follow all regulations and appropriate SpaceX procedures, including quality policies, safety policies, Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), National Electrical Code (NEC), and other standards

• Strong experience with schematics and diagrams for fluid routing, instrumentation, and electrical components

• Experience working in a fast-paced production environment in fields such as power generation, oil and gas, aerospace, automotive, or electronics

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
