jobs.title: Technical Content Writer
jobs.location: San Fransisco, Bay Area OR Pittsburgh, PA OR Austin, TX
jobs.description:
Efficient Computer is rethinking computing from the ground up to solve one of AI's biggest challenges: energy. Our Fabric architecture delivers a 10–100x improvement in energy efficiency for general-purpose computation, including AI, while supporting familiar programming languages and software frameworks—unlocking new possibilities for autonomous machines, intelligent infrastructure, wearables, and space systems. With our first processor, Electron E1, now shipping in volume and more than $97 million in Series B financing recently announced, we're accelerating customer deployments and scaling our architecture to data center performance. Join us to build the hardware and software that bring intelligence wherever it's needed and help shape the next generation of computing.

Efficient Computer is seeking a Technical Content Writer who enjoys figuring out how things work and helping other people understand them. You have an engineering background, and writing is the part of the job you want to spend more time doing.

At Efficient, you will help engineers, product managers, and technology leaders understand what a different processor architecture could make possible for their products. That might mean adding a new feature, running more processing on the device, or extending battery life. Your job is to explain how it works, and show the results.

Much of your work will start with our applications and engineering teams. You will turn their customer applications, benchmarks, and reference designs into useful content for people evaluating our technology. You will also spend time with the hardware yourself: bringing up an Evaluation Kit (EVK), compiling real code with the effcc Compiler, and taking measurements when you need to understand or explain a result. Whether you are working from a teammate’s findings or your own, readers should have enough detail to reproduce the results.

Key Responsibilities

• Write and produce technical content Work with the product, applications, and engineering teams to understand who we need to reach, what questions they have, and where better content would help Turn customer work, benchmarks, and reference designs from the applications team into clear examples of what a product can do with the Electron E1 Write technical blog posts, application notes, white papers, and benchmark reports about the Fabric architecture, compiler behavior, workloads, and application design Write and produce our developer and industry newsletters Help each reader understand what matters to them, whether they are an engineer evaluating the toolchain, a product manager considering a feature, or an executive making an investment decision Write website and solution pages for autonomy, critical infrastructure observability, space and defense, and wearables Script product walkthroughs, demo videos, and short technical explainers, including what viewers should see on screen and how to explain what the hardware is doing Develop the technical story and content for sales presentations, conference talks, and partner briefings, with editable slides that are easy to follow and readable from the back of a room

• Get hands-on with the engineering Bring up evaluation hardware, port and build applications with the effcc Compiler, and set up the instrumentation to measure them Measure energy use and performance, both independently and with the applications team, then analyze the data and create figures that explain the results Review content with the engineers behind the work to check its accuracy before publication Build small demos, sample applications, and reference projects that developers can clone and run Make sure every published number can be traced to the workload and hardware used to measure it

• Help people use what you create Create solution briefs, competitive one-pagers, demo scripts, and trade show content for sales and field teams Run technical webinars and support conference talks and workshops Follow other approaches to energy-efficient computing so we can explain where our technology fits and how it compares Track traffic, search rankings, engagement, and qualified inbound interest, and use what you learn to plan future content Update published content as the product, toolchain, and positioning evolve

Required Qualifications & Experience

• A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or computer science, or equivalent professional experience

• At least three years of experience in semiconductors, embedded systems, or processor and compiler tools, in engineering, marketing, or a combination of the two

• Examples of writing for a technical audience, such as blog posts, application notes, white papers, documentation, or conference papers

• Fluency in C or C++, with the ability to work through an unfamiliar codebase, get it building, and make changes independently

• Experience working with development hardware: bringing up an evaluation board, connecting a sensor, reading a serial console, and debugging a toolchain or an unexpected measurement

• Working knowledge of Python or a similar language for analyzing data, plotting results, and building small internal tools

• The ability to talk through an engineer’s work, understand the details, and explain why it matters to a customer

• Clear writing and a willingness to edit your own work

Desired Qualifications

• Low-power or battery-powered system design, energy measurement, or power profiling tools

• Compilers, instruction set architectures, or dataflow and spatial architectures

• Work with drones and autonomy, industrial monitoring, space and defense, or wearable devices

• Embedded machine learning, digital signal processing, or real-time control

• HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for interactive demos and technical web content

• Creating figures, diagrams, and data visualizations that help explain a technical result

• Speaking at conferences, leading workshops, or building an audience for your work

How we work

We want our content to be as useful and reliable as the engineering behind it. We publish measured results that we can reproduce, and we explain the conditions behind them. You will work directly with our architecture, compiler, applications, and product teams and have access to the hardware. If a claim needs more work before we can stand behind it, we expect you to say so.

We offer a competitive base salary for this role, generally ranging from $120,00-180,000, plus a 10% annual bonus, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits. Final compensation will depend on experience, level, and location, with flexibility for the right candidate.

Why Join Efficient?

Build what's next. At Efficient, you'll tackle big challenges with room to take ownership and make an impact. We back you with competitive pay, equity, a 401(k) match, company-paid benefits, paid parental leave, and flexibility—plus opportunities to grow your skills and career as we scale.

jobs.title: Talent Engagement Lead
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced talent and learning leader who can turn organisational priorities into meaningful employee experiences, development opportunities, and practical solutions?

Do you enjoy partnering with managers and senior leaders to solve real team and organisational challenges, while also building the programmes, systems, and experiences that help employees perform and grow?

Are you excited by the opportunity to lead learning, leadership development, engagement, performance, and employee experience across a distributed pan-African organisation?

If so, the Talent Engagement Lead role at ALX might be the right fit for you. This role leads the Talent Development and Experience function and combines strategy, people leadership, experience design, advisory support, and delivery.

About ALX Africa

ALX Africa, a non-profit organization under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programs. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and re-skill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers.

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programs equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving tech industry. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles in software engineering, data science, and cybersecurity.

We achieve this by:

• Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future.

• Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework.

• Building a lifelong, impactful community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey.

Our impact thus far:

• 205k+ learners since 2021

• 117k youth in work

• 13k youth starting own ventures

• 66k youth in jobs through entrepreneurship

Visit our website www.alxafrica.com to learn more about our digital revolution.

Role Summary

The Talent Development and Experience (TDX) team is responsible for shaping the employee journey at ALX through the learning, experiences, systems, and support that help employees and teams perform, grow, and thrive.

The Talent Engagement Lead sets the direction for TDX and leads a portfolio spanning learning and development, manager and leadership capability, performance enablement, employee engagement, culture, onboarding, organisational change, and major employee experiences.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the role leads the TDX team, contributes to the broader People leadership agenda, and works closely with senior leaders and managers to understand organisational and workforce needs, design practical solutions, and ensure high-quality delivery across the employee experience.

Specific Responsibilities

TDX Strategy and Team Leadership

• Develop and lead ALX’s Talent Development and Experience strategy in line with organisational priorities.

• Lead, coach, and develop the TDX team, setting clear priorities, standards, and performance expectations.

• Oversee the TDX portfolio, budget, external partners, and delivery across the function.

• Advise senior leaders and managers on talent development, team capability, employee experience, engagement, and organisational needs.

Learning, Manager and Leadership Development

• Lead ALX’s employee learning and development strategy and translate organisational needs into relevant development opportunities, pathways, and resources.

• Own manager and leadership development, working with internal specialists and external partners where required.

• Ensure employee learning and development initiatives are practical, well-designed, and evaluated for quality, application, and impact.

• Build and manage the internal and external partnerships needed to deliver high-quality learning and development, including facilitators, coaches, subject-matter experts, and learning providers.

Talent and Employee Experience

• Oversee onboarding, offboarding, role clarity, employee development, and growth pathways.

• Lead the developmental aspects of performance management and partner closely with Talent Operations.

• Partner with managers to understand team capability, development, performance, and workforce needs, and connect them to the right support and solutions.

• Provide talent and development insights that help leaders make informed decisions about employee growth, capability, and succession.

Employee Engagement, Culture and Organisational Experiences

• Lead ALX’s employee engagement strategy, including employee listening, surveys, insights, and action planning.

• Oversee organisational rituals, employee communications, community initiatives, and experiences that strengthen connection and bring ALX’s culture to life.

• Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of major employee experiences, including organisation-wide retreats, leadership retreats, and strategic workshops.

• Support organisational change management by equipping managers and employees with the communication, learning, and engagement needed to navigate change effectively.

Insights, Systems and Continuous Improvement

• Use employee, learning, performance, and engagement data to identify needs and advise senior leaders.

• Establish clear measures of success and use evidence and feedback to continuously improve TDX initiatives and employee experiences.

• Oversee the systems and tools that support learning, engagement, onboarding, performance enablement, and talent development.

• Identify opportunities to simplify and automate TDX processes through technology, AI, and improved ways of working.

Skill Requirements - Essential

• 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in learning and development, talent development, organisational development, employee experience, human resources, or a related field.

• Experience leading a similar function or multidisciplinary team.

• Strong experience developing learning and development strategies and manager or leadership development initiatives.

• Experience designing learning, employee, and organisational experiences that translate clear objectives into meaningful, practical participant journeys.

• Ability to understand organisational and workforce needs and translate them into practical talent, development, and employee experience solutions.

• Strong people leadership, portfolio and programme management, and senior stakeholder management skills.

• Sound understanding of performance management, talent development, employee engagement, organisational change, and the employee lifecycle.

• Experience using employee, learning, performance, or engagement data to inform decisions and improve approaches.

• Experience working across African markets and within cross-cultural, geographically distributed organisations.

• Strong communication, systems thinking, and operational discipline, with the ability to use technology, AI, and automation to improve how work is delivered.

• Experience or qualifications in facilitation, coaching, organisational development, or change management would be advantageous.

Person Specification/Attributes

• Courage: Willingness to speak up, challenge the status quo, and embrace new challenges.

• Humility: Openness to learning, seeking help when needed, and a focus on serving others.

• Adventure: A passion for setting ambitious goals, tackling difficult tasks, and finding joy in the journey.

• Initiative: Proactive problem-solving, a sense of ownership, and a willingness to go above and beyond.

• Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks, persevere through challenges, and emerge stronger.

• Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect organisational priorities, employee evidence, and talent solutions.

• Systems Mindset: Ability to see how learning, leadership, performance, culture, technology, and employee experience interact.

• Collaboration: Strong partnership and influencing skills across senior leaders, managers, teams, and external partners.

• Communication: Ability to simplify complex information and communicate with clarity and credibility.

• Execution Excellence: Strong planning, prioritisation, judgement, and follow-through.

Employment Type

This role is a full-time position.

Preferred Time Zones

The preferred time zones are GMT +2/SAST/CAT

Due to the considerable amount of virtual work and interaction with colleagues and customers in different physical locations internationally, it is essential that the successful applicant has the drive and ethic to succeed working in small teams physically but in greater efforts virtually. Self-driven communication through web collaboration and video conferencing is essential.

jobs.title: Account Lead, Influencer Marketing, Sports & Entertainment (Fully Remote)
jobs.description:
ABOUT KYRA

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.



👋 ABOUT THE ROLE

Permanent · Full-Time · US-based · EST Hours
Target Start Date: November 2026

We're hiring an Account Director for one of our biggest sports and entertainment clients. The work covers sportsbook, fantasy and live events, and the campaigns are judged on views, CPV and how quickly we can get from brief to live post.

You'll own this one account end to end, with two Campaign Managers reporting into you.

The account is newly won and growing quickly into the end of the year. An interim lead is running it until then, so you'll get a proper handover and join with campaigns already live.

We're looking for someone who has spent at least five years agency-side running creator programmes in sports betting, DFS or around the NFL and NBA, and who can show us the numbers behind that work.




🏟️ WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

One account, in depth. Most Account Director roles, run a portfolio of clients and build CM teams underneath them. This role is responsible for one is a single client. We need someone who understands sports, betting and the US creator space properly.

Senior and hands-on. You're the client's senior contact and you're also across the detail every day: who has been outreached, what's stuck in contracting, which draft is late, whether spend is on pace. You run the operations yourself.

Structure matters. This client tracks delivery milestones, feedback windows and their own dependencies against a timeline. You bring the process, keep the client to their side of it and keep everyone on top of dates.

Speed matters. Campaigns are built around games and moments. Turnaround from brief to live is one of the things we measure you on.

The category has rules. Sportsbook and fantasy content comes with age gates, state restrictions and platform policies. You need to already know how these work.

It moves fast. Briefs land with short lead times, priorities change with the sports calendar, and the client expects answers the same day. You need to be comfortable working at that pace without letting quality slip.

We are an AI-native business. Kyra is Claude-first and our campaign workflows run through our own proprietary platform, built with AI at the core. On top of that there is plenty of room to use AI tools to make your own working day more efficient. We are not looking for someone who is open to AI. We are looking for someone who is already getting real value from it: building their own workflows, automating the repetitive parts of the job and using the time saved to think harder about the client. You will be expected to bring that with you.




🏈 WHAT YOU'LL DO: THE GAME PLAN

Grow the client relationship. Grow the client relationship. You own the client relationship and retention on this account, and you’re measured on net revenue retention (NRR). You are the client’s senior contact at Kyra, accountable for strategy, approvals, escalations and commercial conversations. You keep them informed, manage their expectations and identify what we should be doing next with them. 🏆

Agree how the account runs. You own the operating playbook: casting, outreach, contracting, briefing, review, approval, go-live and reporting. You keep it current, and when a process is slowing delivery you change it. 📋

Make the casting calls. You set the casting strategy for every campaign: creator profile, tier, mix and volume. You set the negotiation approach on fees and usage rights and approve deals before contracting. You are responsible for compliance: 21+, state restrictions, platform policy and disclosure. 🎯

Execute delivery every day. You oversee every live campaign from first outreach to the moment content goes live. You know the status of every workstream, surface risk early and protect the quality of what we put out. ⚡

Pace the budget. You track creator spend and delivery against the contracted plan, flag variances early and adjust allocation to protect both performance and margin. 💸

Lead the team. You manage two Campaign Managers. You set priorities, review their work, give direct and constructive feedback and develop their skills. 🤝

Analyse performance. You agree KPIs with the client before launch, monitor performance in flight and adjust creator mix, creative or distribution when the data calls for it. 📊

Next campaign, stronger. Every campaign ends with a debrief. You take what we learned into the next brief so the account keeps improving. 🔁




📈 HOW WE'LL KNOW IT'S WORKING

We measure success by what the brand gets from us. 

The brand hits its moments. Content is live when the game, the fixture or the launch happens. Creators are contracted, posts are delivered and volumes are met on the timelines the client has planned around.

The brand gets the reach it paid for. Blended CPM and CPV come in at or better than the agreed rate on every campaign.

The brand can react quickly. Turnaround from brief to live is short enough that the client can respond to a result, a trade or a trending moment with creator content.

The brand trusts the delivery. The account runs on a documented playbook, feedback windows and dependencies are tracked, and issues leave meetings with an owner and a date. The client does not need to chase us.

The brand brings us the next brief. The client renews because the work is good and the relationship is easy, and comes to Kyra first with new ideas. Revenue growth is shared with Client Solutions. The client's confidence in delivery sits with you.

What good looks like by month six. The account is running to plan without the interim lead, the client has signed off the operating cadence, rates are being met or beaten, and your two Campaign Managers can each run a campaign end to end on their own.




🙋 WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

 - 5+ years agency-side running creator programmes for sportsbook, DFS or fantasy brands, or US league partnerships (NFL, NBA)

 - Real numbers: CPV targets you've hit, creator and post volumes per month, typical turnaround from outreach to live

 - You've owned a senior client relationship yourself, including the difficult conversations

 - You've managed Campaign Managers while staying close to the work

 - You're fluent in views, CPV and CPM and can turn performance data into clear recommendations

 - You know FTC disclosure and the compliance rules around betting content

 - US-based, working EST hours

 - Not currently working on a competing sportsbook, DFS or betting brand

 - Organised, direct and calm when plans change at short notice

 - Experience in a fast-growing business or account, where the scope, the team and the client's expectations have scaled quickly and you have had to keep delivery steady through it

 - Already using Claude or similar AI tools to do real work, with your own workflows for casting, research, reporting or client comms, and able to show what they have saved you or improved
   


📅 WEEKEND WORK

Campaigns go live around games, fixtures and events, so this role involves some weekend work. Please only apply if you're open to that.

Kyra reserves the right to amend your duties from time to time in line with the needs of the business.

💟 Support

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy https://www.bamboohr.com/legal/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Talent Scout
jobs.description:
ABOUT DISTYL AI 

Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations.

We research and deploy technologies that power AI-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys.

Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board-members of 20+ F500s. 




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The exceptional people we assemble are the source of Distyl's competitive advantage. The quality of our work is set by who we find before anyone else does.

Most companies run recruiting as a process that fills seats. We want a hunter: someone who would rather spend a month landing one exceptional person than a week closing three adequate ones.

This is a scouting role -  you develop an independent view of exceptional talent and persuade others through evidence. You will work with the founders and executive-team, own the front of the funnel, and partner with the Recruiting team on sourcing, process and closing. 

This role is not for you if:

 - You consider a search done once the seat is filled.

 - Your first instinct when a role opens is to post it and wait.

 - You know only one way to open a door.

 - You want to run scouting from a desk alone. This role lives in conversations.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Judgement: Form an independent view of exceptional talent before the credentials make it obvious. Back your judgment with evidence, track your accuracy, and learn when you're wrong.

 - Build the Talent Map: Know the best people in our target markets, where they are, and what would move them. Most will not be looking.

 - Pursue the Unreachable: When a hiring manager says the profile does not exist, you find three.

 - Run Scouting Like a Business: Prioritized markets, a pipeline, a cadence, and conversion you understand at every stage.

 - Own the Outcome: You are measured on the quality of who we land, judged a year in. The funnel numbers are how you get there.




WHO YOU ARE

Recruiting experience is optional. Exceptional talent judgment is not. You need a track record of deal-making and running a funnel with outsized success: a super-connector, a headhunter, a sports scout , a founder who hired the first twenty, or a background we have not thought of.

 - Outsized Results in a Funnel You Owned: Pipeline from nothing, conversion well above peers. Bring the numbers.

 - Judgment: You recognize exceptional people others overlook. You've been right when others weren't, and can explain both your best calls and your mistakes.

 - Persistent Without Ego: You find a sixth way through a closed door, know when to change your mind, and earn the respect of people you don't land.

 - Demonstrated Excellence Before This: Academic, commercial, entrepreneurial, competitive, or otherwise.

 - Travel: 20%.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within 6 months: a map of exceptional people in our priority markets, a pipeline of people who weren't looking, and hires conventional recruiting would have missed. You have a clear record of your scouting convictions, the evidence behind them, and what you've learned from the outcomes.

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary, plus meaningful equity and a comprehensive benefits package

 - The opportunity to build a new, strategically critical function with direct access to Distyl's founders

 - 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents; flexible time off; 401(k), HSA, FSA, and commuter accounts; wellness and family-building benefits through Carrot; in-office lunches

 - A mission-driven, fast-moving culture that values curiosity, pragmatism, and excellence

Distyl has offices in San Francisco and New York. This role follows a hybrid collaboration model with 3+ days per week (Tuesday–Thursday) in-office.

We're grateful for the strong interest in this role. The best way to get your profile in front of our team is to apply directly through our careers page, where all applications are reviewed. We will be in touch with every applicant once we've completed our review, regardless of the decision.



We believe diverse perspectives make our work stronger and more impactful. We are an equal opportunity employer and evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Welder (Starship) - Night Shift
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

WELDER (STARSHIP) - NIGHT SHIFT

Welders at Starbase, TX, build, maintain, and upgrade structural, fluid, and launch pad systems to support Starship launch campaigns. This welder will work with an elite team of fabricators to rapidly build and weld large assemblies, structural stands, tubing, piping, and launch pad infrastructure at our South Texas facility.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Complete welding assignments and procedures for the construction, repair, and upgrade of site structural stands, launch pad structures, and fluid systems on time, safely, and in a professional manner

• Weld using flux-cored arc welding (FCAW), gas metal arc welding (GMAW), shielded metal arc welding (SMAW), and gas tungsten arc welding (GTAW) processes on carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum structural shapes, tubing, and piping

• Cut, trim, scarf, fit, and fabricate metal components and weldments to dimensions for building and assembling test site and launch pad structural forms using standard tools, materials, motions, and practices of the welding trade

• Collaborate with the lead welder to ensure the proper weld procedure, type of material, and rod/filler size are accurately assessed for each welding project

• Under the supervision of a lead welder, analyze and review engineering drawings and specifications to plan welding operations where procedural information is unavailable

• Utilize hand welding, flame-cutting, and related equipment to weld together metal components and parts to assemble structural forms and launch pad systems

• Ability to visually inspect own welds per American Welding Society (AWS) D1.1 and American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) B31.3 (normal and high-pressure service) with proper training

• Obtain and maintain internal licenses, operator permits, or certifications as required

• Make a continuous effort to improve operations, decrease turnaround times, streamline work processes, and work cooperatively and jointly

• Work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities based on program needs

• Perform other related duties, as assigned, for the purpose of ensuring an efficient and effective work environment

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 2+ years of hands-on experience with at least one of the following: shielded metal arc welding (SMAW), gas metal arc welding (GMAW), gas tungsten arc welding (GTAW), or flux-cored arc welding (FCAW), including gas-shielded FCAW (FCAW-G); experience from a college or vocational welding program qualifies

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 5+ years of experience in one or more of the following processes: FCAW, SMAW, GTAW, and GMAW

• Experience as a combo welder with the ability to fabricate and weld carbon structure, carbon pipe, stainless pipe, and aluminum

• 5+ years of professional experience in GTAW welding with one or more of the following materials: SCH 10 stainless steel pipe, SCH 10 carbon steel pipe

• 5+ years of professional experience in FCAW welding with stainless steel and/or carbon steel

• Previous welding qualifications in accordance with one or more governing codes: AWS D1.1, AWS D1.2, AWS D1.6, AWS D17.1, or ASME Section IX

• Highly proficient in tube/pipe cutting, grinding, and fabrication

• Knowledge of DC GTAW welding techniques and engineering requirements

• Knowledge of standard tools, materials, motions, and practices of the welding trade

• Knowledge of occupational hazards and effective safety precautions of the trade

• Knowledge of arc air procedures and equipment

• Experience with overhead cranes and forklifts

• Use of precision measuring instruments

• Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a fast-paced, challenging work environment

• Familiarity with computer systems

• Ability to read and interpret blueprints and isometric drawings

• Ability to perform fit-ups of various structures and piping

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Valid driver’s license

• Typically exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain

• Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise

• Must be available for overtime and weekends, as the schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility is required

• Typical hours for this position are Monday - Friday, 6:00 pm – 6:00 am

• Stand: Up to 10 hours per day

• Sit: Up to 10 hours per day

• Push/Pull: Up to 75lbs. (unassisted) between 1 to 2 hours per day

• Overhead reach: Up to 10 hours per day

• Walk: Up to 10 hours per day

• Lift/Carry: Up to ≤ 50 lbs. (unassisted) between 1 to 2 hours per day

• Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 6 hours per day

• Kneel/Crouch: Up to 10 hours per day

• Upper body twist: Up to 6 hours per day

• Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees for 6 hours or more per day

• Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500ft), in confined spaces, operating heavy equipment and machinery, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description. Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. This is a long-term, full-time, onsite position. jobs.description:
ABOUT FACTORY



Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly organized and execution-oriented professional to join our Executive Operations Team. In this role, you will be the right hand to our COO and will work closely with the CEO’s Executive Operations Partner.

This is a dynamic role in a high agency environment that requires swift and pragmatic decision making, an ability to navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and a hunger to build as Factory scales rapidly. As an early member of the ExecOps team, you will help define what operational excellence looks like and become a deeply embedded partner with your respective teams.

 - Own end-to-end interactions with candidates, customers, investors, and board members, ensuring communications are prompt and polished.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - Extremely organized and accountable; skilled at managing multiple competing priorities.

 - Proactive; you identify gaps, conflicts, and risks before they become issues.

 - Highly responsive; comfortable with regular text communication and quick decision-making.

 - Detail-oriented with exceptional accuracy and follow-through.

 - A confident communicator who represents leadership with professionalism and discretion.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity, autonomy, and scaling systems in a startup environment.

NICE TO HAVE

jobs.title: Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Analyst (NYC or Washington D.C.)
jobs.description:
Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, Peregrine helps public safety organizations, state and local and governments, federal agencies, and private-sector institutions address society’s challenges with unprecedented speed and accuracy. Our AI-enabled platform turns siloed and disconnected data into operational intelligence — instantly surfacing mission-critical information to empower better, faster decisions that improve outcomes at every touchpoint. Today Peregrine supports hundreds of customers across 30+ states and two countries, serving more than 125 million people — and we’re amplifying our impact as we expand into the enterprise and internationally.

The Role

We’re looking for a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Analyst to help strengthen and scale our security and compliance program. In this role, you’ll support developing and maintaining frameworks that ensure our organization meets key regulatory, contractual, and operational standards across data protection, privacy, and security.

You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and leadership teams to maintain compliance with frameworks like SOC 2, CJIS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, GDPR, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP as our business expands across new markets and government sectors. This position is ideal for someone who’s detail-oriented, collaborative, and excited to build structured compliance practices that make a real impact on security and trust.

What You’ll Do

• Support the implementation, tracking, and continuous improvement of compliance frameworks (SOC 2, CJIS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, GDPR, FedRAMP, NIST 800-53).

• Manage and organize compliance documentation, internal audits, and evidence collection for both internal and external stakeholders.

• Collaborate with internal teams to update policies, procedures, and controls related to data protection, access management, and incident response.

• Maintain strong awareness of security best practices in cloud environments - particularly AWS - including services like GuardDuty, SecurityHub, Amazon Inspector, and AWS Config.

• Use compliance management tools such as Vanta, Drata, SecureFrame, or HyperProof to streamline reporting and evidence collection.

• Partner with technical teams to ensure identity and access management (IAM), MFA, and least-privilege principles are applied correctly.

• Contribute to audit readiness and help respond to customer and vendor compliance inquiries.

• Be based in one of our hubs, with a 4-day-per-week in-office requirement.

About You

• Experience: 7-10 years of experience in information security, compliance, or risk management within regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance or government).

• Framework Familiarity: Working knowledge of SOC 2, HIPAA, CJIS, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, or similar frameworks.

• Technical Knowledge: Understanding of cloud-native SaaS environments, microservices, VPCs/VPNs, and identity management concepts such as RBAC and MFA.

• Detail-Oriented: You thrive on structure, accuracy, and organization - especially when managing documentation and multiple compliance tasks.

• Collaborative & Curious: You enjoy learning from others, contributing to shared goals, and improving processes along the way.

• Clear Communicator: You can translate complex security concepts into simple, actionable language for different audiences.

Preferred Certifications

• Governance & Compliance: CGRC, CISSP, CISA, CIPP/US, HCISPP, CompTIA Security+.

• Cloud Security: CCSP, CCSK, AWS Security – Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect – Associate, or CompTIA Cloud+.

Bonus Points

• Experience working with public safety, justice, or government agencies, or other highly regulated data environments.

• Familiarity with CJIS, SOC-2 or overlapping control frameworks.

• Passion for building scalable, user-friendly compliance systems in a fast-growing organization.

NOTE: This role requires you to be in the office 4 days a week in either our NYC or Washington D.C. office location

$150,000—$165,000 USD

Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, certifications or licenses, and specific work location. Information on the benefits offered is here.

jobs.title: Analytical Chemist
jobs.description:
MAKING THE METALS POWERING THE WORLD

Solcoa is building the next generation of American metalmaking, starting with rare earths — the metals of power and motion. We've developed a new chemistry that converts rare earth oxides into high-purity metals — the materials inside every EV, fighter jet, wind turbine, and data center — cleaner, cheaper, and faster than any conventional process. Now we're scaling it to thousands of tonnes of annual production.


THE ROLE

We’re hiring an Analytical Chemist to operate our analytical instruments and characterize rare earth materials. You’ll prepare and analyze oxide feedstocks, process intermediates, metals, alloys and powders, and report results to our research and production teams. This is a hands-on laboratory role focused on sample preparation, instrument operation, routine maintenance and accurate, repeatable measurements.

Our analytical tools include ICP-OES, ICP-MS, SEM-EDX, particle size analysis, XRD and inert gas fusion (IGF). This is a full-time, on-site position in Alameda, California.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Operate ICP-OES and ICP-MS to measure rare earth content, metallic impurities and product purity using established methods; help improve methods as needed.

 - Prepare samples and standards, including representative sampling, digestion and dilution. Control contamination and oxidation when handling reactive metals and powders.

 - Use SEM-EDX to investigate morphology and elemental distribution, XRD to identify crystalline phases, and particle size analysis to characterize powder distributions.

 - Measure oxygen, nitrogen and hydrogen using inert gas fusion, with sample preparation and calibration appropriate to the material and instrument.

 - Run quality controls using blanks, reference materials, calibration checks, spikes and duplicates. Review results against method acceptance criteria and investigate matrix effects, interferences and unexpected readings.

 - Maintain and troubleshoot instruments, track performance, and coordinate service and consumables to keep the lab running reliably.

 - Work with research and production teams to investigate unexpected results, identify contamination sources, close elemental balances and improve product consistency.

 - Write SOPs, maintain traceable sample and data records, and prepare clear analytical reports for process development, product qualification and quality control.

 - Maintain safe practices for acids, reactive powders, compressed gases and laboratory waste, and train teammates on established methods.


WHAT YOU BRING


REQUIRED

 - BS or higher in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Materials Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Typically 3+ years of relevant analytical laboratory experience. Substantial hands-on graduate research counts.

 - Strong hands-on experience operating ICP-OES or ICP-MS, including sample preparation, calibration, routine maintenance and troubleshooting.

 - A rigorous approach to analytical quality: you can distinguish a material problem from a sampling, preparation or measurement problem.

 - Ability to interpret data, document methods and explain results clearly to engineers and production teams.

 - Ability to follow SOPs, manage a daily sample queue and adapt to changing research and production priorities.


PREFERRED

 - Experience with rare earths, high-purity metals, inorganic materials, mining, metallurgy or advanced materials manufacturing.

 - Hands-on experience with SEM-EDX/EDS, XRD, particle size analysis or IGF/LECO O/N/H systems.

 - Experience with difficult inorganic digestions, trace impurity analysis, air-sensitive materials or glovebox handling.

 - Familiarity with laboratory quality systems, customer qualification testing, or data analysis using Python, spreadsheets or LIMS.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Base salary within the posted range, based on relevant experience, analytical expertise and scope of responsibility.

 - Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance.

 - Company-provided lunch daily.

 - Visa sponsorship available if needed.

jobs.title: Head of Deployments
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Kastle is building the AI employee for financial services. We work with some of America's largest banks, helping them scale their operations using autonomous AI Agents that process payments, originate loans, and help customers get a world class experience during some of the biggest financial decisions of their lives.

We've processed over $2 billion in transactions and are backed by Insight Partners and Y Combinator. If you are interested in building AI that is applied in the real world where precision, reliability, and performance matter and redefine access to credit across the world, apply below.

We just raised a $24M Series A and are growing fast!




ABOUT THE ROLE

Kastle is hiring its first Head of Deployments to build the team that takes our AI agents from signed contract to live production inside banks, lenders and mortgage servicers.

Kastle is the AI workforce platform for financial services, starting with consumer lending. Our voice, SMS and workflow agents collect payments, answer borrower questions and qualify loan inquiries, working on top of the systems lenders already run, such as ICE MSP, rather than replacing them. We're a San Francisco team backed by Insight Partners, Y Combinator, Commerce Ventures and Fifth Wall, and we closed a $24M Series A in September 2026.

You'll report to the CEO and own every customer deployment end to end. You'll lead forward deployed engineers, deployment PMs and process specialists who embed with lending operations teams, scope workflows, integrate with core systems and get agents into production safely. As we scale across banks and financial institutions globally, you'll turn bespoke rollouts into a repeatable deployment engine.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and scale the deployments org. Hire, develop and retain forward deployed engineers, deployment PMs and lending process specialists. Set the hiring bar and team structure as we grow from a handful of deployments to dozens running at once.

 - Own delivery for every customer. Be accountable for time-to-live, quality and adoption at each bank, credit union, lender and servicer. Run kickoffs, scoping, integration, UAT and go-live, and step in personally on the hardest accounts.

 - Make deployments repeatable. Turn one-off rollouts into playbooks, reusable integration patterns (servicing cores, LOS, dialers, CRMs) and tooling that cut deployment time with each customer.

 - Get compliance right from day one. Partner with customers' risk, compliance and InfoSec teams on vendor reviews, model risk management and consumer protection rules (TCPA, FDCPA/Reg F, UDAAP) so agents launch safely and audit-ready.

 - Feed the product roadmap. Turn what you learn in the field into clear product requirements. Work closely with Engineering and Product on what becomes platform versus what stays custom.

 - Partner with Sales and Customer Success. Join late-stage deals to scope solutions credibly, define clean handoffs from sale to deployment to ongoing success, and help expand accounts after launch.

 - Bring operational rigor. Define engagement models and deployment pricing, plan capacity for a scarce team, track deployment metrics, and report customer outcomes to leadership and in customer QBRs.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years in technical, customer-facing roles, with 4+ years leading deployment, solutions engineering, professional services or implementation teams

 - A track record of building a team or service line from early stage and scaling it through rapid growth

 - Hands-on experience deploying enterprise software into regulated environments, ideally banks, lenders, mortgage servicers or other financial institutions

 - Strong technical depth: APIs, system integrations, data pipelines and the SDLC, enough to unblock engineers and earn trust from customer IT teams

 - Working knowledge of LLMs, AI agents or conversational AI, and sound judgment on where they work in production and where they don't

jobs.title: Accounting Project and Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Burkland's core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals as they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content because we are an industry thought leader. Startups trust our expertise, so founders can focus on their companies, products, and value-add. Because of our demonstrated value, our clients have raised more than $17.8B!

At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees.

We are a remote-first company with over 185 team members, more than 800 clients, and a culture built on doing meaningful work with people who genuinely care about helping our clients grow. Come build something with us!




ROLE SUMMARY

The Accounting Project and Implementation Specialist executes  BKA's project-based accounting work and provides support for group-wide process and system implementations. Operating outside recurring monthly production, this role directly manages finite engagements like historical cleanups, new-client onboardings, and other client project requests. Additionally, it assists the broader team in testing, adopting, and refining new software and workflows designed to improve efficiency

Assigning a dedicated owner to client projects ensures clear accountability from kickoff through handoff. This structure protects production team members from ad hoc project demands, allowing them to remain fully focused on their recurring client portfolios.

Success in this role means engagements delivered accurately, on scope, and within budget; clean, well-documented handoffs to the production team; championing new initiatives under the guidance of the Director, and helping implement new tools that improve efficiency and quality across the division's client work.

This job description outlines the core of the role, but it isn't meant to cover everything you'll do. As Burkland grows, your responsibilities may shift and new projects, tasks, or priorities may be added along the way. We hope you'll see that as a chance to stretch, learn, and broaden your skills.




ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Project Delivery & Scope Management

 - Project manage and execute historical cleanup and new-client onboarding/implementation engagements to the agreed scope and timeline

 - Reconstruct and reconcile historical records, correct prior-period errors, and bring client books to a reliable, close-ready state

 - Set up new client accounting environments, including chart of accounts, opening balances, and connections to supporting systems, in line with BKA standards

 - Flag scope changes and discoveries during an engagement that affect pricing, and raise them promptly so they are resolved before work continues

 - Track hours against the quote in real time throughout each engagement, not just at the end, to catch overruns early

 - Maintain transparent communication with the ongoing production team throughout each engagement

 - At the conclusion of each engagement, provide a documented final deliverable that transitions operational accounting responsibilities seamlessly, covering account status, open items, and client-specific processes

Process Improvement and AI

 - Use AI tools and firm systems to accelerate cleanup, reconciliation, and review work, with appropriate human review and protection of client data

 - Document repeatable approaches for cleanup and implementation work so engagements become more consistent over time

 - Share actual hours and lessons learned from completed engagements to improve how future cleanup and implementation work is scoped and quoted

 - Test and support implementation of new tools, systems and processes
   
   


CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

 - Technical accounting judgment — Knows what accurate, close-ready books look like and can quickly spot what is off in unfamiliar or messy records.

 - Attention to detail — Reviews work thoroughly and consistently, catching errors others miss without losing sight of materiality.

 - Project management — Plans and runs multiple engagements/projects at once, setting timelines and milestones, prioritizing competing deadlines, and keeping clients, production team, and Director informed of status at every stage.

 - AI fluency — Hands-on comfort using AI tools in accounting and operational work, with sound judgment about where AI adds value, where human review is required, and how to protect client data.

 - Communication  - Serves as the client's main point of contact during cleanup and implementation, setting expectations, requesting missing information, and explaining findings and scope changes in plain terms. Keeps the production team updated on progress, open issues, and client-specific details throughout the engagement so nothing is a surprise at handoff.

Minimum Requirements

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work history

 - 5+ years of hands-on accounting work, including month-end close, account reconciliations, and accrual-basis financial statement preparation under U.S. GAAP

 - Experience creating new processes and being a change champion for new tools and processes that improve efficiency

 - Demonstrated ability to complete historical cleanup and catch-up engagements, including reconstructing records from incomplete or inconsistent source data

 - Background in new-client implementation, such as chart of accounts design, opening balance setup, and connecting supporting systems

 - Comfort working within fixed-fee or budgeted scopes and tracking time against them

 - Ability to manage several concurrent engagements independently in a remote environment

 - Strong organizational skills and project management skills




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - CPA license, or active progress toward one

 - Prior work in an outsourced or fractional accounting firm serving startups or venture-backed companies

 - History of building quality control checklists, review standards, or process documentation

 - Hands-on use of AI tools in accounting workflows




PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

This is a remote position. Work is primarily performed at a computer for extended periods, requiring the ability to use a keyboard, view a screen, and communicate via video and phone. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.




EEO STATEMENT

Burkland Associates is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Burkland Associates is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or another legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please visit our careers page https://burklandassociates.com/careers/. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.



The base pay range target for the role described in this job description is 115,000-130,000. Final offer amounts depend on multiple factors such as candidate experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data. In addition, full-time regular positions are eligible for, 401(k), health benefits, and other benefits; some of these benefits may be available for part-time.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role:

We are looking for a strategic and results-oriented Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team as the operational backbone of our Partner Experience (PX) organization — Partner Success, Clinical Success, Implementation, Support, and PX Ops. In this key role, you will own the systems, workflows, and analytics that power PX — including administration of Planhat and Zendesk — while keeping the post-sale motion tightly aligned with Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

As a trusted partner to leadership, you will provide actionable insights that align operations with company goals, helping to accelerate growth and optimize the partner journey — from implementation through expansion and renewal.

What You'll Do:

 - Own the PX Tech Stack: Serve as administrator and product owner for Planhat and Zendesk — health scoring, playbooks, workflows, triggers, SLAs, routing, Salesforce integrations, and reporting. Assist with administration of our LMS/CMS platforms supporting partner education and enablement. Continuously improve these systems so PX teams maintain optimal performance.

 - Optimize Operational Workflows: Design, refine, QA, and implement workflows and processes that enable PX teams to operate at peak efficiency. Streamline operations to ensure seamless handoffs across the full partner lifecycle — from deal close through implementation, clinical adoption, support, and renewal.

 - Empower Data-Driven Insights and Strategic Decisions: Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that provide leadership with real-time visibility into key metrics, including partner health, adoption and utilization, support volume and SLA attainment, and retention trends. Use data to drive actionable strategies that improve decision making and operational performance.

 - Enhance Revenue & Forecast Clarity: Partner with Finance to support renewal and retention forecasting, analyze commission reports, and generate revenue-related insights that align with business goals and drive clarity across the organization.

 - Business Partner to PX Leadership: Act as the dedicated operations partner to leaders across Partner Success, Clinical Success, Implementation, Support, and PX Ops — translating their priorities into systems, process, and reporting, and representing PX needs in cross-functional RevOps planning with Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

What You'll Bring:

 - 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Customer Success Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar role in a SaaS company (healthcare experience is a plus).

 - Extensive experience with SaaS tools such as Salesforce, Planhat (or Gainsight/similar CS platform), Zendesk, and exposure to LMS/CMS administration. Administration experience with a CS platform or support platform strongly preferred.

 - Strong understanding of go-to-market strategies and key metrics that influence success in Sales, Marketing, and Partner Success.

 - Direct experience business-partnering with post-sale leadership — Customer/Partner Success, Clinical or Implementation teams, or Support — you understand how these functions operate and what they need from operations.

 - Fluency in post-sale metrics: net revenue retention, gross retention, adoption and utilization, NPS, CSAT, and support SLA performance.

 - Exceptional AI and Business Intelligence experience (Claude, OpenAI, Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, Business Intelligence tools, etc.), with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable operational plans.

 - Proven track record in building and maintaining commercial dashboards and reports that provide clarity and support data-driven decision-making.

 - Demonstrated ability to align cross-functional teams around shared goals, priorities, and revenue-driving strategies.

 - Excellent project management skills, with a history of successfully leading and driving complex initiatives to completion.

 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across teams.

 - A proactive, problem-solving mindset, with a focus on continuous improvement and operational scalability.


WHY WORK AT ABRIDGE?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.



HOW WE TAKE CARE OF ABRIDGERS:

 - Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

 - Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

 - Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

 - Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

 - Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

 - 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

 - Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

 - Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

 - Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

 - Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

 - Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

 - Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

 - ... and much more!


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.




STAYING SAFE - PROTECT YOURSELF FROM RECRUITMENT FRAUD

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com http://abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/05/scammers-are-hijacking-job-ads-heres-how-spot-fakes. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

jobs.description:
ABOUT NORY

Join NORY, the premier STEM camp provider in NYC and Boston, where we shape the future leaders, innovators, and problem solvers. With over 4,000 campers annually across 10+ locations, our camps offer a magical and transformative experience akin to the Disney World of STEM education.  - Instagram: bit.ly/noryi http://bit.ly/noryi

 - LinkedIn: bit.ly/norylink http://bit.ly/norylink

 - Summer Camp Video: bit.ly/noryvideo1 http://bit.ly/noryvideo1

 


WE'RE SEEKING A ROCKSTAR SCHOOL BREAK DAY CAMP SITE LEADER

Are you ready to lead a campsite to success? As we prepare for our upcoming School Break Day Camps, we’re looking for passionate and experienced Site Leaders to join our NYC team and share their availability for upcoming camp dates.

In this role, you will inspire and support our educators, ensuring they have a happy and rewarding experience at our School Break Day Camps. You will show love and care to our campers, deliver the highest level of customer support to parents, and guide our staff to shine.

Our School Break Day Camps take place on select days and school breaks when schools are closed throughout the year, making this a great opportunity for experienced educational leaders looking for flexible leadership opportunities that fit their availability.

 


WHY WORKING AS A SCHOOL BREAK DAY CAMP SITE LEADER ROCKS

 - Professional Development in Leadership: Enhance your leadership abilities and build a strong track record for your resume. Our role is designed to prepare you for future leadership positions.

 - Training in Diverse STEM Topics: Develop your skills in a variety of STEM areas, including robotics, coding, and woodworking. No prior STEM experience? No worries. We offer comprehensive training that can be transferable to your future educational career.

 - Build Lasting Professional Relationships: Join a community of dedicated, excellence driven colleagues.

 - Pathway to Continued Opportunities: Access a development pipeline that supports sustainable professional growth and provides additional opportunities to stay involved with NORY throughout the year.

 


SCHOOL BREAK DAY CAMP SITE LEADER RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Teach and Inspire: Lead your assigned group of campers with engaging activities that bring NORY’s core values to life, inspiring curiosity and enthusiasm.

 - Coach and Train Educators: Mentor and develop our teaching staff, ensuring they grasp the purpose behind each activity and properly implement protocols to create a fun and safe camp environment.

 - Nurture and Support Campers and Their Families: Build nurturing and supportive relationships with NORY campers and their families to enhance the camp experience for everyone involved.

 - Resource Management: Efficiently oversee and manage essential resources necessary for the success of our NORY camps, including materials, facilities, and daily schedules.

 - Administrative Oversight: Keep accurate and up to date administrative records for all aspects of camp, ensuring smooth operations and compliance.

 


SCHOOL BREAK DAY CAMP SITE LEADER QUALIFICATIONS

 - You have experience managing and coaching a team of 4+ teachers and fostering a positive team environment.

 - You have a track record of building strong relationships with families in a camp or educational setting.

 - You have more than 4 years of experience, preferred, teaching children ages 3 to 13 in any subject or discipline, preferably with a focus on STEM.

 - You demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to learn and adopt new technology and skills.

 


SCHOOL BREAK DAY CAMP SITE LEADER COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Schedule: 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM

 - Compensation: $200 to $210/day
   
   - Additional $20/hour for extended care until 5:00 PM
   
   - Includes attendance at one lab camp session, ranging from 1 to 5 days.

 - Benefits: 401 (k) plan available to eligible employees.

 


BEYOND DAY CAMPS

At NORY, the opportunity to make an impact continues beyond our School Break Day Camps. We also offer opportunities through afterschool programs, birthday parties, and special events, giving you additional ways to stay involved with NORY, continue developing your leadership skills, and make an impact on our campers and community throughout the year.


TEAM CULTURE

We’re searching for Site Leaders who are not just skilled and experienced but also align deeply with our core values. At NORY, our "Ways of Being" guide everything we do:

 - We are purposeful in our actions, always asking "why" to cultivate inner motivation.

 - We are unifiers, fostering a loving and caring team environment that deeply values empathy and compassion.

 - We ask "how to make it work" before wondering "if it will be possible."

 - Our decisions are grounded in data and logic.

 - We actively seek feedback, embracing different perspectives and effective methods that contribute to our growth.

 - We avoid superficial solutions, opting instead to thoroughly analyze problems to create sustainable, scalable responses.

These aren’t just words. They’re the essence of our DNA. If these values speak to you, see how you align with our complete "Ways of Being" at www.nory.co/value http://www.nory.co/value.

 


APPLICATION PROCESS

Please submit your resume and cover letter, detailing your passion for this position and your approach to leading a successful and joyful site. If you have a special reason for wanting to join our team, please send your application directly to Liza@nory.co.

 

NORY New York is a proud equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.



Position Summary

The Senior Customer Success Engineer (Senior CSE) is an advanced technical role within the Customer Success organization, serving as a subject matter expert and escalation point for complex, high-impact technical challenges. Building on the foundation of the CSE role, the Senior CSE handles the most technically demanding and strategically significant issues, provides mentorship to CSE peers, and drives the development of scalable processes, tooling, and knowledge assets that elevate the entire team’s capabilities. This pooled, non-billable role supports CSMs across the full Delinea product portfolio (excluding FastPath) and operates with a high degree of autonomy.




What You’ll Do

• Serve as the top-tier technical escalation point for CSMs and CSEs on the most complex, multi-product, or high-severity issues involving Delinea’s product portfolio (excluding FastPath).

• Lead root-cause analysis for persistent or cross-functional technical challenges, coordinating across engineering, product, and support teams to drive resolution and communicate findings.

• Provide strategic technical advisory to CSMs for the organization’s largest and most complex enterprise accounts, including architecture reviews, integration guidance, and optimization recommendations.

• Mentor and coach CSE peers, sharing expertise on troubleshooting methodologies, product knowledge, and customer engagement techniques to build team-wide self-sufficiency.

• Develop and maintain technical knowledge base content, runbooks, and best practice documentation that enable CSMs and CSEs to resolve common issues independently.

• Identify patterns in escalated issues to proactively recommend product improvements, inform roadmap priorities, and contribute to beta testing and early access programs.

• Engage directly with customers at a senior technical level when escalated, representing Delinea’s technical expertise while ensuring the CSM retains the primary relationship.

• Collaborate with CS leadership to shape team processes, define escalation criteria, and establish metrics for measuring CSE impact.

• Stay current on industry trends, emerging threats, and competitive landscape in the PAM and identity security space to inform customer conversations and internal strategy.

• Maintain clear boundaries with Professional Services; this role does not involve billable implementations, custom development, or long-term customer assignments.




Escalation and Assignment Process

Senior CSE engagements follow the same structured process as standard CSE assignments. CSMs escalate needs to the CSE Team, who evaluates relevance. The CSE is assigned temporarily to the issue, not the customer or CSM. The Senior CSE is engaged for issues requiring advanced expertise, cross-functional coordination, or strategic significance. The Senior CSE may also be proactively deployed for high-risk accounts or critical situations at the discretion of CS leadership.




What You’ll Bring

• 7+ years of related experience in a senior technical customer-facing role such as Senior Solutions Engineer, Technical Lead, Senior Support Engineer, or equivalent.

• BA degree with STEM focus or equivalent experience; advanced degree or industry certifications (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, Security+) preferred.

• Deep cybersecurity experience in the identity and access management space, with strong knowledge of PAM concepts, architectures, and competitive solutions.

• Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional technical engagements with minimal supervision.

• Proven track record of mentoring and developing technical talent.

• Experience working with enterprise-grade environments including Active Directory, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), SIEM/SOAR integrations, and identity governance frameworks.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to executive and non-technical stakeholders.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to identify systemic issues and drive process improvements.



Why work at Delinea? 

 - We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

 - We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

 - What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.



At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

 - Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

 - Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

 - Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

 - Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

 - Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

 - Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays. 

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
