jobs.title: Laboratory Technical Supervisor
jobs.description:
MISSION

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.



Role Purpose

This is a two-phase role. First, you build the lab. Then you run it.

You'll lead the setup and validation of Neko's on-site clinical laboratory in Miami — Abbott Alinity platforms, SOPs, workflows, regulatory readiness — and bring it through to a compliant go-live under CLIA, CMS, and the state of Florida. After go-live, you become the on-site technical owner and people leader: responsible for instrument performance, testing quality, inspection readiness, and the development of the Laboratory Technologist team that runs the bench day to day.

You'll partner closely with the Head of Labs, who provides multi-site oversight and holds final regulatory sign-off. But the lab on the ground — and the team in it — is yours.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

 - Lead laboratory setup and go-live readiness, taking the lab from empty space to compliant patient testing under CLIA, CMS, and Florida State regulations.

 - Complete full instrument and assay validation on Abbott Alinity platforms — accuracy, precision, reportable range, reference intervals, analytical performance — with complete, inspection-ready documentation.

 - Establish the SOPs, workflows, and validation practices the lab will run on for years. Build them so they're safe, efficient, and repeatable by the team that comes after you set them.

 - Keep the lab inspection-ready at all times — validation, QC, maintenance, and corrective-action records complete and current.

 - Transition the lab from setup mode into stable day-to-day operations, holding testing quality, turnaround times, and instrument reliability steady through the shift.

 - Manage and develop the Laboratory Technologist team — through 1:1s, performance feedback, technical coaching, and the day-to-day mentorship that turns good lab techs into great ones.

 - Serve as the on-site escalation point for any technical, operational, or quality issue affecting laboratory testing.

 - Build the culture of the lab — quality, accountability, and continuous improvement — from day one.

What We're Hiring For

 - Builder Who Can Also Run -- You've stood up a lab before — or something close to it — and you know what go-live actually looks like. But you also know the harder work starts after. You're not the kind of person who builds something impressive and then loses interest when it becomes operational. You take pride in steady-state performance just as much as the launch.

 - Validation Is Your Native Language -- You don't treat validation as paperwork. You understand why every parameter matters, what each one protects against, and how to defend the documentation to an inspector. Accuracy, precision, reportable range, reference intervals — you can talk through your validation strategy before you start, and you can show your work after.

 - Inspection-Ready Is a Default, Not a Project -- You don't prepare for inspections. You operate in a way that means you're always ready. Documentation is current because that's how you work, not because an audit is coming. When something deviates, you address it and document it the same day — not the same week.

 - The Technical Owner People Trust -- When something doesn't work — an instrument flag, an unexpected QC result, a workflow that's quietly breaking down — you're the person the team brings it to. You troubleshoot rigorously, you decide clearly, and you communicate honestly with the Head of Labs about what you've found. You don't minimize problems and you don't catastrophize them.

 - Develops the Team You Rely On -- The lab is only as strong as the Technologists running it. You take their development seriously — not as a side responsibility, but as core to your job. You give honest feedback, you teach the why behind the SOP, and you build people who could eventually do what you do. When something goes wrong on the bench, you treat it as a coaching moment, not a blame moment.

Minimum Requirements

 - 5+ years of experience in a supervisor or lead technologist role within a high-complexity clinical laboratory environment

 - Bachelor's degree in Medical Laboratory Science, Clinical Laboratory Science, or a related field.

 - Active Florida Clinical Laboratory Supervisor license, with specialty designation covering clinical chemistry, immunology, and hematology

 - Hands-on experience with automated chemistry and immunoassay platforms.

 - Demonstrated experience with laboratory validation, quality systems, and CLIA requirements.

Preferred

 - MLS (ASCP) or equivalent certification.

 - Direct experience with Abbott Alinity or Abbott ARCHITECT platforms.

 - Prior ownership of laboratory setup, instrument validation, or go-live activities.

 - Experience overseeing day-to-day laboratory operations in a clinical setting.

 - Familiarity with laboratory information systems (LIS), such as Epic or Cerner.

Compensation & Benefits

 - Paid Time Off & Holidays

 - Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance

 - 401(k) Retirement Plan

 - Commuter Benefits

 - Wellness Rewards Program

 - Complimentary full Neko scan for you and eligible family members

jobs.title: Robotics Systems Intern
jobs.description:
WHEELED PLATFORMS & LIFTING SYSTEMS

Emeryville, California | Internship

Proposed base compensation. Final terms are subject to Astera’s hiring process.


ABOUT ASTERA

Astera Institute is a private foundation supporting ambitious work in science and technology through grants, investments, and in-house research. Its research programs combine the pace and autonomy of a startup with the freedom to pursue difficult scientific questions. Learn more about Astera’s mission at astera.org/vision http://astera.org/vision.


ABOUT THE ROBOTICS LAB

We are building a frontier robotics lab at Astera Institute. We believe neuroscience and AI will converge in embodied intelligence: animals and robots face shared challenges of perceiving their surroundings, navigating, manipulating objects, and using memory and reasoning to accomplish tasks in the physical world. Robotics provides a powerful testbed for investigating how biological neural circuits solve these challenges and for developing AI systems that turn perception, learning, and cognition into effective action.

Our strategy starts with making robots useful, while developing a mechanistic understanding of how neural circuits can generate intelligent behavior. We aim to continually expand the repertoire of behaviors a robot can perform reliably in real environments, while improving its ability to learn new skills, adapt to changing conditions, and recover from failure. These practical capabilities provide both measurable outcomes and a foundation for investigating deeper principles of intelligence.

Wheeled robotic platforms are one of the embodiments we use to test neural-circuit models and AI systems as we work toward general embodied intelligence. We have already demonstrated indoor navigation on a simple differential-drive platform. We are now expanding this work to evaluate other wheel and drivetrain configurations, along with lifting systems that allow robots to adjust their working height.


POSITION SUMMARY

Help us build and compare the systems that allow robots to move and adjust their working height. Under engineering mentorship, you will prototype wheeled mobile bases and lifting platforms, run hands-on experiments, and evaluate how different designs perform under realistic operating conditions.

Starting with our existing hoverboard hub motors and other motorized wheel hardware, you will help explore different wheel and drivetrain configurations. You will also help develop and evaluate lifting platforms, comparing commercially available mechanisms and custom prototypes. Your work will help the team select practical designs based on measured performance, reliability, cost, and ease of integration.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Evaluate wheeled platforms. Assemble and modify mobile bases using hoverboard hub motors, hub motor wheels, and conventional motor-driven wheel assemblies. Help design and fabricate chassis, mounts, and supporting components. Compare navigation performance of different systems.

 - Compare wheel and drivetrain configurations. Develop repeatable tests to evaluate maneuverability, low-speed motion, traction, payload handling, power consumption, steerability and general performance across relevant floor surfaces.

 - Prototype lifting platforms. Help assemble, adapt, and test different lifting mechanisms, such as scissor lifts and telescoping lifting columns. Integrate actuators, guides, mounts, and supporting structures.

 - Evaluate lifting performance. Compare lifting range, speed, positioning repeatability, rigidity, and stability under defined loads. Investigate vibration, mechanical play, and other issues that affect reliable operation.

 - Integrate controls and measurements. Configure motor controllers, connect position and speed feedback, and develop simple control and data-collection scripts. Help implement travel limits, homing, and coordinated motion under engineering supervision.

 - Document comparisons and improve designs. Maintain CAD files, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and test records. Summarize tradeoffs and work with engineers to refine promising designs.

 - Keep experimental hardware ready. Organize components, tools, and spares; maintain prototypes and test fixtures; and assist with equipment inspections, repairs, and experiment setup.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Coursework, projects, or practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics, or a related discipline.

 - Experience building and troubleshooting a physical system through coursework, research, student teams, or personal projects.

 - Basic familiarity with mechanical assembly, electrical wiring, motors, and sensors.

 - Interest in hands-on prototyping and systematic testing, including careful measurement and documentation.

 - Comfort working with an engineering mentor and contributing to the upkeep of a shared robotics lab.


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - CAD, 3D printing, machining, or fabrication of mechanical prototypes.

 - BLDC motors, motor controllers, encoders, wheeled robots, or drivetrain design.

 - Linear actuators, screw drives, scissor lifts, lifting columns, or other positioning mechanisms.

 - Python, C/C++, microcontrollers, or basic feedback control.

 - Building test fixtures, collecting experimental data, or comparing hardware designs.

Prior experience with every technology listed is not expected. We value curiosity, practical problem-solving, and an interest in understanding how different mechanical systems perform through real experiments.

The work we do is rewarding and fast paced. It presents many opportunities to deepen your knowledge of the field. This is an on-site role and will require the majority of days to be spent in the Menlo Park office.

Responsibilities:

• Assay & Method Development: Develop and extend current assays to better fit evolving clinical needs, with support from scientists, engineers, and other technical staff

• Computational Data Analysis: Apply the analytical and computational methods used in current assays, and build upon them to enable new capabilities; develop, implement, and use software tools to quantitatively analyze experiments and processes, requiring moderate proficiency in R or Python

• Validation & Regulatory Compliance: Support assay validations and derisking under regulatory and design control frameworks (FDA, MolDx, etc.)

• Scientific Communication: Present technical findings and project updates verbally at group meetings and via internal written reports

• Wet Lab Execution: Carry out experiments in lab and document experimental procedures and results, and contribute to routine organization of the R&D lab

• Tech Transfer: Partner across departments to transfer and scale developed assays and workflows into high-throughput clinical laboratory operations.

• Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis: Apply sound engineering practices to scale, optimize, and improve molecular biology methods; systematically identify and investigate root sources of variation to develop short-term corrections and long-term preventative measures

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s, Master’s, or equivalent degree in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, Microbiology, Biophysics, or related fields

• At least 12 months of experience with molecular biology techniques (e.g. PCR, electrophoresis, DNA purifications) in a research or clinical laboratory (can be during or after Bachelor’s degree)

• Solid foundation in quantitative data analysis, statistics, and experimental design, with familiarity using R or Python (and a strong willingness to expand computational skills).

• Clear verbal and written communication skills in reporting to cross-functional teams of scientists and non-scientists

• Proven experimental troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills with sharp attention to detail

Nice-To-Haves:

• Start-up experience

• Experience with next-generation sequencing (NGS) and/or cell-free DNA

• Previous experience with liquid handling or other laboratory automation

• Knowledge of molecular oncology

• Experience with composing protocols of standard molecular biology techniques

Benefits And Perks:

• Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patients

• Open, transparent culture that includes weekly Town Hall meetings

• The ability to indirectly or directly change the lives of hundreds of thousands patients

• Multiple medical benefit options; employee premiums paid 100% of select plans, dependents covered up to 80%

• Extremely generous Family Bonding Leave for eligible employees (16 weeks, paid at 100%)

• Supplemental fertility benefits coverage

• Retirement savings program including a 4% Company match

• Increase paid time off with increased tenure

• Latest and greatest hardware (laptop, lab equipment, facilities)

• Free daily on-site lunches provided from top eateries

• A variety of perks on campus (shuttle to and from select transit hubs, state of the art gym, restaurant)

• Free on-site EV charging (compatible with all EVs, including Tesla)

At BillionToOne, we are proud to offer a combination of a (1) base pay range (actual amount offered is based on experience and salary/equity options split that the candidate chooses) (2) generous equity options offering, on top of (3) industry leading company benefits (free healthcare options, 401k match, very generous fully paid paternal leave etc.).

For this position, we offer a total compensation package of $105,737 per year, including a base pay range of $76,155 - $87,034 per year.

BillionToOne is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For more information about how we protect your information, we encourage you to review our Privacy Policy.

BillionToOne is a next-generation molecular diagnostics company on a mission to make powerful, accurate diagnostic tests accessible to everyone. Our revolutionary QCT molecular counting technology enhances disease detection resolution by over a thousandfold using cell-free DNA,a breakthrough that has already transformed the lives of over half a million patients worldwide.

Our Impact

Unity Complete™ is the only non-invasive prenatal screen capable of assessing fetal risk for both common recessive conditions and aneuploidies from a single maternal blood sample.
Unity Confirm™ enables non-invasive confirmation for high-risk screening results through the capture of intact circulating fetal cells using BillionToOne’s Fetal Cell Capture™ Technology.
Our Northstar® liquid biopsy test uniquely combines treatment selection with real-time monitoring, giving oncologists unprecedented precision in cancer care.

Our Growth

From $0 to $400M+ annualized revenue run-rate in just 6 years. In 2025, we completed one of the most successful IPOs for a medical diagnostics company, building on nearly $400M in private funding,including our $130M Series D in 2024 and backed by world-class investors including Hummingbird, Adams Street Partners, Neuberger Berman, Baillie Gifford, and Premji Invest.

Our Recognition

Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers for 2025 and we're Great Place to Work certified, with 100% of our people willing to go the extra mile, even as we've scaled to over 700 employees.

Our Future

Headquartered in Menlo Park with facilities in Union City, CA, and a new lab opening in Austin, TX in 2027, we're continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible in molecular diagnostics. We're just getting started.

Ready to help us change the world, one molecule at a time? Learn more at billiontoone.com

jobs.title: Manager, Application Engineering - ​​Atlassian Cloud Platform
jobs.description:
As Manager, Atlassian Cloud Platform, you will lead the team responsible for the strategy, administration, governance, delivery, and operational health of Riot’s Atlassian Platform which currently includes Jira. You will manage a team of application engineers, administrators, solution architects, and/or analysts who partner with teams across Riot to build scalable systems of work, improve the Rioter experience, and enable better outcomes through thoughtful use of Atlassian technology.

Jira is a foundational enterprise capability for planning, delivering, and operating work across Riot. Jira supports and enables the majority of player-facing value streams at Riot.

This is a player/coach role where you will set direction and create the conditions for your team to deliver, while maintaining enough craft depth to guide platform architecture, configuration, automation, integrations, security, service management, and operational decisions. You will partner closely with Information Technology, Information Security, Enterprise, and teams across Riot to balance customer needs, platform standards, risk, capacity, and near-term business priorities.

For this role, success means building a healthy, high-performing team; delivering a dependable Jira platform; establishing clear and scalable governance; and providing a frictionless environment for our game teams and the teams that support them. Ultimately, you win when teams at Riot spend less time blocked and more time making great games for players.

Responsibilities:

• Manage and evolve a team of 2-5 application engineers; coaching them, providing performance management, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring positive results

• Own the interviewing and onboarding process for new engineering team members

• Establish healthy team processes for intake, prioritization, discovery, solution design, delivery, change management, documentation, and support.

• Deliver platform capabilities and improvements against clear commitments, keeping stakeholders informed of progress, risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and changes in priority.

• Plan for keep-the-lights-on work, technical debt, platform maintenance, licensing needs, and other necessary technical investments alongside roadmap delivery.

• Facilitate alignment across teams when platform decisions affect multiple business units, Jira spaces, service portals, integrations, or governance domains.

• Build strong relationships with Atlassian and relevant vendors; manage vendor performance, escalations, and technical direction.

• Advocate for the team while ensuring decisions optimize for Riot and player value rather than for a single team or local preference.

• Be accountable for the team’s output and successful delivery against commitments.

• Promote contextual awareness of Riot’s company priorities, Information Technology strategy, Atlassian industry trends, and the needs of the teams that rely on Jira.

• Build healthy relationships with other engineering teams across Riot globally, in order to foster cross-team collaboration

Required Qualifications:

• 2+ years of experience managing a team of technical individual contributors in an enterprise platform, SaaS administration, business systems, application engineering, or related environment.

• 6+ years experience working with Jira at enterprise scale where Jira is a business-critical platform, including environments with thousands of users, multiple sites, hundreds projects or spaces, substantial work-item volume, and complex configuration or integration needs.

• Experience operating a large SaaS platform with attention to reliability, security, access control, change management, support, and lifecycle management.

• Demonstrated ability to set goals, manage performance, provide direct feedback, coach talent, and address performance issues in a timely and respectful way.

• Experience hiring technical individual contributors and building a high-quality team through structured, objective assessment.

• Experience prioritizing a team backlog and roadmap based on customer outcomes, technical capability, team bandwidth, operational risk, and organizational priorities.

• Experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make complex platform decisions understandable to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ability to work effectively in an ambiguous, changing environment while maintaining clear priorities and a high bar for execution.

Desired Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience, with multiple years in an application engineering role

• Experience with Jira Service Management, Assets, virtual agents, service portals, or configuration-management practices.

• Experience with Jira Product Discovery, Jira Advanced Planning, Automation, Atlassian Analytics, Atlassian Guard, Rovo, ScriptRunner, Structure, eazyBI, or comparable Atlassian Marketplace applications.

• Experience with Jira configuration-as-code, migration, environment promotion, configuration management, or tools such as Salto.

• Experience operating Confluence at enterprise scale, including information architecture, security architecture, governance, and integration with Jira or other business systems.

• Experience managing Atlassian licensing, vendor relationships, budgets, renewals, or commercial negotiations.

• Atlassian certifications such as ACP-120, ACP-420, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and choices that focus on your fellow Rioters, who are the customers of your work. Being a dedicated fan of games is not necessary for this position!

Our Perks:

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:

• Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data

• Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors

• Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks

• Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Habilitation
jobs.description:
Associate Director, Habilitation — HLS

Help open a new office. Build a lasting foundation.

BAYADA is seeking a collaborative, mission-driven Associate Director to help launch and grow the new HLS Habilitation office in Missouri. This is an opportunity to help shape a new team, build trusted community relationships, and establish dependable office operations while supporting people with intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD) to live with greater independence, dignity, and opportunity.

As the office grows, you will partner with BAYADA leaders and future office team members to create a welcoming, reliable presence for clients, families, employees, and community partners. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone energized by building relationships, developing people, and bringing structure to a new operation.

Role overview

• Practice: Habilitation

• Location: St. Louis, Missouri

What you will do

• Help launch the HLS office and establish BAYADA as a trusted provider and employer in the community.

• Build relationships with clients, families, referral partners, community organizations, and prospective employees.

• Support outreach, recruiting, and local business-development efforts that grow awareness of Habilitation services.

• Partner with BAYADA leaders to establish sound office routines, responsive service processes, and a positive client and employee experience.

• Support client-service coordination, staffing, scheduling, and day-to-day office workflow as the team is built.

• Help monitor office goals, key performance indicators, and operating measures, and use them to identify priorities and solve problems.

• Contribute to hiring, onboarding, coaching, and development of a strong office team.

• Support quality, safety, and compliance by following BAYADA policies and applicable requirements, and by elevating questions or concerns promptly.

• Work collaboratively with clients, families, employees, and colleagues to address changing needs with care and sound judgment.

• Participate in leadership development and help prepare for increased office leadership responsibility as the HLS team grows.

Building the office

The opening period will bring evolving priorities and hands-on work. You may help establish local relationships, support client and employee growth, and step into operational responsibilities while the office’s staffing and processes are being developed. The Associate Director role is designed to build leadership capability through hands-on experience and partnership with the Director and other BAYADA leaders.

What we are looking for

• Bachelor's degree required.

• Experience leading people, coordinating operations, or managing day-to-day business activity.

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to earn trust and work effectively with a range of people.

• Good judgment, organization, follow-through, and the ability to manage competing priorities.

• A flexible, practical approach to solving problems and improving processes.

• A genuine commitment to supporting people with I/DD and helping clients and families achieve meaningful outcomes.

• Comfort working in a new office where priorities and processes may evolve as the team grows.

Preferred experience

• Experience supporting people with I/DD, Habilitation, or other community-based human services.

• Experience launching or growing an office, program, or service.

• Experience with hiring, coaching, employee development, client services, scheduling, staffing, or operational measures.

• Experience with community outreach, referral relationships, or recruiting.

Why this opportunity matters

A new office is an opportunity to build trust from the beginning. Your leadership will help create a caring, dependable environment where clients and families feel supported, employees can grow, and the HLS office can become a valued part of its community. At BAYADA, our commitment to compassionate care and lasting relationships guides how we serve—and how we build for the future.

As an accredited, regulated, certified, and licensed home health care provider, BAYADA complies with all state/local mandates.

BAYADA is celebrating 50 years of compassion, excellence, and reliability. Learn more about our 50th anniversary celebration and how you can join in here.

BAYADA Home Health Care, Inc., and its associated entities and joint venture partners, are Equal Opportunity Employers. All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, military status, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws.  Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other marginalized communities.

jobs.title: Account Director, Financial Institutions
jobs.description:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Sales Account Director will join a team driving TRM’s go-to-market strategy in the US Private Sector market. This is a high-paced role, with a large volume of accounts that move quickly. The Account Director’s goal will be to expand and strengthen our foothold in the North American banking and large financial institutions space. We're looking for a customer-obsessed, consultative salesperson to own the entire sales process with new and existing customers. This person will be knowledgeable about blockchain intelligence and digital assets, and feel comfortable navigating complex processes to close six and seven-figure deals.

The impact you will have:

 - Connect with current and net new key stakeholders within your territory and identify what matters to them, what are their potential mission applications, who holds budgets, who makes decisions, who influences decisions, who owns which process

 - Spearhead the implementation of blockchain intelligence into customer workflows, driving towards intimate understanding of the customers' application of TRMs tooling and data to proactively find ways to improve the customers success.

 - Own, plan, execute, and/or quarterback activities to nurture client relationships, feedback loops, referrals, renewals, upsells, cross-sells, expansions

 - Create and execute strategic plans for your territory to not only ensure company goals are met across key revenue and churn metrics, but also new growth opportunities are discovered and pursued

 - Hone TRM product and customer vertical subject matter expertise to enrich every stage of the sales process from demonstrations to trial to customer advisory sessions to innovation workshops

 - Proactively gather and prioritize customer feedback and champion it within TRM

 - Develop a roster of happy customers that will refer new prospects, champion TRM, and provide crucial feedback

What we’re looking for:

 - At least 8+ years of experience selling SaaS products, or 4 years experience accompanied with expert customer domain and mission knowledge and a background in consulting

 - Experience with virtual currencies, applications, and their use in financial networks

 - Strong knowledge of crypto-native organizations as well as their workflows, procurement processes, and organizational structures

 - Strong customer-facing presentation/listening skills with the ability to establish credibility with senior executives

 - Familiarity with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulatory framework

 - A knack for storytelling. You have the ability understand customer needs and build + convey compelling value propositions

 - Ability to operate a large volume of accounts that develop quickly

 - You find excitement or fulfillment through developing meaningful client relationships, identifying new use cases, obsessing over customer happiness, meeting new contacts within accounts, and closing deals

 - Adaptable. Goals can change fast. You anticipate and react quickly

 - Autonomous. You own what you work on. You move fast and get things done

 - Excellent communication. You will need to communicate complex ideas effectively

 - Collaborative. You must work collaboratively in a cross-functional team and with people at all levels in an organization

About the Team:

 - Our team thrives on collaboration, always looking out for each other by sharing opportunities and competitive insights. We actively exchange ideas and strategies to boost each other's sales efforts. Communication is key, and we primarily use Slack, making sure to @mention colleagues for timely responses. Our routine includes weekly 1-on-1 meetings with managers, bi-weekly team meetings, and monthly Pod meetings with the broader support organization. Above all, we prioritize our customers' missions, and this dedication is reflected in every aspect of our TRM life.

 - Our team predominantly operates in the EST timezone, with some members in PST. We start our day around 8:00 am and typically finish after 5:00 pm. While we may work beyond standard hours when necessary, we deeply respect family time and strive not to intrude on it. We're committed to contributing whenever needed, ensuring our team's success isn't confined to a 40-hour workweek.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

 - Rapid Opportunity Assessment: You'll swiftly qualify or disqualify opportunities to ensure a strong, future-focused pipeline. Your goal is to add more than $500k in qualified pipeline each month, targeting next quarter and beyond.

 - Sales Campaigns: You'll develop two new sales campaigns each month to accelerate pipeline growth, with a focus on generating in-quarter opportunities.

 - Strategic Sales Planning: You'll regularly update and evaluate a strategic sales plan for all Tier 1 current customers and identify potential Tier 1 prospects on a monthly basis.

 


APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.




INTERVIEWING WITH TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

 - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

 - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

 - Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.




AI FLUENCY AT TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

 - Accelerate repeatable workflows

 - Structure and solve problems

 - Improve output quality

 - Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.




LIFE AT TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - Priorities and targets to change quickly

 - Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 




LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

 - Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

 - Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

 - Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.





JOIN OUR MISSION

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. 





PRIVACY POLICY AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy https://www.trmlabs.com/policies/privacy-policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc6e8jRCl2cQwgIzXLpIGQXtwvMQh__TcokvO2toAAkT44A6Q/viewform?usp=dialog. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSevmAzPxWOYm_7kMHb9lEJlX3tpdBeHvvvNWjsI_6xhUfnXjw/viewform?usp=dialog.




RECRUITMENT AGENCIES

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

jobs.title: Recreation Manager
jobs.description:

As our Recreation Manager, you will take care of the little things and big things at the beach and pools: ensuring a safe and enjoyable environment for Colleagues and guests, ensuring a seamless daily operation and overseeing the growth and development of the department Colleagues.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Responsible for providing service within Fairmont & Leading Quality Assurance (LQA) standards.  Areas of responsibility will include, but are not limited to the following:

• Assist & ensure seamless daily operations of beach and pool areas with an emphasis on luxury service standards
• Conduct pre-shift briefings
• Assist the Director of Recreation with special projects and hotel activities
• Work closely with the departmental leadership and staff to provide support and direction.
• Take ownership for guest’s cabana, reservations and special requests. Work closely with the concierge and activities agents.
• Motivate, lead, coach and monitor the performance levels of all team members.
• Manage labor and payroll by creating weekly schedules in compliance with labor management guidelines and updating time cards as needed.
• Complete colleague performance reviews and discussions
• Record & control inventory, including ordering of department’s operating equipment including chairs, tables, umbrellas, etc.
• Supervise, coordinate and direct prompt, efficient and courteous service in & around department’s areas. Assign and control side duties in a fair and reasonable manner.
• Ensure the delivery of luxury service by maintaining high staff morale and team spirit while maximizing profit potential.
• Establish and maintain effective colleague relations, watch proper staffing levels and labor hours.
• Maintain atmosphere of aloha spirit by providing engaging, personalized, timely, and efficient service to our discerning guests
• Focus attention on problem resolution and guest satisfaction with beach and pool experience, including activities vendors.
• Promote and enforce health and safety awareness as well as to have a complete understanding of the emergency procedures

jobs.title: Lead Brand Designer (Bangkok based, relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

A bit about the Brand team

Agoda’s Brand team brings together, brand managers, media planners, project managers, designers, and creatives. We shape how consumers, business partners, and employees experience Agoda, building recognition and brand trust. Working as an internal agency, we develop brand campaigns and marketing communications across digital channels, events, presentations, and other brand touchpoints.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Design Lead who combines exceptional design craft with experience managing and developing designers. This role carries both individual contributor and people management responsibilities. You will personally develop concepts and design key work, while guiding the team and raising the quality of its output.

A central focus will be making Agoda’s distinctive brand assets more recognizable, versatile, and effective through repeated use. You will shape how these assets appear across campaigns, channels, and markets, building familiarity while finding fresh, purposeful ways to express the brand.

You bring a refined eye for impactful design and a strong understanding of visual and message hierarchy. You can demonstrate your thinking through your own work, coach others to strengthen theirs, and use AI confidently in visual design and campaign development.

In this role you’ll get to

• Personally concept and design. Own design projects from brief through final execution, producing original work and contributing actively to the team’s everyday creative output.

• Strengthen Agoda’s distinctive brand assets. Develop consistent, inventive applications that make our assets more recognizable, versatile, and effective across touchpoints and over time.

• Lead and develop designers. Manage and coach the team, set clear expectations, and run constructive creative reviews. Give actionable feedback and demonstrate solutions through your own design work.

• Shape visual and message architecture. Work with copy, creative, and marketing partners to establish what audiences should notice first, understand next, and act on.

• Evolve our design guidelines. Develop practical principles, examples, and reusable resources that help teams and external partners use our brand assets consistently and imaginatively.

• Connect creative quality to business objectives. Present a clear rationale for design decisions, use audience insights and performance feedback to improve work, and balance priorities and deadlines. Collaborate with production specialists to carry the creative vision through delivery.

• Use AI to elevate design and brand campaigns. Apply AI tools confidently to develop campaign concepts, explore visual directions, and create and refine layouts and brand imagery. Guide the team in integrating AI into everyday design work while maintaining strong craft, clear message hierarchy, and consistent use of Agoda’s distinctive assets.

What you’ll need to succeed

• 10+ years of design experience within creative, branding, or advertising agencies, with a strong record of personally delivering high-quality brand and marketing communications.

• Proven experience managing and developing a team of designers, alongside an active individual contribution to concept development and execution.

• An outstanding portfolio that clearly distinguishes your own design work from projects you directed, demonstrating exceptional craft and your ability to elevate the work of others.

• A refined eye for typography, composition, imagery, color, and spacing, with the ability to create elegant, distinctive work suited to the brand and audience.

• Strong command of visual hierarchy and message architecture, including the ability to simplify complex information and create a clear relationship between headlines, supporting content, and calls to action.

• Experience developing brand guidelines and distinctive assets, with an understanding of how consistent, repeated use builds recognition across campaigns and formats.

• The ability to explain why a design works and translate your judgment into specific feedback that helps designers improve their craft and confidence.

• Excellent collaboration and presentation skills, with experience aligning stakeholders and balancing creative ambition with business objectives and delivery requirements.

• Strong practical proficiency in core design tools such as Figma, Adobe Illustrator, and Photoshop.

• Proficiency in using AI tools for visual design and brand campaign development, with practical experience creating and refining layouts, imagery, and campaign concepts. A strong eye for evaluating and improving AI outputs, ensuring they meet the brief and reflect the brand’s identity.

It’s great if you have

• Experience working with global brands and adapting creative across markets, languages, and cultural contexts.

• Experience using brand research or creative testing to strengthen the recognition and effectiveness of distinctive brand assets.

• Experience collaborating with motion, film, and automation specialists, providing clear creative direction throughout production.

• Experience bringing agency standards of craft and creative development into an internal brand team.

What we offer

• The opportunity to shape Agoda’s visual expression and strengthen the impact of its distinctive brand assets.

• A role combining personal design ownership with the opportunity to develop a team and influence creative quality across the business.

• A collaborative environment with colleagues and specialist creative partners across disciplines.

• Opportunities to advance the use of AI and emerging creative tools while building on strong design foundations.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
Accounting Manager – Internal
 
As an Accounting Manager, you will be part of the internal accounting team and play a key role in the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of the organization's financial reporting. This position combines hands-on accounting responsibilities with oversight of key processes and team activities, including the month-end close, intercompany accounting, accounts payable, and fixed assets. Payroll accounting is also a core part of the role, including accounting oversight of payroll and general oversight of the payroll team. As a growing company expanding into new international markets, we need a versatile, hands-on team member who can act as a utility player, picking up new projects, including M&A integrations and purchase accounting, and helping wherever the accounting team needs support. The Accounting Manager reports to the Controller.
 
Key Responsibilities
Manage the month-end close process, including the preparation and review of journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, and supporting schedules.
Oversee intercompany transfer pricing calculations and the preparation and recording of related intercompany billings, ensuring accuracy and consistency with established policies.
Manage the intercompany close process, including reconciling intercompany balances, resolving discrepancies, and ensuring intercompany activity is eliminated accurately and on time.
Oversee the accounting and general ledger recording of payroll, including reviewing payroll-related journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, and account activity for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate classification.
Provide day-to-day guidance, review, and oversight to accounting team members, helping ensure work is completed accurately, completely, and on time.
Oversee the accounts payable and expense reimbursement processes, including the timely resolution of issues and maintenance of appropriate controls.
Maintain and review cash flow forecasting to support effective financial planning and decision-making.
Provide general oversight of the payroll team to confirm payroll activities are completed accurately and timely, while promptly identifying and escalating errors, missed deadlines, or control concerns.
This role does not process payroll and is not responsible for payroll tax calculations, deposits, filings, returns, or related compliance activities.
Oversee the organization's fixed assets, ensuring proper accounting, depreciation, reconciliation, and asset tracking.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prepare accurate and timely financial reports and resolve accounting matters.
Coordinate with the payroll team and other stakeholders to obtain the information needed for period-end close, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
Monitor financial controls, reporting processes, and compliance with applicable accounting standards; recommend and implement process improvements where appropriate.
Support external audits by coordinating requests, reviewing supporting documentation, and helping ensure timely and complete responses.
Document and maintain business processes and accounting policies to strengthen internal controls and promote consistent execution.
Support the company's international expansion by helping with accounting needs in new countries, such as new entity setup, multi-currency accounting, and local reporting requirements, and take on special projects and new areas of work as the business grows.
Play a key role in M&A activity, including integrating acquired entities into the company's accounting processes and systems and assisting with purchase accounting, including opening balance sheet entries and related analysis.
 
What you must have
Thorough knowledge of general financial accounting, month-end close, account reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and internal controls.
Ability to review payroll-related accounting and general ledger activity without responsibility for payroll processing or payroll tax compliance.
 
Nice to have
Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance.
At least 5 years of progressive accounting experience, including experience reviewing the work of others or leading accounting processes.
Prior experience with payroll accounting, payroll journal entries, and payroll-related account reconciliations preferred.
Public accounting experience preferred.
Experience with M&A integrations or purchase accounting is a plus.
Experience with general ledger systems and Microsoft Office, including strong Excel skills.
 
Who thrives here
Strong leadership, review, and team-management skills, with the ability to set priorities and hold team members accountable for accurate and timely work.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and resolve issues proactively.
Flexibility and willingness to help where needed, including taking on new projects and unfamiliar areas as the business grows and expands internationally.

Conversion is the agentic marketing automation platform for modern enterprises such as Plaid, ClickHouse, Webflow, and Productboard. Our platform lets growth teams run their entire go-to-market motion in one place, from acquisition through retention, with AI agents doing the work that legacy tools like Marketo, HubSpot, and Pardot can't.



We've raised $28M+ from Abstract Ventures, True Ventures, and HOF Capital. The team is based in San Francisco and includes engineers, designers, and operators from Airbnb, Palantir, Pinterest, IMC, Shopify, LinkedIn, and Microsoft.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Hello hello -- 👋 Kyle here. I lead Marketing at Conversion, and up until now I've also somehow been the person responsible for all of our brand work. Every logo variation, every deck, every launch page, every color and kerning our typeface. It has been an absolute blast but unfortunately I'm drowning in work and have to let this go.



So, now I'm hiring a brand designer. Someone who owns our visual identity top to bottom and builds our design system at scale.



This will be the person who decides what Conversion looks like and feels like everywhere it shows up across every medium! The identity system (logo, type, color, grid, motion language), the guidelines we use to pass to our agencies and freelance partners, and how we think about craft and brand for the entire business. You'll bring it to life across web, social, launch creative, decks, and collateral. When we ship a new feature or run a launch, you're making the page look incredible, designing launch video, and setting the visual story. This is brand and identity work rather product UI (Levi owns our in-app surfaces), and not code. If you think of yourself as a design engineer, this probably isn't the right fit (but we are hiring those too -- look at our careers page!!)



I care about this a lot, which is why the bar is high. We always evaluate portfolio first. I want to see identity work you've built from the ground up and can walk me through: what the problem was, what you made, and why every decision. I'd rather see one brand you shaped end to end than ten logos you touched. Tool fluency is expected for this role (Figma, Illustrator, After Effects / Lottie / Figma Motion, Claude Design), and I'm looking for roughly 1 to 7 years of being an in-house brand owner.



The people who crush this role tend to be the same off the clock. Side projects, an art Instagram, a vlog, a brand they built just because. Strong opinions about advertising and what good creative actually is (I keep a Super Bowl ad tier list, so no judgment). The friend whose dinner party has a custom menu. Obsessive about craft down to the pixel. If that's you, and you want to own a brand rather than execute someone else's, please reach out!!



This role is in-person 5 days/week in San Francisco.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - The visual identity itself: logo, type, color, grid, motion language, and the guidelines that keep all of it consistent as more people build on top of it

 - The look and feel of Conversion everywhere it shows up: web, social, decks, collateral, launch creative

 - Launch work end to end: the launch video, the webpage, the assets, the story that ties them together

 - The craft bar for anything visual that leaves the building, including work made by others

 - The brand system that lets the team move fast without every piece routing through you

 - Motion and video where the brand needs it: launch films, product moments, social cuts

 - Tracking what's landing and iterating, because taste plus a feedback loop beats taste alone




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have a portfolio of identity work you built from the ground up and can walk me through: what the problem was, what you made, and why every call

 - Are fluent in the core tools (Figma, Illustrator, After Effects / Lottie / Figma Motion, Claude Design) and pick up new ones fast

 - Have an almost annoying attention to detail, down to the kerning and the pixel

 - Can take a project from concept to finished thing (type, layout, motion, the whole build) without much direction

 - Have a clear, opinionated POV on typography, color, layout, and composition, and can defend your calls

 - Work well across product, sales, and marketing without losing your creative conviction

 - Want full ownership of a brand rather than a slice of someone else's




YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU

 - Have shaped a brand identity someone would recognize, not just executed against an existing one

 - Have range across mediums: identity system, landing page, launch video, deck, all held to the same bar

 - Make things outside of work too: a side project, an art Instagram, a vlog, a brand you built just because

 - Have strong opinions about advertising and what good creative actually is

 - Believe in high-intensity in-person teams and want to be surrounded by people pushing in the same direction

 - Care about craft in every artifact: every frame, every thumbnail, every slide




USEFUL LINKS

 - Website: https://conversion.ai/

 - Company culture: https://conversion.ai/careers

jobs.title: Senior ABM Manager
jobs.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

We are hiring a full-stack, technical Sr. Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Manager to own our ABM program end-to-end. You'll start with bespoke 1:1 and 1:few programs against our most strategic enterprise and regulated accounts, then build the operating model and automation to extend what works to 1:many.

This is a builder role, not a project manager role. You'll launch your own ads, build your own pages and workflows, and pull your own data. You reach for an agent or automation before doing anything by hand, and you're a real partner to Sales, with the presence to shape account plans and the discipline to report on shared numbers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own the ABM program. Set strategy and run execution for Chainguard's top enterprise and regulated accounts across the full lifecycle: new business, deal acceleration, and expansion. Design and launch 1:1 and 1:few campaigns yourself across paid digital, web, email, gifting, and executive events, with messaging built for CISOs, security engineering, and platform leaders.

• Build the operating model. Define the playbooks, target account lists, tooling, and measurement framework for how ABM runs here, so programs stay repeatable and high quality as we scale from a handful of accounts to 1:many.

• Operationalize AI for ABM. Build agents and workflows in Clay, HubSpot, Hightouch, and custom internal apps to research accounts, capture signals, personalize outreach, and orchestrate multi-channel plays. Experiment, productionize what works, and document it.

• Partner with Sales, BDR, and Partners, and measure what matters. Develop joint account plans with Sales, sales leadership, the BDR team, and the Partner team, ensure coordinated follow-up on every program, and drive rep enablement. Define KPIs for pipeline, penetration, engagement, and acceleration, and report impact with Marketing Ops in Omni and BigQuery.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

• 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, with 2+ years running ABM programs at a SaaS, security, or infrastructure company, and cross-channel campaigns you shipped end to end that produced pipeline.

• Full-stack execution across paid media, web, email, and marketing automation, without waiting on a large supporting team. Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clay (or equivalents), familiarity with intent and comfort writing SQL against BigQuery to answer your own questions.

• An AI builder's mindset: you've applied agents, LLM APIs, or advanced automation to real marketing problems and treat AI as the default way to scale.

• Creative in the 1:1 tier, disciplined enough to run many programs at once, and credible with technical and security buyers and sales leadership alike.

• You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience marketing into regulated industries or the public sector (FedRAMP, financial services, healthcare)

• Familiarity with the cloud-native and open source ecosystem (Kubernetes, containers, software supply chain security)

• Experience building and managing CDP-driven audience pipelines, including audience syncs, match rate optimization and suppression workflows.

We know not everyone will check every box on day one. If this role excites you and you've done most of this, we'd like to hear from you.

Base Salary Range

$140,000—$167,500 USD

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

• We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.

• We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.

• We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.

• We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

• Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.

• Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

• 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.

• ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.

• 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

jobs.title: Platform Product Manager (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas or take over sponsorship at this time.

About the role:

Enova’s Platform Product Management Team is seeking a Product Manager to own and drive the tools, services, and platforms that help our software engineers build and ship faster, including how we adopt AI across the software development lifecycle.

In this role, you will shape the product strategy for our internal developer platform, including our developer portal, on-demand environments, shared libraries, AI-powered developer tools, and the tooling that supports building, testing, securing, and deploying software. You’ll treat engineers as your customers: you’ll partner closely with the Developer Experience team, engineering teams across the company, and technology leadership to find friction in the development lifecycle, define solutions, and drive successful execution. You will also lead efforts to help engineers adopt AI tools safely and effectively, from AI coding assistants to internal AI agents and integrations. This is a highly collaborative position that requires strong product and project management skills and the ability to turn engineering needs into measurable improvements in developer productivity.

Responsibilities:

• Own the product lifecycle for developer platform capabilities, from discovery through delivery, adoption, and iteration

• Define and drive the strategy for AI adoption among engineers, including evaluating, piloting, and rolling out AI-powered developer tools and workflows

• Partner with engineering teams across the company to understand their workflows and pain points, and define product strategy for the developer platform

• Prioritize initiatives and manage a roadmap aligned to engineering productivity goals, security and reliability needs, and platform evolution

• Elicit, document, and validate requirements with the DevEx team, ensuring alignment with technical feasibility and scalable, maintainable solutions

• Drive adoption of platform tools and services through enablement, documentation, communication, and feedback loops with internal users

• Drive alignment across cross-functional teams, ensuring clarity on priorities, scope, and timelines

• Collaborate closely with engineers throughout development, making tradeoff decisions as needed

• Define and track developer experience metrics (e.g., adoption, environment spin-up time, build and deploy times, developer satisfaction), using data to inform decisions and continuous improvement

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of product management, technical program management, or business analysis experience, ideally with internal platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure products

• Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle and modern engineering practices, such as CI/CD, testing automation, containerized or cloud environments, and developer security tooling

• Experience gathering requirements directly from engineers or other technical users and validating solutions with them

• Strong ability to translate user needs into clear requirements and prioritize MVP solutions

• Experience working in Agile environments and tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence), with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced setting

• Proven ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional stakeholders, including engineering, security, and technology leadership

• Experience with developer portals or internal developer platforms (e.g., Backstage)

• Strong ownership and execution skills, including creating product artifacts (e.g., requirements, process flows, test plans, roadmaps) and independently driving projects from concept through delivery

• Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or integrating AI agents with internal tools and data sources

• Familiarity with generative AI and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, LLM-based agents), including their capabilities, limitations, and risks

Compensation

The budgeted annual salary range for this position is $90,000 - $125,000. Actual annual salary will be determined based on qualifications, skills, experience, and level assessed during the hiring process and may fall outside of the range shown. Additional compensation for this role may include a bonus. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in Company benefits, described in more detail here.

Benefits & Perks:

• Our hybrid roles require in-office work Tuesday through Thursday, with remote flexibility on Mondays and Fridays. This schedule fosters collaboration, team connection, and strategic planning, enhancing communication and effectiveness to drive results.

• Health, dental, and vision insurance including mental health benefits

• 401(k) matching plus a roth option (U.S. Based employees only)

• PTO & paid holidays off

• Sabbatical program (for eligible roles)

• Summer hours (for eligible roles)

• Paid parental leave

• DEI groups (B.L.A.C.K. @ Enova, HOLA @ Enova, Women @ Enova, Pride @ Enova, South Asians @ Enova, APEX @ Enova, and Parents @ Enova)

• Employee recognition and rewards program

• Charitable matching and a paid volunteer day…Plus so much more!

About Enova

Enova International is a leading financial technology company that provides online financial services through our AI and machine learning-powered Colossus™platform. We serve non-prime consumers and businesses alike, while offering world-class technology and services to traditional banks—in order to create accessible credit for millions.

Being a values-driven organization is at the core of Enova’s success. We live our values by listening to our customers, challenging assumptions, thinking big, setting high expectations, and hiring and developing the best. Through our values and our commitment to making Enova an awesome place to work, we maintain an environment of inclusion and culture where our employees can thrive. You can learn more about Enova’s values and culture here.
