jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Agent Runtime & Evals
jobs.description:
ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.




ABOUT YOUR ROLE

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the agent runtime and evaluation layer of Foundry, the platform where Juniper Square builds, deploys, and operates AI agents, apps, and code. It is built for non-engineers: a fund administration specialist or business SME should be able to describe what they need and end up with a governed, deployable automation that has its own identity, access grants, and audit trail. You will report to the Group Product Manager for Foundry and work closely with a dedicated engineering team on the details that make that promise real.

About 75% of your time goes to the agent runtime itself: versions and deployments, evaluations and testing, and what happens when a new model ships and teams want it for some automations but not others. The other 25% goes to partnering with the workflow orchestration PM on the contracts that let hosted agents plug into governed workflows and get real work done. Think of orchestration as the shape of the container, and this role as how that container gets filled with automations in a deterministic, predictable way.

The platform is early and the problems are hard. We are rebuilding how fund administration gets done to be agentic first, with humans and agents building, configuring, and deploying automations together. You will help shape the foundations, and engineering will look to you to make the call on ambiguous platform tradeoffs.

AI fluency is a baseline expectation. PMs at this level should be comfortable using the full range of modern tools (e.g. LLMs, agent orchestration frameworks, Claude) to move faster and make sharper decisions. That might mean building and deploying your own agents on the platform you own, prototyping before writing requirements, or using coding agents to submit pull requests for engineering. The expectation is sound judgment about what will get to the best outcome for the customer and the team.

This role would benefit from in-person collaboration in San Francisco, where many of our product management, design, and engineering personnel are based, although we also welcome exceptional candidates from elsewhere in the United States and Canada.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build the agent runtime for non-engineers: Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a platform where business users take an agent, app, or script from idea to governed production without an engineering cycle. Define the full lifecycle: draft, test, publish, version, deploy, run, observe, improve, and retire.

 - Own evaluations and model governance: Define how every automation is tested before it ships. Work with engineering and our shared eval platform team on golden datasets, data labeling, and regression gates that block promotion. Decide when an automated judge is enough and when a human has to stay in the loop. Shape how evals decide which models are eligible for which agents, so a new model release becomes a product decision rather than a scramble.

 - Solve the "who evaluates the evaluator" problem: Agents that grade other agents need their own checks. Partner with engineering on patterns that keep quality measurable at the scale of thousands of agents, and turn them into experiences builders can understand and trust.

 - Shape memory, learning, and self-improvement: Define how agents keep long-lived memory, compact it, and improve from experience, with an eye on adoption and user-facing impact rather than algorithms alone.

 - Run a model-agnostic platform: Own model routing, cost attribution, and pricing so teams can choose the right model for each job and see what it costs.

 - Integrate with broader systems: Define how hosted agents reach data and take action across our product suite, our fund administration systems of record, and third-party tools. Own the connector, credential, and access-grant model so integrations are reusable rather than rebuilt per agent. Define agent identity and run modes, including when an agent acts with the invoking user's access and when it acts under its own service identity.

 - Give people oversight at scale: Design the tools that let fund administration teams supervise large fleets of agents: dashboards, run history, observability through traces, metrics, and logs, kill switches, and auditability. Make it clear what is an exception and what is an issue.

 - Define how automations bind to workflows: Partner with the workflow orchestration PM on the agent registry and typed contracts that describe what an agent needs and produces, and how workflows bind to it. Protect the safety boundary that agent-driven steps stage changes and people release them.

 - Deliver configuration to business SMEs: Partner with design and engineering to build the tools SMEs use to configure, test, and tune automations themselves. Hold the line on convention over configuration so every setting earns its place.

 - Stay ahead of the market: Track managed agent runtimes, agent frameworks, and automation platforms. Turn that view into clear build, buy, and partner calls.

 - Be a leader: Set direction across the platform and adjacent teams, raise the bar for product craft, and be the person engineering trusts on ambiguous platform tradeoffs.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years of product management experience in B2B or Enterprise SaaS, including 3+ years operating in an AI-oriented role.

 - Proven experience owning a complex product area end-to-end, from strategy and roadmap through execution and iteration, ideally in a zero-to-one context.

 - Hands-on understanding of how agent evaluation works: golden datasets, data labeling, automated judges, regression testing, and knowing when a human has to step in.

 - Background building agents and replacing human-driven processes with product and automation, with real evaluation and monitoring discipline in production.

 - A strong engineering partner with a product mindset. You can go deep with engineers on topics like typed contracts between agents and workflows, structured and deterministic outputs, and agent memory, and you know the right questions to ask even when you don't have the answers. This is not a TPM role: your focus is how people actually use these tools.

 - User empathy for non-engineering builders and operators, including how people oversee large numbers of automated agents.

 - Fluency with LLMs and common AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor). You should be able to run your own prototypes and use AI to get work done faster than a traditional PM workflow would allow. Bonus points for deep experience with managed agent platforms such as Claude Managed Agents or Workato Genies, including evals, tool and connector access, versions, and deployments.

 - Strong communication skills, written and verbal, with the ability to articulate product decisions clearly to engineers, designers, executives, and customers alike.

 - Track record of leading through influence, ideally mentoring or managing other product managers, and setting strategy that multiple teams execute against.

What success looks like

 - By the end of Q1: The platform runs real fund administration workflows with real automations, such as capital calls and distributions, built and deployed on Foundry.

 - Following the Q1 milestone: Those workflows roll out to the entire fund administration team, fundamentally changing how they work.

 - Long term: An "AI factory" where AI watches how work gets done and proposes new workflows and agents, and people move from building to oversight and course correction. A new client could be up and running in a day and fully automated within the week.
   
   


COMPENSATION

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. salary range for this role is $200,000 - $230,000+ USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.



Benefits include:

 - Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

 - Life insurance

 - Mental wellness coverage

 - Fertility and growing family support

 - Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

 - Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

 - Retirement saving plans

 - Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

 - Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

Our goal is to continuously learn from deployments, distribute AI’s benefits widely, and ensure that powerful tools remain aligned with human values and safety considerations.

About the Role

The Safety Measurement Research Program Manager drives OpenAI’s strategy for safety measurement and evaluations, partnering closely with safety research, data science, and engineering to advance how we measure harm and safeguard efficacy across research and production.

You will work directly with researchers, data scientists, policy owners, and product teams who contribute to or use our measurement systems, identifying the most important problems to solve and shaping the data, dashboards, tools, and workflows we build for them. This role combines measurement expertise, product judgment, and cross-functional execution: you will engage with evaluation results and data workflows, make prioritization tradeoffs, and drive work from problem definition through rollout and iteration.

This position is based in San Francisco, CA, with relocation assistance available.

In this role, you will:

 - Define strategic priorities and product roadmaps to improve safety measurement and evaluation approaches and scale our measurement platform to new use cases, products, and the needs of cross-functional teams

 - Partner closely with research, data science, engineering, policy teams, and other stakeholders to craft a vision for understanding safety outcomes and prevalence across our products, and translate that vision into concrete programs of work.

 - Drive the integration of cutting-edge AI safety research into OpenAI’s safety measurement and evaluation platforms, working with researchers, data scientists, and engineers to navigate technical tradeoffs, coordinate dependencies, and resolve blockers.

 - Develop and continuously refine clear, actionable success criteria that effectively capture our ambitions with safety measurement and evals.

 - Represent quantitative progress on safety to senior leadership.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 6+ years of experience in research program management, technical program management, product management, or related roles, with expertise in AI safety, trust & safety, integrity, or related domains.

 - Have a strong foundation in data science, statistics, economics, or a related field, and hands-on experience with measurement or evaluations.

 - Enjoy working at the intersection of data science and AI safety research, translating evolving measurement needs into clear requirements, priorities, and roadmaps.

 - Can independently drive complex, cross-functional programs from problem definition through rollout, building alignment and unblocking decisions in ambiguous spaces.

 - Ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions, and exercise sound judgment about technical tradeoffs and the strengths and limitations of metrics and evaluations.

 - Build strong partnerships across research, data science, engineering, policy, and product, and communicate complex findings clearly to technical teams and leadership.

 - Are curious about AI safety and its societal impacts, learn new domains quickly, and adapt as research and priorities evolve.

jobs.description:

Title: Medical Scribe

Company: Oak Street Health

Role Description:

The purpose of a Clinical Informatics Specialist (CIS or Medical Scribe) at Oak Street Health is to support our primary care providers with clinical documentation so that they can focus on providing exceptional care to our patients. Scribes assist providers throughout the patient care journey - huddling each morning to plan for the day's visits, joining them in the exam room to observe and document, and touching base after the visit to assist with next steps.

Beyond the typical Scribe role, these important care team members serve as clinical documentation assistants to their paired provider. Internally, we call them CISs (Clinic Informatics Specialists) in recognition of their important role in supporting accurate, specific, and timely clinical documentation. In addition to observing and documenting all patient encounters in real time, our Scribes become experts in our value-based care model and the documentation and care of chronic conditions, including ICD-10 and CPT coding. Scribes use this expertise to help providers identify and help close care gaps. Scribes receive extensive on-the-job training in clinical workflows, value-based medicine, preventative care for chronic conditions, accurate and specific documentation, population health data streams, and team based care.

Because our patients and providers rely on our Scribes, the ideal candidate should commit at least 1-2 years to this role. This is an excellent opportunity for pre-med track individuals looking to gain practical, paid experience in a clinical setting before applying to an MD/DO/PA/NP program, as well as those pursuing careers in Health Informatics, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Medical Coding, and other related fields.

Responsibilities:

• Documenting Patient Encounters ~ 80%Joining the provider in the exam room to observe patient visitsDocumenting patient encounters in a structured note, including the history of the present illness, assessment, plan, and physical examAssigning appropriate CPT and ICD-10 codesPreparing After Visit SummariesConsulting with provider to ensure accurate and specific documentation
• Clinical Documentation Improvement ~ 10%Requesting and reviewing medical recordsLeveraging Oak Street's population health tools to support clinical documentation improvementPreparing for and supporting Daily Huddles and Clinical Documentation ReviewsConsulting with provider on clinical documentation opportunities
• Administrative support for your provider and care team ~ 10%Placing orders and referralsAddressing tasksSupporting the care team with additional responsibilities related to clinical documentation
• Other duties as assigned

What we're looking for

Knowledge

• Knowledge of medical terminology and common medications, either from a pre-medical degree or prior clinical experience [required]
• Prior clinical experience, including shadowing and/or volunteering [strongly preferred]
• Prior scribe or transcription experience [preferred but not required]

Skills

• Advanced listening and communication skills [required]
• Strong computer literacy and ability to learn new technical workflows [required]
• Fluency in Spanish, Polish, Russian, or other languages spoken by people in the communities we serve [required where indicated]

Abilities

• Ability to adapt to new workflows and to quickly learn new concepts and skills [required]

Job Description

Job Purpose and Summary:

The purpose of the Asset Protection Coordinator (APC) is to improve the retail customer experience and mitigate company losses to external theft in their assigned store. This position requires superior customer service skills and experience implementing loss prevention and opeartional strategies. This position reports dierctly to the District Asset Protection Leader but involves close collaboration with business partners including store leadership and specialized divisions within the Asset Protection Department. The APC will closely monitor all store activity and gather information on theft and operational vulnerabilities. This is a high visibility position with strong emphasis on customer service and preventing theft, not a covert position apprehending shoplifters.  APC’s will be required to wear specialized CVS store uniform as a deterrent to theft. The APC does not perform operational duties such as unloading truck deliveries or manning a POS terminal.

Primary Job Duties & Responsibilities:

• Provides attentive, friendly customer service. Greets all customers, provides answers to general customer questions, and assists with opening and securing locked shelves and showcases per customer requests.
• Moves throughout the store to monitor assigned store(s) for activity that causes the loss of CVS Pharmacy assets/products. Communicates with Store Management about observations and asks Store Management for guidance/assistance if theft is suspected. Does not apprehend suspected shoplifters.
• Inspects high-risk product categories regularly to detect and deter theft activity.
• Ensures use of approved asset/product protection equipment and the security labeling program.
• Prepares External Theft reports in Auror system as incidents occur and monitors feeds to gather and share intelligence on known repeat offenders with key stakeholders.

Required Qualifications:

• Physical abilities to support the essential functions of the role as listed above, such as able to stand and/or move throughout the store for the majority of work time in order to provide excellent customer service and conduct effective theft prevention. Able to stoop, knell or crouch, and able to reach or grasp objects, including objects on lower shelves. Able to perform duties requiring manual dexterity, including but not limited to: applying security tags, and using keys to open and close locks.
• Excellent observational skills and able to recall and describe detailed facts. Able to see and hear in order to perform observational duties, including but not limited to: reading small print on labels, tags or containers.
• Able to engage and communicate well with customers and provide excellent customer service.
• Able to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing. Able to prepare and submit external theft reports as needed. Able to communicate effectively with both Asset Protection and Store Leadership Teams

The Strategic Account Director (SAD) is a senior people leader responsible for leading teams of Account Executives (AE) and Strategic Account Executives (SAE) who support large, complex employer Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) clients. The role is accountable for revenue growth, client retention, profitability, and long‑term partnership success across a portfolio of strategically important accounts.

As a leader of experienced account professionals, the SAD sets strategic direction, establishes priorities, and drives consistent, high‑quality execution across renewals, expansions, and ongoing client engagement. The SAD serves as a senior escalation point and trusted executive partner for clients and works closely with CVS Health leadership to influence outcomes, align resources, and deliver sustainable value. The role uses data, analytics, and emerging AI‑enabled insights to forecast risk, evaluate financial tradeoffs, guide renewal and expansion strategies, and scale best practices across the portfolio.

People Leadership & Team Performance

• Lead, coach, and develop teams of Account Executives and Strategic Account Executives, setting clear expectations aligned to revenue, retention, and client satisfaction goals
• Establish direction, priorities, and operating expectations for AE and SAE roles, ensuring strong role clarity, accountability, and consistent execution
• Foster a high‑performance culture through ongoing feedback, talent development, and succession planning

Strategic Account Oversight

• High team engagement, capability development, and performance outcomes

In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work.  We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day and our Graduate Pharmacy Interns play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.

As a Graduate Pharmacy Intern, you will apply your didactic learning from pharmacy school and pharmacy practice into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor and District Leader, you will complete a comprehensive training roadmap within 120 days of graduation designed to further your knowledge of store, district, and regional operations. Through your hands-on experience, training roadmap, and time spent with leaders in your district you will deepen your understanding of patient safety and error prevention, quality assurance drug utilization review (DUR), pharmacy professional standards such as corresponding responsibility and red flag detection. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

Job Category

Program & Project Management

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Job Description: Technical Program Management Director, Digital Marketing
Location: San Francisco, CA and Seattle, WA

The Experience

Salesforce is rethinking how digital marketing gets built and delivered. Our email and messaging platform is shifting to an agent-first model, changing how teams plan, ship, and measure success. As Director of Technical Program Management, you will lead high-impact, cross-functional programs where humans and AI agents work side by side to drive marketing outcomes.
You will lead the transformation of Salesforce's email and messaging operations: keeping today's high-volume systems reliable while delivering the next-generation agentic email platform, powered by Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud. You will align product, engineering, and marketing leadership around a shared vision, and use AI to change how complex programs are planned, tracked, and delivered. This is a high-visibility role that directly supports the priorities of the CMO and CDO.

What success looks like:

• First 90 days: Map the current email and messaging program portfolio, dependencies, and risks. Establish the steering committee cadence and a single source of truth for program status.
• First 12 months: Deliver key milestones of the agentic email platform with no loss of reliability, deliverability, or compliance in current systems. Embed AI-assisted program practices (planning, risk detection, status reporting) across your programs.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Program leadership

• Own end-to-end delivery of one or more strategic programs: define scope, release plan, program structure, and success metrics tied to business goals.
• Lead cross-team dependencies across scrum teams, functions, divisions, and partners; anticipate and clear blockers quickly.

Executive alignment

• Run steering committees to drive decisions, resolve escalations, and keep business goals and strategic vision on track.
• Be a trusted advisor to executive leadership; deliver monthly program reviews covering progress, risks, and critical issues.

Operational excellence

• Balance run and build: keep current email and messaging systems reliable (production issues, deliverability, compliance) while delivering the new platform.
• Run cross-functional working sessions with Product Owners, Marketing, Scrum Leads, UX, and CX on releases, dependencies, metrics, and status.

AI-enabled ways of working

• Introduce AI-powered approaches to program management and partner with teams building agentic capabilities.

Org and culture

• Foster a collaborative environment that encourages creativity, innovation, and learning.
• Act as a change catalyst, advancing the Technology, Marketing & Products strategy globally.
• Create clarity from chaos.

You're Our Person If

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
• 10+ years of technical program or engineering management experience at an enterprise technology company, including leading multi-team programs at director scope.
• 7+ years leading SaaS product development programs, with solid understanding of the SaaS business model and product development lifecycle.
• Deep experience with the software development lifecycle and agile methods, adapting them to dynamic environments.
• Proven ability to build credibility with senior executives and drive consensus in a cross-functional, matrix environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on, detail-oriented approach.
• Experience with portfolio management.
• Excellent organizational, communication, and relationship-building skills.

Even Better If

• Experience with marketing technology, email/messaging platforms, or customer data platforms (e.g., Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, or comparable tools).
• Familiarity with email deliverability, privacy, and compliance (e.g., CAN-SPAM, GDPR).
• Hands-on experience applying AI or automation to program delivery.
• Experience supporting C-level or CMO/CDO-level stakeholders.

About You

• You have led large-scale, multi-team technical programs in dynamic software focussed environments, e.g. marketing technology, or email/messaging platforms, or customer data platforms.
• You are credible with engineers and executives alike: comfortable going deep on architecture and dependencies, then summarizing for the CMO or CDO.
• You build relationships and drive alignment across product, engineering, marketing, UX, and CX in a matrix organization.
• You are curious about AI and have applied it to how work gets done (planning, automation, reporting), not just to the product.
• You bring calm, clarity, and urgency in complex or ambiguous situations.
• You think customer-first and value transparent communication.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. jobs.description:

This role requires being onsite in San Jose, CA at least 4 days/week.

Meet the Team

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) creates innovative hardware platforms central to the AI era, powering Cisco’s core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products for organizations globally. Our innovations in silicon, optics, and hardware platforms—like Silicon One—are shaping the technology industry. We're a global team of creative experts, bringing our unique backgrounds and bold ideas to push boundaries and help each other grow. Because full product development—from design to qualification to production—is within our team, we’re able to think differently, experiment more, and work quickly. Join us to power the future of the digital world.

Your Impact

• Design and develop thermal solutions (air cooled or liquid cooled) for systems with high-power ASICs and high-density optical transceivers.
• Develop detailed package, board, and system level simulations using Computational Fluid Dynamic tools such as Flotherm or Icepak to simulate and analyze thermal solutions.
• Collaborate with Distinguished Engineers and Hardware leads on system architectures and cooling.
• Perform thermal testing (including airflow, acoustic, thermocouple testing, modules, and/or platform level validations) to validate simulation models.
• Lead and mentor other thermal engineers in the group.
• Collaborate with mechanical engineers and other cross-functional teams to identify risks, derive tradeoffs and deliver objective, data-driven solutions.
• Develop test plans and test reports and present simulations reports to project team and management.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelors in Mechanical or Thermal Engineering + 12 years of related experience, or Masters in Mechanical or Thermal Engineering + 8 years of related experience, or PhD in Mechanical or Thermal Engineering + 5 years of related experience.
• 5+ years of experience in design, simulation, and testing of thermal solutions for electronic devices and systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 3+ years of relevant experience in the thermal design of telecom, compute, or networking equipment.
• Experience in use of Computational Fluid Dynamic analysis tools such as Flotherm or Icepak.
• Knowledge and experience with advanced air-cooling technologies (vapor chamber and remote heat sinks, thermal interface materials, fans/fan trays).
• Experience with designing liquid cooling and/or immersion cooling systems.
• Experience with performing other analysis such as Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Data Center cooling simulations.
• Experience with 3D MCAD modeling tools such as PTC's Creo or NX.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Meet the Team

FLEX is a 3-year leadership development program at Cisco under the People, Policy, and Purpose Organization (3P). FLEX’s name is derived from the vision the program has for participants to Find their passion and community, LEad their career and work, and EXplore the world of potential at Cisco.

As part of FLEX-EL, you will embark on a three-year leadership journey through a series of rotations (3–12 months each, though rotations typically last 12 months) within our 3P organization. • Our Policy Organization: home to our Government Affairs organization which manages how Cisco interacts and collaborates with local, national, and international governments.
• Our Purpose Organization: home to our teams responsible for driving Cisco’s work to build a more inclusive future for all such as Strategy and Planning, Country Digital Acceleration, Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), Social Impact & Inclusion, and Real Estate, amongst others.

Following the three years, graduates of the FLEX Program enter full-time roles across the 3P organization based on their career goals and interests.

Your Impact

• Work on projects that will increase value to the business.
• Drive several team-based projects and complete individual stretch assignments.
• Collaborate with senior leadership, managers, cross-functional teams, and other members of the FLEX community.
• Contribute to the FLEX Community by participating in program-specific teams.
• Participate in professional development workshops, function-specific training, and business seminars often led by industry leaders.

Currently enrolled in one of the following:

• An undergraduate degree program (Associate's or Bachelor's); or
• An educational or workforce development program (e.g., Apprenticeship, Boot camp, or Certification).

Wells Fargo recognizes and rewards the behaviors that create meaningful customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. • Champion digital adoption by educating customers on self-service and mobile banking options to elevate satisfaction, engagement, and service efficiency.

• Knowledge of book of business management practices, documentation of planning conversations, and consistent follow-through to drive retention and balanced growth across deposits, lending, and investments
• Experience assessing needs and recommending products and services for consumer and business customers
• Champion digital adoption by educating customers on self-service and mobile banking options to elevate satisfaction, engagement, and service efficiency
• Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and confidently, listen with empathy, and build credibility and trust with others

As a primary point of contact for customers, you represent the branch through strong service, attention to detail, and genuine care.

As a Teller, you will build foundational banking skills while learning about customers’ needs and introducing them to helpful products, services, and digital tools. You will identify opportunities to support customers and connect them to the right banker for more detailed product conversations. You will work closely with branch teammates to keep daily operations running smoothly and deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience. This role offers meaningful exposure to retail banking and serves as an excellent starting point for long-term growth and career mobility, supported by Wells Fargo’s training, coaching, and team-based culture.

In this role you will:

• Deliver a positive and reliable branch experience by accurately processing transactions and engaging customers with care.
• Process routine service transactions (such as deposits, withdrawals, payments, and check cashing) with accuracy and attention to detail.
• Welcome customers, understand their needs, and guide them to efficient ways to bank, including digital tools, self-service options, or the appropriate team member.
• Build relationships, actively listen to understand everyday financial needs, and connect customers to relevant information, services, digital tools, or bankers.
• Identify potential product or service needs, introduce solutions at a high level, and refer customers to a banker for detailed guidance.
• Complete transactional and operational activities accurately, exercising sound judgment and managing risk in line with policies and controls.
• Use strong communication and active listening skills to clarify needs and provide clear, simple solutions or next steps.
• Collaborate with branch teammates to deliver strong operations and service, follow leadership direction, and escalate complex situations as needed.
• Resolve routine customer questions or concerns and escalate more complex issues to ensure timely resolution.

Required Qualifications:

• 6+ months of interacting with customers experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience in customer-facing roles, with strong attention to detail and the ability to accurately process transactions across multiple systems in fast-paced environments.
• Strong verbal communication and active listening skills, with the ability to understand needs, ask effective questions, and clearly explain solutions.
• Ability to follow policies, procedures, and controls while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
• Proven cash-handling experience
• Demonstrated ability to quickly build accuracy, confidence, and consistency in customer transactions.
• Professional, integrity-driven approach focused on building trust through reliable service.
• Ability to recognize potential risk, ask questions, and appropriately escalate concerns to protect customers and the organization.
• Ability to understand customer needs, identify referral and service opportunities, and educate customers on digital banking tools to improve convenience.
• Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively with branch teammates to deliver a consistent customer experience.
• Organized and adaptable, with the ability to prioritize effectively in a dynamic, customer-focused environment.
• Ability to resolve routine customer concerns with sound judgment and professionalism.

Job Description:

In order to support the department ‘On-Board Processing’ in Ottobrunn, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Software Development Engineer – Embedded Real-Time SW (d/f/m)

Within the Digital Payload Centre of Competences of Space Systems Engineering organization, you will join the transnational entity (France, Germany and United Kingdom) in charge of Payload Processing, encompassing:

• Delivery of qualified on-board and on-ground processing chain (payload mission SW / applicative VHDL) for Telecom and Navigation Digital Payloads and RF Sensing
• Software delivery, operations and functional validation support for Optical & Radar Instruments.

Your location:

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. You are into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Our Benefits for You:

• Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
• Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
• Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
• Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
• Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

The local department in Ottobrunn is in charge of the full development process of Instrument Software, as :

- Analysis of Requirements Baseline provided by System Engineering through the SW Architect, defining the functional behaviour of the SW
- Definition of Embedded SW Architecture ( static and dynamic )
- Implementation of all functionalities as given in Requirements Baseline Execution of HW/SW integration and Functional Qualification before integration in Payload AIT
- Execution of all activities according to external and internal SW Process Standards ( ECSS-E-ST-40C, ECSS-Q-ST-80C )
- Piloting continuous internal efficiency improvement, productivity and processes, industrialization topics for the Digital Payload Processing entity.

Tasks and Responsibilities:

- Transformation of System SW requirements ( SSS ) into detailed SW requirements ( SRS )
- Analysis of embedded/real-time implementation constraints ( memory size, CPU load, deadlines )
- SW Design ( task scheduling, I/O, functional algorithms, SW Mode Management )
- HW/SW interface design ( I/O, interrupts, timing )
- Implementation of SW requirements ( coding )
- HW/SW integration and debugging - HW ( JTAG ) & SW ( gdb )
- Support to Verification activities ( coding rules, metrics, code coverage )
- Execution of SW validation activities ( unit testing, functional testing )
- Configuration control of SW and validation elements
- Generation of SW documentation according to SW process ( ECSS )
- Working multi-disciplinary with other functional domains ( Simulator - FVI, Database – DB )
- Support for controlling schedule and cost of SW development

Desired skills and qualifications:

Technical:

- Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics (or similar studies)

- Minimum 5-7 years of professional experience in a similar field

- Familiar with Space Standards ( ECSS-E-ST-40C, ECSS-Q-ST-80C, , ECSS-E-ST-70-41C )

- Adherence to a given SW development process and development standards and practices ( OPAL, MISRA, Static Code Analysis, Code Coverage )
- Embedded SW ( working with limited resources )
- Real-time systems and operating systems ( RTEMS )
- Experience in development for bare-metal targets w/o memory protection
- Programming language skills : C/C++, Assembler ( SPARC, ARM, .. )
- Ability to understand HW datasheets
- Familiar with standard interfaces ( Mil-Bus, Spacewire, CAN )
- Mastering the GNU compile environment
- Common SW development tools ( Eclipse, make, Confluence, Git, Jira, Gerrit, Doxygen, Polyspace )
- Mastering of standard SW packages ( Linux, Windows, Office )

Non-technical:

- good communication skills
- ability to work autonomously
- teamworking spirit ( intercultural )
- language skills ( English, Deutsch )

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online now

jobs.title: MRTT Production Quality Flight line and Delivery Center Engineer (on-site)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

An opportunity for a MRTT Production Quality Flight line and Delivery Center Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).

The selected candidate will join the MRTT Quality Operations Team, supporting manufacturing, maintenance, and flight line/delivery activities. The team is dynamic, highly collaborative, and multidisciplinary, working closely with production to ensure the highest standards of quality, safety, and operational excellence.

The jobholder will play an active role both on the shopfloor and as a direct interface with national/international customers and aviation authorities during official audits and aircraft handovers. Additionally, this role involves periodic international travel to support facilities and operations across the globe.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The main tasks of the jobholder will be:

• Manage and attest production quality: Perform shop-floor inspections, non-conformity management, and official attestation of work orders close to manufacturing/maintenance operations, preventing Foreign Object Damage (FOD).
• Lead customer and regulatory interfaces: Act as the primary Quality focal point during inspections and aircraft deliveries, directly interfacing with international customers and aviation authorities during audits.
• Conduct root cause analysis: Lead Practical Problem Solving (PPS) investigations for technical and quality issues, ensuring containment, corrective, and curative actions across multifunctional teams.
• Drive continuous improvement: Capitalize on project phases and operational valleys to propose, implement, and foster proactive quality improvement and predictive quality projects.
• Support shift and shop-floor operations: Guarantee quality coverage close to production on regular day shifts, rotating to afternoon shifts as needed (approximately 5 weeks per year).
• Provide international support: Travel to international and partner facilities (such as France, Switzerland, Canada, among others; at least 6 weeks per year) to support MRTT industrial operations.

SKILLS

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you:

• Education: Aeronautical, Industrial, or Mechanical Engineering degree (Bachelor's or Master's degree).
• Experience: 3 to 5 years of proven hands-on experience strictly related to Manufacturing, Shop-Floor Operations, or Maintenance environments (aerospace or automotive sectors are highly valued).
• Soft skills: Autonomous, proactive, strong team spirit, adaptability to changing workloads, and excellent interpersonal skills to foster a positive team environment.
• Languages: Advanced/Negotiation English level (real C1 for international customer interface) and native/advanced Spanish (direct contact with manufacturing). .
• Technical knowledge: Hands-on experience with manufacturing/maintenance quality tools, Practical Problem Solving (PPS), and knowledge of technical regulations
• Valuable / Nice to have: Knowledge of MRTT systems, knowledge of aeronautical regulations (EASA Part 145 or Part 121), and experience directly facing customers and official auditing bodies.

WORKING CONDITIONS & OPERATIONAL CONTEXT

• Workplace (100% On-site): This is an on-site, shop-floor position requiring daily direct interaction with production, hangars, and flight line operations. As such, this role does not have a structured teleworking scheme, though scheduling flexibility is provided to support personal circumstances and work-life balance.
• Work schedule & shift pattern: Regular working hours are primarily morning shifts (7:00 to 15:00), working in close proximity to production. The position requires rotating to an afternoon shift (15:00 to 23:00) on a scheduled basis (approximately 1 week every 8 weeks, totaling around 5 weeks per year), which includes a specific shift allowance (plus de doble turno) and additional personal leave days.
• Travel readiness: Willingness to travel nationally and internationally for a minimum of 6 weeks per year (typically clustered into defined blocks) across global sites and customer locations supporting the MRTT program worldwide.

WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE?

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:

• Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year.
• Attractive salary.
• Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting work-life balance.
• Collective transport service in some sites.
• Benefits such as health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.
• On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office.
• Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives.

• Special rates on products & benefits.

jobs.title: System of Systems (SoS) Concepts Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

An opportunity for a System of Systems Concepts Design Engineer has arisen in the area of Future Concepts within Airbus Defence and Space (Getafe).

The selected candidate will join the Future Concepts team, in charge of developing the future of Air Power solutions and capabilities. As part of the System of System Concepts team, it will contribute to the conceptual design activities of new solutions and integration of legacy systems as part of larger System of Systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Architectural Design & Conceptualization: Design and analysis of complex SoS architectures, addressing multi-domain challenges to define how future air power-enabled systems interact and operate.
• Advanced Modeling & MBSE: Support the development and refinement of SoS architectural frameworks and methodologies using MBSE to create rigorous models that allow us to understand and harness the emergent behaviors of complex, non-managed systems.
• Strategic Roadmapping: Contribute to the development of SoS roadmaps and technology strategies, identifying and curating key solution roadmaps to guide our long-term SoS evolution.
• Driving Reusability: Tackle the "Architecture of Reuse" challenge by designing scalable, reusable frameworks rather than one-off builds, maximizing the value of our entire portfolio.
• Analysis & Integration: Conduct trade-off analyses, feasibility studies, and impact assessments. Define interfaces, protocols, and integration strategies for heterogeneous systems to ensure seamless interoperability and data exchange.
• Risk Management: Identify and mitigate architectural risks, proactively addressing potential issues related to performance, scalability, security, and resilience.

SKILLS

• Master's degree or PhD in Systems Engineering, Aerospace, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a closely related technical field.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in systems engineering or architecture, desirable including training and hands-on experience in System of Systems (SoS) or complex enterprise-level architectures.
• Prior knowledge in architectural frameworks (e.g., UAF, DoDAF, MODAF) and modeling languages (e.g., SysML, UML), with hands-on experience using tools such as Cameo.
• Strong understanding of defence systems, including their operational contexts, constraints, and regulatory requirements.
• IDemonstrated experience in defining and integrating diverse technical domains (e.g., communications, sensors, command & control, data analytics, cybersecurity).
• Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
• A high level of adaptability, with the ability to work in areas with evolving requirements where the path is not yet paved.
• A collaborative spirit and a dedicated team-player mindset, enjoying the resolution of multi-disciplinary problems through collective intelligence.
• Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish is required.
• Applicant must fulfill the requirements to obtain a National Spanish Security Clearance.

jobs.title: STAGE 2027 - Animateur Qualité - Structure A350 (ALL GENDER)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ?

Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium.

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année.

Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - Technicien Qualité  - Structure A350 (ALL GENDER) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Montoir de Bretagne.

Cette mission débutera en janvier 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois.

Découvrez le site en vidéo :

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo et la Présentation du site de Montoir de Bretagne

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 30 personnes au sein du département  « Qualité A350 Structure » en charge de la Qualité Produit de l'unité de production A350 Structure

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

1. Digitalisation et gestion de l'enregistrement qualité

• Analyser l'ensemble des flux d'information « flash qualité » et diagnostiquer les écarts de transmission vers le terrain.
• Concevoir et déployer une nouvelle procédure de communication ciblée à destination des opérateurs de production.
• Piloter l'intégration de ce nouveau standard au sein du module de formation.
• Restructurer l'archivage des enregistrements qualité selon les besoins opérationnels des postes d'assemblage et digitaliser leur accès.

2. Déploiement de la culture qualité et ingénierie de formation

• Mettre en application les référentiels de certification aéronautique et les exigences applicables aux structures composites A350.
• Participer à la conception de modules de montée en compétences pour les compagnons
• Contribuer à l'animation des démarches d'amélioration continue du Système de Management de la Qualité (SMQ).
• Animer des actions de sensibilisation terrain pour diffuser la culture qualité sur la ligne d'assemblage.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation :

• Ingénierie des processus qualité : Analyse critique de la documentation technique, garantie de l'adéquation entre besoins terrain et exigences de certification aéronautique.
• Gestion de projet et conduite du changement : Structuration d'un projet de digitalisation, cadrage du planning, suivi des livrables et mesure des indicateurs d'efficacité opérationnelle (KPI).
• Ingénierie de formation et pédagogie industrielle : Création et déploiement de supports pédagogiques pour la montée en compétences des compagnons.
• Excellence opérationnelle & Data Quality : Exploitation des données de non-conformité et application des outils de résolution de problèmes (PDCA, QRQC) au sein d'un SMQ aéronautique.

Parlons de VOUS !

Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +2/3 (ou équivalent) dans le domaine de la qualité, la formation, l’industrie ou une discipline apparentée.

Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :

• Capacité d'analyse et de synthèse face à des volumes importants de données techniques.
• Notions de gestion de projet (planification, suivi d'actions, indicateurs).
• Sensibilité aux enjeux de la formation continue et de la gestion des compétences en milieu industriel.
• Notions fondamentales sur les systèmes de management de la qualité (ISO 9001 / EN 9100)
• Savoir être : Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Bonne communication, Capacité d'adaptation
• Anglais : notions
• Français : courant

Parlons de NOUS !

Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est :

• Participer à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie, visant à construire l’avion de demain tout en répondant aux défis environnementaux,
• Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale,
• Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain.

Notre processus de sélection

Toutes les candidatures seront soigneusement examinées par un recruteur.

Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous serez invité à réaliser un entretien vidéo afin de vous présenter.

Après évaluation, les candidats retenus seront contactés pour un entretien avec le manager ou le tuteur qui procédera alors à la sélection finale.

jobs.title: Avionics - Airborne Electronic Hardware Designer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

A vacancy has arisen for an Airborne Electronic Hardware Designer, inside the A/C & Mission System Integration Rigs domain, withing Airbus Defence and Space Air Power Engineering in Getafe.

The successful applicant will join the A/C & Mission System Integration Rigs domain, belonging to the Flight and Integration Test Centre of Competence. The domain is composed of around 100 employees located in Getafe, Manching and Bremen.

We are looking for an experienced and motivated engineer with a passion for advanced digital systems and aerospace technologies. The selected candidate will join a multidisciplinary team, in charge of the full life-cycle of the Design and Build of Airborne Electronic products and solutions.

The main activities of an Airborne Electronic Hardware Designer are:

• Design and develop complex airborne electronic hardware solutions
• Define hardware requirements and ensure system level requirements allocation
• Perform component selection considering reliability, obsolescence, thermal, and environmental constraints
• Support hardware validation, integration, qualification and environmental testing campaigns
• Collaborate closely with firmware developers, systems designers and certification responsible authorities
• Management of supplier work packages for the design, manufacturing and validation activities during prototype and production phases
• Participate in technical reviews, with internal customer teams (Design Offices, Chief Engineering and Program Offices) or external Certification/Qualification authorities (INTA, EASA)
• Prepare technical documentation aligned with aerospace development and certification processes
• Ensure compliance with aerospace and airborne standards DO-254 and DO-160

Associated competencies to main activities are:

• Digital Electronic Hardware Detailed Design: The demonstrated ability to master the design and/or perform analysis of digital electronic circuits including, logic circuits in FGPA, PLD requirements capture, timing analysis, corner cases analysis, power consumption estimation and environmental constraints.
• Knowledge of digital instrumentation and verification techniques as well as latest digital design tools
• Ability to provide sufficient detailed data and information about system elements to enable the implementation consistent with architectural entities as defined in models and views of the system architecture and in accordance with the allocated requirements.
• Ability to verify the compliance of a detailed, PLD solution toward baseline of validated requirements at aircraft equipment or system level.

Required Competences & Skills:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Engineering, or related discipline
• 5+ years of experience in hardware design for embedded or airborne systems within aerospace, defense, industrial, or high-reliability sectors
• Strong expertise in:Digital and analog electronicsHigh-speed designSignal and power integrityEmbedded architecturesEMI/EMC considerations
• Advanced experience with PCB design and review tools such as Altium Designer, Cadence OrCAD, or similar.
• Experience with aerospace communication protocols and interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, ARINC or similar avionics interfaces)
• Proven experience in hardware bring-up, debugging, and validation
• Strong understanding of safety-critical development environments
• Professional working proficiency in English

Desired Competencies & Skills:

• Previous experience in aerospace, avionics, UAV, or defense programs
• Knowledge of certification processes and airborne compliance standards (DO-254, DO-160, MIL-STD environments)
• Experience with FPGA-based systems and RF electronics

jobs.title: STAGE 2027 - Ingénieur Recherche et Technologie Matériaux Composites (ALL GENDER)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ?

Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium.

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année.

Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - Ingénieur Recherche et Technologie Matériaux Composites (all gender) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Méaulte.

Cette mission débutera en janvier 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois.

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo

Présentation du site de Méaulte

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 15 personnes au sein du département « Recherche et Technologie Composites » (R&T Composite Manufacturing) en charge du développement des technologies composites pour les aérostructures.

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

• Conception et ingénierie d'essais R&T : Participer au développement de la pyramide d'essais, définir les plans d'expériences et élaborer les protocoles d'essais de caractérisation des matériaux composites.

• Essais de fabrication et métrologie : Planifier et réaliser les essais de mise en forme ainsi que les mesures physiques et mécaniques sur des pièces composites de grade aéronautique.

• Analyse de données et optimisation des procédés : Analyser les données d'essais (plans de caractérisation, contrôles non destructifs) pour identifier et optimiser les paramètres de fabrication garantissant la qualité cible.

• Restitution scientifique et suivi de roadmap : Synthétiser les conclusions techniques, rédiger les rapports d'essais et présenter les recommandations au sein d'une équipe projet pluridisciplinaire et internationale.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation :

• Ingénierie des Matériaux Composites & Procédés : Maîtrise des techniques de transformation aéronautique, des protocoles de caractérisation mécanique/physico-chimique et des critères de conformité des structures composites.
• Démarche scientifique & Analyse de données R&T : Capacité à concevoir un plan d'expériences rigoureux, à analyser des données d'essais complexes et à modéliser la fenêtre de répétabilité des procédés.
• Communication scientifique en environnement international : Aptitude à rédiger des synthèses techniques structurées et à argumenter des choix d'ingénierie en anglais face à un réseau d'experts.
• Gestion de projet R&T & Rigueur industrielle : Structuration des étapes d'essais, respect des jalons de livraison et alignement des livrables sur la feuille de route technologique d'un leader de l'aéronautique.

Parlons de VOUS !

Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 (ou équivalent) dans le domaine de la mécanique, du génie des matériaux ou une discipline apparentée.

Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :

• Fondamentaux de la chimie/physique des matériaux composites (procédés de mise en œuvre, polymérisation) et mécanique générale (résistance des matériaux, calcul de structures).

• Capacités de lecture de plans techniques, modélisation ou exploitation de données expérimentales.

• Savoir-être : Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Bonne communication, Capacité d'adaptation
• Anglais : avancé
• Français : courant

Vous pourrez être amené(e) à vous déplacer avec votre tuteur.

Parlons de NOUS !

Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est : Participer à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie, visant à construire l’avion de demain tout en répondant aux défis environnementaux, Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale, Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain.

Notre processus de sélection

Toutes les candidatures seront soigneusement examinées par un recruteur. Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous serez invité à réaliser un entretien vidéo afin de vous présenter. Après évaluation, les candidats retenus seront contactés pour un entretien avec le manager ou le tuteur qui procédera alors à la sélection finale.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – C++ / Linux
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Senior Software Engineer – C++ / Linux

Flight Simulation Software

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our simulation engineering team, developing and maintaining software solutions for aeronautical simulation systems.

In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, integration, and verification of high-quality software, working primarily with C++ in a Linux environment. You will collaborate with a team of engineers on complex simulation projects, helping to develop robust, maintainable, and reusable software components while contributing to continuous improvements in software quality and development practices.

We are looking for an engineer with strong C++ programming skills, solid Linux expertise, and a good understanding of modern software development practices and tools.

Experience in flight simulation or aeronautical systems is a plus, but candidates with a strong software engineering background from other domains are also encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain high-quality software components using C++ in a Linux environment.

- Contribute to software architecture and technical design decisions, promoting modularity, maintainability, and reusability.

- Develop, build, debug, and troubleshoot software in Linux-based environments.

- Manage software dependencies and build configurations using tools such as CMake and Conan.

- Use Git for version control and collaborate effectively within a software development team.

- Use Docker to support consistent development, integration, and testing environments.

- Develop and maintain automated tests and contribute to software verification, code quality, and continuous integration activities.

- Use static analysis and code quality tools to identify issues and improve software quality.

- Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

- Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to integrate software components into simulation systems.

Required Qualifications and Experience

- At least 8 years of professional software development experience, with substantial experience in C++.

- Strong knowledge of modern C++ (C++14/17 or later), including the Standard Template Library (STL), memory management, object-oriented design, and software engineering best practices.

- Solid experience working in Linux environments, including command-line tools, shell scripting and software development and debugging.

- Practical experience with CMake for software configuration and builds.

- Experience managing software dependencies and packages, preferably using Conan.

- Proficiency with Git and collaborative version control workflows.

- Practical experience using Docker for development, testing, or integration.

- Good understanding of software testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and code quality practices.

- Ability to analyse complex technical problems, work independently, and take ownership of software deliverables.

- Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within an international engineering environment.

Desired Qualifications and Experience

The following skills and experience would be considered an advantage:

- Experience with flight simulation systems, simulation frameworks, or simulation software.

- Familiarity with flight simulation architectures, relevant standards, and interoperability concepts.

- Experience with aeronautical systems, avionics, flight dynamics models, or aircraft systems simulation.

- Familiarity with automated testing frameworks, unit and integration testing, and code coverage.

- Experience with continuous integration tools such as Jenkins and static analysis and code quality tools such as SonarQube and Clang-Tidy.

- Knowledge of software architecture principles, design patterns, and reusable software components.

- Experience with software integration and testing environments, including Model-in-thje-Loop (MIL), Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL).

- Experience working in aerospace, defence, or other complex engineering domains.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a proactive and technically strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, takes ownership of software quality, and is committed to continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate combines deep C++ expertise with practical Linux development experience and a structured approach to software engineering. They understand the importance of maintainable, reusable software and effective development practices, and they are comfortable collaborating with engineers from different disciplines.

An interest in simulation technology and the ability to work effectively in an international engineering environment are particularly valuable.Candidates must meet all legal and professional requirements for the role.

jobs.title: ATR - Internship - Automation of Measurement Uncertainty Calculation for FTI Measurements
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Want to join the ATR adventure? An internship opportunity has just opened on our site in Francazal!

In 2025, ATR has been awarded the Happy Trainees label. 94.3% of students recommend our company after their work-study or internship.

What we will do together:

Being an apprentice at ATR means being integrated into a team as a full member with a real scope of intervention and responsibilities. You will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills and experience within a market-leading company!

Internship: Automation of Measurement Uncertainty Calculation for Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) Measurement Chains

The ATR Flight Test Department relies on an onboard Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) system used to acquire and analyze thousands of parameters required for aircraft development, certification, and continuous improvement.

To ensure the quality and reliability of data collected during flight test campaigns, it is essential to assess the uncertainty associated with each measurement chain. This analysis must consider all elements of the measurement chain, including sensors, signal conditioning units, data acquisition modules, wiring, and any data processing applied throughout the acquisition process.

Today, these calculations are performed partially manually and require the collection of information from multiple sources. The objective of this internship is to develop a methodology and a software tool capable of automating both the uncertainty calculation process and the generation of the associated reports.

As part of this internship, the successful candidate will be expected to:

• Conduct a state-of-the-art review of uncertainty calculation methods applied to aerospace measurement systems.
• Analyze the various components that make up FTI measurement chains and identify the associated sources of uncertainty.
• Define a standardized methodology for automatically calculating the overall uncertainty of a measurement chain.
• Develop a tool to automate uncertainty calculations (using Python, MATLAB, or another suitable environment).
• Validate the obtained results through several representative application cases.
• Automate the generation of uncertainty analysis reports.
• Document the proposed solution and provide recommendations for its integration into the Flight Test Department’s processes.

This internship is designed for you

• Currently in the 2nd or 3rd year of an Engineering Degree (Master’s level, Bac+4/Bac+5) with a specialization in instrumentation, physical measurements, electronics, aerospace engineering, or data processing;
• Knowledge of metrology, instrumentation, and/or data analysis;
• Software development skills, with Python experience strongly preferred;
• Familiarity with data acquisition systems or testing environments would be considered an asset;
• Personal qualities: autonomy, rigor, analytical mindset, and technical curiosity;
• Languages: French and English.

Calendar

Starting date: Early 2027

Duration of 6 months

How does the recruitment process work?

The recruitment process takes place in two stages after receiving your application:

• Technical interview with Manager: Last step of the process you are almost there! The course manager will contact you for a validation interview.

jobs.title: Prototype Design and Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Airbus Helicopters is looking for a Prototype Design and Integration Engineer (f/m) based in Getafe (Madrid metropolitan area). We are looking for passionate individuals to join a cross-divisional project that will shape the future of autonomous flight for UAS (Uncrewed Aerial Systems) and enable 24/7 mission capabilities in the most challenging operational conditions.

The position is functionally attached to the Head of Engineering Spain and reports operationally to the Research and Innovation Leader in Spain..

Your working environment:

You will be based in Getafe, Airbus’s third-largest site globally where all three divisions converge. Madrid offers an unparalleled lifestyle for those looking to balance a high-impact career with a vibrant cultural scene. You will collaborate closely with various Engineering departments within Airbus Helicopters and the Helicopter Programs.

Your challenges:

• Preliminary Prototype & Modification Design: Lead the preliminary mechanical, structural, and electrical design for experimental UAS prototypes, specialized mounting provisions, and modular airborne payload enclosures.
• Multi-System Interface Definition: Define, document, and manage Interface Control Documents (ICDs)—encompassing mechanical attachments, electrical power distribution, thermal dissipation, and high-speed data interconnects—between novel sensors (cameras, LiDAR, radar), AI processing units, and flight test platforms.
• Platform Integration Studies: Conduct preliminary engineering studies to adapt and integrate experimental mission systems into diverse flight test assets (uncrewed platforms and crewed aircraft), ensuring structural integrity, mass balance, and minimal aeromechanical impact.
• Rapid Prototyping & Fabrication: Accelerate iteration cycles by leveraging rapid manufacturing techniques, additive manufacturing (3D printing), precision CNC fabrication, and custom wire harness integration.
• Ground Integration & Functional Verification: Supervise physical fit-checks, mechanical installation, electrical bench integration, and thermal/EMI risk reduction prior to experimental flight trials.
• Airworthiness & Design Office Alignment: Coordinate closely with structural, system safety, and airworthiness specialists to establish permit-to-fly documentation and safe-for-flight release criteria for experimental trial modifications.
• Trade-Offs & SWaP-C Optimization: Reconcile payload operational requirements with airframe physical boundaries, actively optimizing Size, Weight, Power, and Cooling (SWaP-C) constraints across prototype variants.

Your profile:

• Education: Degree or Master’s in Aerospace, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Systems Engineering. Specialization in Aerospace Vehicle Design or Mechatronic Prototyping is highly valued.
• Professional Experience: At least 5 years of professional experience in aerospace mechanical design, physical systems integration, or rapid prototyping within an aerospace OEM, flight test unit, or agile robotics company.
• Physical & Electrical Systems Integration: Proven track record of developing multi-disciplinary ICDs and integrating complex airborne equipment (electro-optical payloads, computing modules, power distribution units).
• CAD & Preliminary Design Mastery: Proficiency in 3D CAD platforms (e.g., CATIA V5/3DX, SolidWorks) for preliminary structural packaging, bracketry, aerodynamic fairings, and structural assemblies.
• Aeromechanical & Mass Properties Awareness: Understanding of aircraft weight and balance (CG envelope), structural load paths, thermal dissipation, and basic aerodynamic considerations for external stores or modifications.
• Hands-on Prototyping Skills: Practical experience with additive manufacturing (3D printing), rapid shop tooling, and aerospace harness assembly practices.
• Airworthiness & Modification Standards: Familiarity with aerospace modification design principles, environmental qualification guidelines (DO-160), and experimental flight permit processes (EASA/national authorities).
• Systems Thinking & Pragmatic Mindset: Ability to translate loose operational concepts into robust physical solutions, demonstrating agility and decisive technical judgment in fast-paced R&D environments.
• Language: Fluent English (C1 minimum) and Spanish.
• Travel: Availability to travel sporadically at a national and European level in line with flight testing plans.
